sections.title: LUXMAN A1020
sections.overview:
This tube pre-main amplifier kit not only has good performance but also takes design into consideration.A 3-pole tube is used for the whole amplifier.A 2-stage P-K / NF type equalizer, a 1-stage P-G / NF type buffer, and a LUX type NF type tone control are used. A total of four 12AX7 amplifiers are used for the preamplifier.The output stage of the main amplifier section combines 6R¥, a 3-pole output tube with low internal resistance and excellent low-frequency characteristics, with an OY14 output transformer that exhibits excellent characteristics over the entire band.The circuit that drives this stage employs a cathode coupled circuit called the Mulard type, which has a small time constant in the low-frequency range and is more stable and has a high gain.The first stage is 6AQ8, and the phase inversion stage is 12AU7.The external design is combined with the 500 series transistor-type pre-main amplifier.The headphone port uses a headphone plug to switch the output of the main amplifier.In the case of the kit, there is a problem of adjustment, but we have succeeded in drawing out the desired performance with minimum adjustment in the main amplifier and no adjustment in the preamplifier by devising mechanical aspects such as accuracy of parts and use of a board.

Circuit diagram A shows the commonly used 2-stage P-K / NF type equalizer circuit, and circuit diagram B shows the equalizer circuit adopted for A1020.For the circuit used in A1020, R2Is V2Plate to V1This resistor is connected directly to the cathode of the circuit diagram A.1However, in Schematic B, the low-frequency time constant is reduced by one step compared to Schematic A, and the phase characteristic is improved.

The high-cut and low-cut filters use a circuit called the CR1-stage circuit. In the A1020, the low-cut frequency is 35 Hz and the high-cut frequency is 11 kHz as the standard. You can change the cut-off frequency by changing each filter capacitor in this circuit one by one.Similarly, the standard low-frequency and high-frequency turn-over frequencies of the tone control circuit can be changed by changing the corresponding capacitor.These changes are detailed in the Assembly Manual.

sections.title: LUXMAN A2012
sections.overview: Stereo preamplifier kit with all stages DC configuration.The A2012 is based on the know-how obtained with the 5C50 preamp of the Luxman Laboratory Reference Series. sections.title: LUXMAN A3032
sections.overview: Preamplifier kit incorporating LUXMAN tube control amplifier CL32 into a kit.The equalizer amplifier section uses a 3-stage cathode-cathode NF circuit incorporating SRPP (Shunt Regulated Push-Pull) output circuit and feeds back from the output stage to the first stage cathode. This circuit realizes high input resistance and high S / N ratio while keeping distortion factor low.A two stage plate-cathode NF circuit is adopted for the flat amplifier section. Feedback is applied from the second stage cathode to the first stage plate. Local feedback is applied between the plate and plate to improve the bare characteristics before applying the major NF.A cathode follower circuit is used for the output stage.A 4-channel volume has been adopted to improve the SN ratio at a practical level.A new type of low-frequency filter is used to cut the very low frequencies from 5 Hz to 10 Hz without increasing the number of active elements and minimizing the influence on the audible frequency band.By eliminating most of the shielding wires in the signal path and routing the input circuit in the shortest path, long-term stability and excellent characteristics are ensured.A power transformer using a cut core is used for the power supply part, and a DC ignition using a constant voltage circuit is used for the heater power supply to prevent mixing of pulse noise.Crosstalk characteristics have been improved by separating the vacuum tubes except for the cathode follower of the output stage to the left and right.There was a muting circuit kit as an optional item sold separately.This kit allows you to disconnect the output circuit until the operation is stable.

sections.title: LUXMAN A3400
sections.overview: Vacuum tube type control amplifier kit.The equalizer circuit uses the K-K ? NF type, which is close to the Marantz type, and was newly developed after ascertaining the characteristics of the Marantz Model7 and Macintosh C-22 circuits. In this A3400 circuit, the cathode resistance of the third stage is divided into 33k   and 3.3k   to prevent the amount of NF in the ultra-high band from becoming unnecessarily large. In addition, by locally applying NF from the third stage cathode to the first stage plate, the bare characteristics before the major NF is applied are improved, and the strain rate characteristics are improved.The intermediate amplifier is a 3-pole tube 2-stage configuration. In order to suppress the gain of the A3400 and not to worsen the distortion at high output, we have adopted a B-type balancer (insertion loss is approximately -8dB) to provide an appropriate overall gain. This is because in order to achieve a low gain at the 2-stage configuration, the high feedback type inevitably reduces the negative feedback resistance, so this resistance becomes the second stage plate load and prevents the distortion at high output from worsening.By installing a linear equalizer in this stage and switching the feedback element, frequency characteristics with a linear slope can be obtained over the whole band.The tone control circuit uses the Lux-NF type.Since a print switch is used for adjusting the low and high sound levels, flat characteristics are improved and stable control is possible.This circuit is also capable of defeat.The output circuit uses a cathode follower to keep the output impedance low.This stage is equipped with a filter that can switch the cut-off frequency in two stages for both high and low frequencies. This is an NF type filter using a cathode follower, and it is a genuine filter that cuts at a slope of -12dB per octave.

sections.title: LUXMAN A3000
sections.overview: This is a bulb-type monaural power amplifier kit that makes full use of the development of new materials such as output tubes, driver tubes, and output transformers and circuit technology that makes use of these materials.Newly developed 3-pole output tube 8045G for large output is used for the output tube.The output tube has a large plate electrode with a high heat radiation effect made of five layered metal plates, and an electrode structure with heat radiation fins, resulting in a plate loss of 45W.The newly developed transformer GX100-3.6 developed for 8045G is used for the output transformer.The GX100-3.6 uses a special winding method called ???????? winding, which is a multi-transformer technology. In this ???????? winding method, the primary winding of the transformer is divided into the plate side (first winding) and the cathode side (second winding), a bootstrap winding (third winding) and a minor NF winding (fourth winding) are provided, and these four windings are wound simultaneously.The external appearance is inherited from OY36, but the content is to increase the handling capacity by increasing the core size and to minimize loss so that it can be taken out up to 100W even at 35 hz.A cross-shunt push-pull circuit is used for the output circuit.In this output circuit, the load of the upper and lower output tubes is divided into two parts, plate side and cathode side respectively, and these parts are cross-connected to each other. In this circuit, 6 dB negative feedback is applied to the output tube, which reduces strain and internal resistance and has a large effect on bare characteristics.To realize this circuit, an output transformer with special winding method is required.The drive stage uses a cathode follower direct-coupled circuit to keep the output impedance low and to obtain a drive voltage without waveform distortion. In addition, this stage requires 100% negative feedback, so there is little distortion and phase change, and favorable conditions for direct coupling with the output tube are also provided.This drive stage employs 6240G, a newly developed twin 3-pole drive tube for high voltage.Cathode follower Since the gain cannot be obtained by the direct drive circuit, the gain is supplemented by a pre-drive circuit using the same 6240G, which has a drive voltage of 200 vrms.For the cathode of this stage, about 5 dB of minor loop negative feedback is applied from the fourth winding of the output transformer by the balance method. This improves various characteristics after the pre-drive stage.The first stage of A3000 employs a differential amplification system using a bi-triode 12AX7 and at the same time serves as phase inversion.The second stage, which is directly connected to the first stage plate, is also equipped with a differential amplifier. The phase inverted signal at the first stage is voltage-amplified and sent to the pre-drive stage. This configuration automatically compensates for the balance of the push-pull operation, resulting in excellent distortion factor characteristics.The power supply circuit uses a power transformer (S-1934) with good regulation, a choke coil (C-1744) with low DC resistance, and a large electrolytic capacitor (220 ? Fx2).Power is supplied to the output stage from a bridge rectifier circuit to minimize voltage fluctuations.Tube kit TU3000 was sold separately.8045Gx2, 6240Gx2, 12AU7x1, 12AX7x1.

sections.title: LUXMAN A2110
sections.overview: Stereo power amplifier kit with DC amplifier configuration.It is based on the LUXMAN Laboratory Reference Series Stereo Power Amplifier 5M21.In order to suppress DC drift due to changes in external conditions such as temperature, which is a defect of DC amplifier, we have adopted DML-IC which integrates dual FET for first stage differential amplifier and auxiliary circuit to improve reliability.The power supply is equipped with two newly developed thin toroidal transformers and four newly developed high-capacity capacitors (10,000 ? F) with improved sound quality. This eliminates interference between the left and right channels and provides a stable power supply to each amplifier circuit.We also use carefully selected parts such as resistors, semi-fixed resistors, capacitors, etc.In order to maximize the performance of the DC amplifier, we use a printed circuit board as much as possible, separate boards for the left and right channels, and separate relays for muting circuits and speaker terminals for the left and right channels to improve crosstalk characteristics.By eliminating functions such as speaker switches, sound quality degradation due to excess contact passage is suppressed.Equipped with peak indicatorsThis indicator consists of two LEDs indicating 0 dB and -6dB, and an indicator sensitivity switch.The input level set uses a new volume with improved sound quality that provides highly accurate attenuation characteristics.

sections.title: LUXMAN A2500
sections.overview: Bulb-type power amplifier kit corresponding to the improved version of KMQ8.6R¥, a 3-pole tube with low internal resistance and excellent low-frequency characteristics, and OY14 type transformer with excellent characteristics are used in the output stage. The 3-pole tube can be used as a 5-pole tube and requires a high drive voltage. The A2500 uses a cathode-coupled Mulard circuit in the drive circuit to obtain sufficient drive voltage and reduce the time constant for the low-frequency range.To improve the bare characteristics of the amplifier, 6AQ8 is used for the first stage and 12AU7 for the phase inversion stage. Together with the output stage, 3-pole tubes are used for all stages. This configuration makes the amplifier excellent in bare characteristics.The amount of NFB can be varied by securing excellent bare characteristics in A2500.The standard amount of NFB is set at 14 dB, and it is possible to obtain satisfactory characteristics as an audio amplifier by applying only 6 dB of NFB, which is about half of this amount.The hood was sold separately as an option.

sections.title: LUXMAN A3500
sections.overview: A typical tube type main amplifier kit of LUX KIT.The output transformer adopts OY15 type which is used for SQ38FD and MQ60, etc., and an output of 40W is obtained by push-pull type ultra linear connection using 6CA7 for the output tube.In addition, 6L6GC and 50CA10 are designed to be used for the output tube with only slight modification.A cathode coupled circuit called a leak Mulard type is used for the driver circuit (phase inversion circuit).This circuit has the advantage of high gain, but it has the disadvantage of unbalanced gain between upper and lower gain. The A3500 uses 6AQ8, which has high amplification, so that the unbalanced gain can be ignored even if the plate resistance is the same between upper and lower.The A3500 has improved bare characteristics throughout the amplifier, ensuring excellent characteristics without applying negative feedback of strength.A unique MLF circuit (multiple loop feedback circuit) is used for the negative feedback circuit to keep distortion low over the entire audible band and to maintain stability against load fluctuations.The power supply section uses a power transformer with sufficient space to accommodate various output tubes, and the choke coil used to remove the ripple that causes the hum component is designed for A3500.The A3500 is designed to take out the power supply for the preamp. When combined with the preamp kit A3300, it can be supplied by the connector cord.Hood is included.50CA10 / CR tube and kit were sold separately.

sections.title: LUXMAN A-3550
sections.overview: Stereo / monaural power amplifier kit with selectable beam tube connection and 3-pole tube connection.The A3550 is based on a stereo power amplifier using a high-reliability and high-power beam tube 6550A developed by GE of the US.As for the circuit method, while taking advantage of the advantages of the Williamson-type circuit characterized by a wide bandwidth and low distortion by reviewing the origin of sound production, we aim to improve sound quality by finishing it into a unique circuit that eliminates multiple NFB.The basic form of the Williamson type amplifier is a high-feedback amplifier using a wide-band OPT (output transformer). However, the A3550 has newly designed and adopted the OY15 high-power type, which is well known for its OPT, and has a sufficient stagger ratio to enable stable NFB. By reducing the amount of NFB as much as possible, the transient response and dynamic characteristics are improved.On the A3550, you can choose 8 modes with 3 selection points.First, the connection of the beam tube and 3-pole tube can be selected at the time of assembly. After assembly, NFB and NON-NFB, stereo and monaural can be switched by the switch operation.All transformers have been newly designed for the A-3550.In addition to using non-magnetic acoustic resistors, Blackgate S block capacitors, oxygen-free copper wiring materials, MD-capacitors, etc. after controlling their polarity, it is equipped with a "Line Phase Sensor" which checks AC lines for the first time in a kit.Copper plating is applied to the bottom plate and other parts necessary for sound quality.

sections.title: LUXMAN A3600
sections.overview: Stereo power amplifier kit using 3-pole output tube 8045G for large output same as A3000.All amplifier stages are designed with emphasis on bare characteristics, and excellent distortion factor characteristics are realized by multiplying major NF by 16 dB.The 8045G was developed jointly by LAX and Shin-NEC in preparation for the high-power era. The plate electrode employs a five layer bonded metal plate with high heat radiation effect and an electrode structure with heat radiation fins, resulting in a plate loss of 45W.The output transformer uses the newly developed OY15-3.6K-HP for the A3600. This transformer has the same appearance as the conventional OY15 type, but the handling capacity is increased to 50W for high power specifications. In addition, it reduces insertion loss and improves high-frequency characteristics.The driver circuit employs a cathode-coupled phase-reversal circuit called the orthodox Mulard type, which provides high stability because of its large output voltage and large gain.This circuit also uses 6240G developed for high-voltage drives. This ball is a twin triode with low internal resistance and Nakamashi width-ratio, and has high plate loss. It has excellent conditions as a driver tube for a high-power amplifier. In order to balance the gain of the upper and lower driver tubes, the A3600 has an appropriate difference in plate resistance. This circuit also has excellent conditions as a driver tube for a high-power amplifier.6AQ8 with low internal resistance and high amplification factor is adopted in the first stage. By keeping the impedance of the plate circuit sufficiently low, deterioration of high-frequency characteristics is prevented, and the phase correction circuit which deteriorates the distortion factor in high-frequency characteristics is eliminated, and excellent high-frequency distortion factor characteristics are obtained.

sections.title: LUXMAN LUXKIT
sections.overview: Chassis kit for power amplifier that allows you to select output tube and circuit method according to your preference.The A3700 consists of a universal high-capacity power transformer, a choke coil capable of handling high current, and a high-voltage block capacitor. With this chassis kit, you can select one of four tube panels (sold separately) according to your preferred circuit type, and combine it with an OY15 type output transformer, vacuum tube, resistor, capacitor, socket, etc. to complete a tube bulb power amplifier.The output transformer of the OY15 series which is recommended to be used for the A3700 is available in two types of high-power push-pull type with reduced power loss by increasing the wire diameter, and two types of newly developed wide-band single type with less power loss.8045G and 2A3 3-pole tubes and 6CA7 and KT-88 multi-pole tubes can be used. The output stage can be either a push-pull circuit or a single circuit. For multi-pole tubes, an ultra-linear connection is standard. A cathode NF circuit can be used in combination with a 3-pole tube connection.However, when a large ST tube such as 2A3 is used as an output tube, it is not possible to construct a stereo push-pull circuit due to its shape and height, or it is not possible to install it with the bonnet as it is.An assembly manual is included with the package. It includes wiring diagrams and adjustment methods for stereo push-pull circuits of 8045G, 6CA7, and KT-88, as well as recommended circuit examples for stereo push-pull circuits of 8045G, 2A3, etc. Leo Shin.TCR-45Recommended circuit parts set of stereo push-pull circuit by combining large 3-pole output tube 8045G jointly developed by LAX and NEC with high-power high-performance output transformer OY15-3.6K-HP with extremely low insertion loss.The driver circuit uses a cathode-coupled phase-reversal circuit called the Mulard type, which uses Lux-brand high-voltage driver tube 6240G to create an excellent driver circuit.When the TCR-45 is combined with the A3700, a stereo power amplifier with an effective output of 50Wx2 is completed.TCR-A7Recommended circuit parts set for stereo push-pull circuit combining 5-pole output tube 6CA7 which is well known as output tube for audio and new output transformer OY15-5K-HP of high power specification with very low insertion loss.The output stage can be connected to an ultra-linear connection, an ultra-linear connection + cathode NF, or a 3-pole tube connection. The driver circuit consists of a cathode-coupled phase inversion circuit using Lux-brand high-voltage driver tube 6240G.When the TCR-A7 is combined with the A3700, a stereo power amplifier with an effective output of 40Wx2 is completed.CR-3700PA CR parts set that includes resistors, capacitors, sockets, lug plates, and wiring materials to configure the recommended stereo push-pull circuit (described in the assembly manual attached to A3700) by combining the output tube such as KT-88 and OY15 type output transformer with A3700.The connection method of the output stage can be selected from ultra-linear connection, ultra-linear connection + cathode NF, and 3-pole tube connection. The driver circuit consists of a cathode coupling type phase inversion circuit using Lux-brand high-voltage driver tube 6240G.Tube panel is not included.

Chassis kit for power amplifier whose configuration can be changed by part set sold separately.The A3700II is a chassis kit for a tube type stereo power amplifier with an effective output of up to 55Wx2.It includes a chassis, a universal high-capacity power transformer, a high-current choke coil, and a high-voltage block capacitor.The A3700II can be combined with a circuit part set (sold separately) to complete a tube type power amplifier. The circuit configuration can be selected from 3 connected NFB, 3 connected NON-NFB and UL connected push-pull circuits. In addition, there was a part set for push-pull to take advantage of the vacuum tubes and OY15 type output transformer.The attached assembly manual lists a single circuit as a recommended circuit.TCR88Stereo configuration parts set combining KT88 large beam output tube and OY15-3.6K-HP high power output transformer with low insertion loss.The first stage is a 3-connection low-noise tube 6267, and the driver circuit is a cathode-coupled phase inversion circuit with 6AQ8. It can be a 3-connection NFB, 3-connection NON-NFB or push-pull circuit with UL connection or a single circuit.TCRAIIStereo push-pull parts set combining 5-pole output tube 6CA7 6CA7 which is well-established for audio and new output transformer OY15-5K-HP of high power specification with very low insertion loss.The first stage is a 3-connection low-noise tube 6267, and the driver circuit is a cathode-coupled phase inversion circuit with 6QA8. 3-connection NFB, 3-connection NON-NFB and UL connection can be made.CP3700PIIThis is a part set for mounting a stereo push-pull circuit using a vacuum tube or OY15. It is a set of resistors, capacitors, sockets, lug plates, and wiring materials. This makes it possible to use a large ST tube such as 2A3 as an output tube. The bonnet may not be used because the shape and height vary depending on the configuration.I had a self-made tube panel sold separately.VP-1 is a push-pull tube panel with 4 holes for GT tubes and 4 holes for MT tubes. VP-2 is also a push-pull tube panel with 4 holes for GT tubes and 3 holes for MT tubes.VP-3 is a tube panel for single, with 2 holes for GT tubes and 3 holes for MT tubes.VP-4 is a raw tube panel.

Stereo power amplifier kit using the same parts as MQ60 model.The circuit configuration follows MQ60 and is based on the power amplifier of SQ38FD and SQ38FD/II.The output tube uses 50CA10, a medium-sized triode. 50CA10 is a compact Ron-type vacuum tube with low internal resistance and excellent bare characteristics.The output transformer uses the OY15 type, which is used in Lux's SQ38FD/II.A cathode coupled type is used for the drive stage.The cathode-coupled circuit is based on the Mulard type and has been improved to take advantage of the characteristics of the circuit. This circuit features a direct connection between the voltage amplification stage at the first stage and the phase inversion stage at the next stage. The time constant circuit is small for the number of stages, and the loop gain of the amplifier can be large.In the original circuit of the Mulard, 6267 is adopted for the voltage amplification stage of the first stage, and this is used as a 5-pole tube. However, in the KMQ60, the same 6267 is adopted for the first stage, and it is connected to a 3-pole tube to lower the internal resistance and improve the high-frequency distortion characteristics.Since the total gain is insufficient in the configuration of the drive stage adopted for the KMQ60, a High Gm twin triode 6AQ8 is used in the phase inversion stage to gain gain in this stage, making it easier to maintain AC balance and to suppress distortion in the first stage.All stages are composed of 3-pole tubes (the first stage consists of 3 connections of 6267), which improves the bare characteristics and ensures high stability by only applying a small amount of NF.A resistor (22  ) and a capacitor (0.22 ? F) are connected in series to the secondary side of the output transformer.This circuit is designed to prevent the amplifier from becoming unstable due to almost no load in the high frequency range where the impedance of the speaker increases. It is a kind of integral phase compensation circuit.In addition, a buffer resistor is inserted into the first stage grid in order to avoid the effect of impedance from the output of the control amplifier, etc., and consideration is taken to suppress the fluctuation of frequency characteristics caused by volume change.The hood in the picture was sold as an option sold separately.Initially the panel design (logo) seems to be slightly different.

sections.title: LUXMAN KMQ80
sections.overview: A bulb-tube amplifier kit is a kit of the tube type stereo power amplifier MQ80.The output tube is a 6336A bi-triode with a large graphite electrode plate.This ball has a large plate loss of 30W per one unit and 60W for both units. However, because this type of tube has a very narrow gap and is dense, it must be stable both in terms of material and structure so that the electrodes themselves cannot be deformed by vibration or heat. For this reason, KMQ80 has selected RAYTHEON tubes for use.The output transformer employs a cross-shunt push-pull operation output transformer that was developed to maximize the performance of 6336A.This transformer employs a bifilar winding, a special winding method, which is the same as the OY15 type in appearance. However, the internal structure is such that the primary winding of the output transformer is divided into the plate side and the carousel side, and these two windings are wound simultaneously. This method has succeeded in reducing distortion factor from small output power to large output power.In addition, the frequency characteristic of the output transformer itself has been extended to 200 kHz, and the phase characteristic is also excellent. Therefore, in addition to improving the bare characteristics of the amplifier, the stability when negative feedback is applied is also excellent.In the driver stage, a cathode follower direct-coupled circuit is adopted to realize a drive voltage without waveform distortion by keeping output impedance low. In addition, a large amount of voltage negative feedback is applied to this circuit, so that distortion and phase change are small, and direct coupling with the output tube is easy.Since this direct-coupled circuit does not have a time constant at the coupling part, there is no transient phenomenon caused by this connection, and stable driving is possible even during overswing.The KMQ80 has adopted a twin triode 12BH7A for this stage.Since the gain cannot be obtained with the cathode follower direct-coupled circuit, the phase inversion stage is used to make up for the lack of gain. The KMQ80 uses the Mulard type, which can gain gain, and uses 6AQ8, which has a large amplification degree and relatively low internal resistance, to obtain a large output voltage. To balance the gain of the inversion circuit, the plate resistance is slightly changed to balance the output voltage.The 5-pole tube 6267 is used for the first stage, and the phase inversion stage is directly coupled with it to reduce the low-frequency time constant circuit.This is because a large gain is obtained at the first stage to increase the total gain, and at the same time, a relatively deep negative feedback of 22 dB is applied from the secondary side of the output transformer to the cathode of the first stage to improve the distortion factor characteristics without loss of stability.A large power transformer is used for the power supply circuit, and the power supply for the output circuit is a bridge rectification system to optimize the regulation. The smoothing circuit also combines a choke coil with low DC resistance and a large electrolytic capacitor (330 ? Fx2) to reduce the power supply impedance and provide a stable circuit with less voltage fluctuation.In addition, a protective circuit for protecting the output tube and a preheating circuit for the output tube are mounted.Chip jack for operation check and input level set are mounted.There was a special hood sold separately.

sections.title: LUXMAN LUXKIT
sections.overview: The armless record player kit was developed by returning to the starting point of what the basic of the player is.The turntable uses 12 mm thick flat glass produced by the floating manufacturing method with excellent smoothness.The success in precision processing of float glass, which had been difficult in the past, has led to the realization of a glass turntable with a high density of 2 kg weight and moderate internal loss.A 12-pole synchronous motor is used as the drive motor. Since the synchronous motor is directly driven by AC 100 V, it has the advantage that the sound quality is not affected by conditions such as DC stability unlike a DC power supply.The power supply frequency of 50Hz/60Hz can be adjusted by replacing the motor pulley.It adopts a simple method of changing the rotation speed by changing the belt, and accurate rotation can be obtained over a long period of time.33 turns belt the upper side of the pulley and 45 turns belt the lower side of the pulley.Stainless steel is used for the spindle, and along with the bearing, an ultra-precision finish of micron order is applied to improve stability while improving rotational accuracy.Any desired arm up to an effective length of 275 mm can be used for the arm base.Arm can be replaced by arm base sold separately.There was a specially developed tone arm TA522 as an option sold separately.The TA522 comes with an arm base TB522.

sections.overview: This player kit is a kit of Luxman's analog player PD131.The turntable is made of aluminum die-cast.The PDK131 is designed to be as heavy as possible while taking into consideration not only the required inertial mass but also the resonance and strength of the motor bearings and parts.A bayonet mount type arm base is adopted for the arm base, and it is designed so that various arms can be replaced with one touch.As for the arm base, only for SME is included as a standard, and there are other variations such as general use, exclusive for orthophone, exclusive for other, and unprocessed arm base.The chassis uses an aluminum die-cast chassis of sufficient strength and weight, and the top panel uses a 3 mm anodized aluminum panel, which is held firmly in place with rubber and wooden frames for damping.A 3-layer structure insulator is used for the leg part.In this insulator, the spring is dumped with rubber and the entire body is dumped with silicon grease to achieve both the compliance and braking necessary for vibration isolation.The strobe displays the number of revolutions by flashing a black light pulse and also identifies the power supply frequencies by color (60 hz : yellow, 50 hz : yellow-green).The power switch uses a micro switch.Dust cover is sold separately for PDK131.There is a mat for the record player as an optional item sold separately, and you can effectively dump the resonance of the record.

sections.title: LUXMAN DA-07
sections.overview: D/A converter using F / E / DAC with emphasis on pulse reproducibility.F ? E ? DAC is adopted for D/A conversion part of DA-07.This DAC was developed based on a new theory, the Full Embassy Theory, invented by the University of Tsukuba. The structure emphasizes the reproducibility of pulse components (impulse response) beyond the reproducibility of continuous sine waves.The F ? E ? DAC is fundamentally different from the conventional D/A converter in which the digital code is converted into a step-like form before analog conversion. The digital code is directly connected by a curve using a new interpolation function for analog reproduction. This realizes an extremely natural waveform natural waveform and approaches the waveform of an analog signal of music. Moreover, the F ? E ? DAC has excellent impulse response and faithfully responds to instantaneous pulse input without generating excessive vibration. Therefore, ideal reproducibility of step response, which was impossible with analog disks and tape decks until now, is realized.The F ? E ? DAC is a waveform reproduction method in which digital codes are directly connected by a curve without changing them in a stepwise manner. Therefore, in principle, it eliminates the necessary evils such as digital filters that generate waveform vibration and analog filters that inevitably generate phase shifts.The analog circuit uses a pure A-class service machine that supplies a constant bias current up to the maximum output.The quality of DAC is fully utilized by the pure A-class system and low-impedance transmission analog circuit that LAX has consistently adopted.The input jacks are equipped with coaxial input Route 3 and optical input Route 3.Two high-speed standard type optical input terminals are installed, and the other one is equipped with an ultra-high-speed optical terminal unique to LUX with a transmission rate several tens of times higher than that of the conventional one.In addition, two digital output terminals (standard type optical and coaxial) are installed as digital outputs for recording.In addition to the canon connector for balanced outputs, the analog outputs are equipped with a total Route 3 output of one direct / variable coaxial outputs each.The chassis consists of two stages, and the analog and digital sections are completely separated. Each block is separated into a total of 10 rooms for complete shielding.The entire chassis is plated with copper to eliminate mutual interference. In addition, the front panel made of 18 mm thick extruded material and special FRP bottom chassis with high rigidity and large mass are made to eliminate resonance of the entire structure.The power supply unit is equipped with two transformers that are independent of analog / digital. In addition, the power supply configuration is completely independent of L/R for both analog and digital. In addition, the use of a rectifier circuit and an 11-division independent regulator eliminates interference between analog / digital, channels, and blocks.We use carefully selected parts such as pure focus condenser with special coating resistance of gold plated cap and sound quality countermeasure, PC-OCC wire material for all wiring materials, glass epoxy board with 70 micron thickness OFC pattern, etc.Multi-multi-processor capability and supports sampling frequencies of 32 khz, 44.1 khz and 48 khz.It has a simple design with only a power switch and an output digital display when the sealing panel is closed. In addition, an oil dump system is used for the sealing panel, allowing smooth opening and closing.Inside the ceiling panel is equipped with an output level volume, a dimmer switch for adjusting the display brightness, and an input selector.

sections.title: LUXMAN E-1
sections.overview: This is a phono amplifier that has a separate phono equalizer and is thoroughly pure oriented.Equipped with an articulator position that blends the cartridge with the signal current of the music to be played.When music is played with the impedance switch in this position, the cartridge is tuned so that the playback capacity of the cartridge is minimized to that music.A flat RIAA curve is obtained by combining an NF-type equalizer and a CR-type equalizer (for super wide area only) using computer simulation.In addition to the left and right channels, it uses a 4-amplifier configuration for MM/MC exclusive use. It can draw out the characteristics of all cartridges with various impedance values such as Orthophone type with internal impedance of 2   and Denon type with internal impedance of 40  .Each MM/MC has a 3-stage impedance switching function.The MM/MC equalizer is switched to the ground side using an audio-only relay.All circuits, including accessory circuits such as relay controls, are separately arranged in an optimum position as a discrete configuration, and noise is isolated by shield partition walls to prevent mutual interference.Two inputs can be switched on the front panel to accommodate two players or a twin-arm type player. The selected input signal is automatically taken out from one output terminal using a 2-in-1-out method.It uses custom audio parts such as block capacitors with excellent instantaneous discharge characteristics and no colorization, and large-capacity resistors with high information content and ultra-low distortion characteristics.

sections.title: LUXMAN E-03
sections.overview: Phono equalizer with independent configuration of MM/MC.In order to minimize the transmission distance to the analog player, a compact design has been adopted that allows grounding near the player.The E-03 employs a 4-amp configuration with independent amplifiers for MM/MC in addition to the left and right channels. It is compatible with all cartridges with impedance values around it, including the orthophone type with internal impedance of 2   and the 40   denon type.The MM amplifier consists of a differential amplifier circuit using two high-Gm dual FETs per channel in parallel for the first stage, a P-type low-noise dual transistor for the second stage, and a high-gain emitter-follower connection for the current amplifier stage.The MC amplifier circuit configuration consists of four High-Gm dual FETs per channel connected in parallel to the first stage differential circuit, receiving the differential by the next stage P-channel transistor, and combining a current mirror circuit to ensure high gain. The final stage emitter-follower circuit is a two stage Darlington connection with high current amplification.Both the MM and MC circuits use the same type of element for matching tone.It uses an NF-type equalizer that can simplify the circuit and is also advantageous in terms of S/N.The NF-type equalizer suffers from the problem of a high-pass rise in the corrected frequency response, but the E-03 solves this problem by determining the constant using computer simulation and realizes an extremely flat RIAA curve.In addition, the feedback circuit uses an AC/DC-separated feedback duo-beta circuit that is highly evaluated as an original circuit of Lux. In addition, the excellent RIAA deviation is realized by using a lot of high-precision, high-sound quality parts developed in Shinkai exclusively for E-03.In order to achieve pure signal transmission, the MM/MC equalizer is switched to the ground side at the output stage rather than at the input stage, so that the signal from the weak cartridge is input to the equalizer circuit without passing through the selector switch.In addition, the switch that selects the output signal to the amplifier short-circuits the input of the circuit side that is not selected by the relay, and the crosstalk performance is also examined. In addition, the short relay on the input prevents the adverse effect of the offset voltage on the cartridge when the power is turned on and realizes the demagnetization effect.The transformer used in the power supply unit is designed with strict measures against leakage flux from the design stage. The magnetic flux density is set at 9,000 gauss to suppress leakage flux generation itself. The core of the EI transformer is shielded with copper, and the transformer is placed in a double shield structure. The transformer is mounted in a mechanical floating mount system to prevent vibration.In addition, the secondary winding of the transformer consists of three windings that are independent of the Route 3 of the MM/MC / control circuit. After rectification, a regulator circuit is installed for each left and right channel to eliminate mutual interference between amplifiers and channels via the power supply.Non-interference construction is used for the internal construction. sections.title: LUXMAN E-06
sections.overview: In order to pursue quality thoroughly, we want to make the phono equalizer into an independent component. This is an old amplifier.The MC transformer is equipped with a hand-wound design MC transformer.This transformer was made by a designer who worked on the design and development of the output transformer for MB300. Characteristic checks and trial listening are repeated with the designer's own hand winding, and more than 100 kinds of trial production have been carried out. The wire is made of PC-OCC, and the wire diameter, core material, stacking method of the core and shielding method are thoroughly examined.The E-06 is equipped with a total of four dedicated transformers of two types with different boosting ratios, one for each L/R. In addition, the MC transformer input can be balanced by the concept that balanced transmission is effective only on delicate MC lines.Both the first and second stages of the CR-type equalizer circuit use a flat amplifier.In the E-06, the flat amplifier element has been fundamentally improved and the CR element has been carefully selected to realize the sound characteristic of the CR type.The volume circuit uses a 32-point altimemate attenuator.This attenuator was developed and designed for E-06 and C-06 by returning to the origin, and it consists of glass epoxy board, gold plated finish, non-magnetic resistance wiring, die-cast, shield case made of extruded material, etc.In the E-06, the L/R is adopted independently. Moreover, in order to obtain more natural volume change, it has a curve characteristic as a trim control that allows delicate adjustment of the output balance of the cartridge in 0.5 dB steps near the maximum output.In addition to the variable output, a direct output terminal is also provided.A flat amplifier is used for the input and output amplifiers of the equalizer circuit.These circuits handle signals with different phases before equalization and after equalization, so if this part is used as a common power supply, undesirable sound quality results may occur.For this reason, the E-06 employs a constant-voltage power supply suitable for each of the input amplifier and output amplifier in addition to the left and right separate transformers to improve sound quality.PC-OCC (single-crystal high-purity oxygen-free copper wire) is used as wiring material.In addition, we use parts that give priority to sound quality, such as a nitrogen gas sealed contact input switching relay with parallel contacts, a bus bar designed to reduce power source impedance, a first stage block with reinforced shield, a monolithic layout glass epoxy board with L/R separation shield, a non-magnetic chassis and a rigid wooden cabinet that eliminate the influence of noise and vibration on signals.It is equipped with a line-phase sensor that can detect the polarity of the AC power supply and improves sound quality by unifying the polarity of the total system.Since both the primary and secondary sides of the power transformer are strictly controlled for polarity, it is combined with the line phase sensor to obtain the effect of uniform polarity.

sections.overview: For pure reproduction of analog, this phono amplifier is thoroughly lavish and pursues uncompromising quality.It is equipped with a total of four transformers for MC, one for each L/R, which were originally developed for two types of MC with different boosting ratios. The transformers are arranged in a loose layout to avoid mutual interference and improve sound quality.This MC transformer was made by a designer who worked on many Luxman transformers. The MC transformer was completed after repeated characteristic checks and trial listening with the designer's own hand scrolls. The wire is made of PC-OCC, and the wire diameter, core material, method of stacking the cores, and shielding method are thoroughly examined.The equalizer circuit is a CR type equalizer circuit that uses a flat amplifier for the input amplifier and output amplifier.Because this method requires the quality and accuracy of CR parts, it has a more severe aspect than the NF type in terms of cost and SN ratio. n ratio. In order to solve this problem, the E-06   has completely removed factors that hinder sound quality by completely reviewing the circuit. In addition to fundamentally improving the flat amplifier circuit, we have adopted a carefully selected CR element.The power supply section consists of left and right separate transformers, and a constant voltage power supply circuit suitable for each of the pre-amplifier and post-amplifier is adopted.This prevents the deterioration of sound quality that occurs when a common power supply is used between the equalizing CR circuit and each flat amplifier that handles signals with different phases before and after the equalization CR circuit.PC-OCC is used as the wiring material, and high-purity 6N cables (purity 99.99997% Cu) are used at important points to ensure sound quality.Based on the judgment that off-the-shelf parts do not provide the desired sound quality, custom-made parts are used everywhere with a sense of luxury.In addition to the nitrogen gas sealed contact relay used in parallel for input switching, the bus bar to reduce the power source impedance, the first stage block with reinforced shield, the glass epoxy board with monolithic layout with L/R separation shield, non-magnetic chassis and rigid wooden cabinet to eliminate the influence of noise and vibration on the signal are adopted.

sections.title: LUXMAN LMC-1
sections.overview: MC type cartridge with unique power generation and support system.The LMC (Linear Magneto-field Cross) power generation mechanism is adopted for the power generation system. The unique structure realizes ultra-lightweight, high-efficiency and linear power generation. With this system, the total weight of the power generation system is reduced to 1/8 of the conventional system, and the power generation efficiency is 5 times higher.In the LMC power generation system, two ring-shaped samarium-cobalt dual magnets aligned coaxially with the direction of the cantilever generate an ideal magnetic field that is uniform in all directions at 360   around the cantilever without using a yoke. This allows the magnetic flux to be made perpendicular to the entire surface of the coil without loss, thus achieving both high efficiency and linearity.A 0.3   sapphire rod is used for the cantilever to realize high fidelity transmission.Natural diamond is used for the material of the stylus, and by making it a semi-line contact type with excellent tracing capability, elastic deformation of the record is minimized and traceability up to high frequencies up to 60 kHz is realized.It adopts a concentrated mounting structure with a unique block chassis support structure.In conventional MC cartridges with low power generation efficiency, the power generation system is heavy. Therefore, the monocoque structure, which is supported by the case itself without having a chassis to fix the power generation system, was used in order to achieve low mass. However, if a lightweight resin case is used with this method, harmful resonance occurs and coloring occurs in the reproduced sound. The LMC power generation system has succeeded in making the power generation system extremely light. Therefore, it is possible to have sufficient weight and strong structure for the support part. To solve this problem, a block chassis is formed using vibration-proof metal with excellent damping characteristics, and the entire vibration system is fixed in the axial (cantilever) direction. All other parts are also directly connected to the block chassis to form a centralized mounting structure.This block chassis is the only structure that fixes the vibration system with this structure, and the cover is not related to the support structure to prevent the coloring of sound caused by deformation and squeal.The LMC-1 uses an anti-vibration zinc alloy SPZ machined block chassis for this part.In the vibration system, the vibrator point is made clear by stainless steel wire with excellent linearity, and the damper load, which is non-linear operation, is reduced by linearly absorbing the needle pressure load.The mounting surface of the shell and is mirror finished to prevent resonance.

By this method, the magnetic flux can be made perpendicular to the entire surface of the coil without loss, thus achieving both high efficiency and linearity.The cantilever uses a titanium taper pipe.Natural diamond is used for the material of the stylus, and by making it a semi-line contact type with excellent tracing capability, elastic deformation of the record is minimized and traceability up to high frequencies up to 60 kHz is realized.It adopts a concentrated mounting structure with a unique block chassis support structure.In conventional MC cartridges with low power generation efficiency, the power generation system is heavy. Therefore, the monocoque structure was used to support the MC cartridge by the case itself without a chassis to fix it. However, if a lightweight resin case is used in this method, harmful resonance occurs and coloring occurs in the reproduced sound.With the LMC power generation system, we have succeeded in making the power generation system ultra-lightweight, making it possible to have sufficient weight and strong structure for the support part. To solve this problem, a block chassis is formed using a vibration-proof metal with excellent damping characteristics to fix the entire vibration system in the axial (cantilever) direction, and all other parts are connected directly to the block chassis in a centralized mounting structure.This block chassis is the only structure that fixes the vibration system with this structure. sections.overview: Line controller using a 23-step trans-type attenuator for level control.While general attenuators generally use the attenuation characteristics of resistors, the AT-3000 is equipped with a line signal transformer that is Shinkai generated for the attenuator in consideration of the influence of DC resistance components that enter the signal line in series on sound quality.By taking out 23 steps from the secondary winding of the transformer and switching each level with a high-precision rotary switch, resistors can be completely eliminated and direct current resistance is minimized.The TRANSFORMERS for the attenuator uses a multi-layered structure of 0.2 mm nickel super-permalloy based on numerous prototypes and listening tests. We have also introduced our unique know-how on how to take out the intermediate tap on the winding, and have realized a high-purity line signal transformer.For the mounting of the transformer, we have adopted an attachment made of maple based on the idea that it is magnetically hollow but mechanically firmly supported. This attachment has been carefully designed to unify the direction of the wood grain.In addition, in order to prevent induction from the outside, it has a double structure with a pure copper inner shield cabinet inside the main body chassis.It has a unique demagnetizer function that uses the energy of the music signal itself to demagnetize the core, thus keeping the attenuator transformer in good condition.Equipped with two coaxial outputs and one European standard XLR balanced output.For the pin terminal used for the coaxial output, a newly developed special part with excellent reliability and durability is used. The metal part is finished with brass machined copper base metal plating, and Teflon material is used for the insulation part, making it a high quality product.The XLR output is a floating type and a balanced connection may not be suitable for some models.Four input terminals and one direct input terminal are installed.A 6N high-purity copper material is used for the internal wiring, and not only the hot side of the signal line but also the ground circuit is switched. sections.title: LUXMAN 5F70
sections.overview: Tone control amplifier designed for the laboratory reference series.The 5F70 uses a newly developed DML-IC newly developed DML-IC at key points to provide perfect drift control without compromising the original sound quality.The basic configuration consists of a tone control circuit and an acoustic control circuit.The tone control circuit has a newly developed FET with low notching and high Gm (forward transfer admittance). Moreover, the differential amplifier circuit is composed of FET with well-balanced both units. The DC amplifier configuration is basically composed of FET with current mirror circuit, cascode circuit, constant current circuit, etc., and DC drift is prevented by effectively arranging DML-IC where DC gain exists.Both boost and cut tone control uses a CR-type circuit for both boost and cut. The high-range tone control uses an NF-type circuit for boost and a CR-type circuit for cut.The acoustic control circuit employs a twin T-type circuit to effectively eliminate harmful standing waves generated in the listening room. The function of the twin T-type circuit is completed by effectively arranging the buffer circuit.This buffer circuit consists of a differential amplifier circuit with newly developed FET, and is a DC amplifier structure with effective arrangement of current mirror circuit and constant current circuit.The tone control function enables fine tone control by setting the bending point frequency to four points in each of the low and high ranges.The acoustic control function consists of three components : the frequency control, which continuously changes the dip frequency from 75 hz to 150 hz, the attenuation control, which continuously changes the dip amount from 0 to -12dB, and the bandwidth control (Q can be continuously changed from about 1 to about 20), which can produce from steep dip characteristics to gentle dip characteristics. By operating these components, it is possible to effectively eliminate standing waves that adversely affect sound quality.It is equipped with a bypass switch to check the tone control effect.In the Laboratory Reference Series, in which legs are attached to the lower part and metal brackets are attached to the upper part, and these are supported by metal supports, so that when the product is stacked, an excessive load is not applied to the product lying below.In addition, the legs and brackets fit together perfectly so that they do not slip or fall over.As an optional part sold separately, there was a standard rack mounting bracket of EIA standard.

sections.overview: A pure electronic peak indicator that can display the peak output of the preamplifier as well as the peak output of the power amplifier.Peak output is displayed in 3-dB steps between + 3 dB and -30dB with 12 LEDs per channel.Compared with mechanical peak meters, this method provides a more accurate peak indication with no delay in indication. In addition to improving visibility by providing a certain amount of holding time, this method is designed so that music signals disappear sequentially from the LEDs indicating peaks so that they can be easily perceived visually.Equipped with a peak hold function, the maximum instantaneous peak level of the program source can be stopped with one LED and the current peak level can also be displayed continuously.With the function switch, you can select the peak output display of the power amplifier and the output display of the preamplifier, as well as the respective display sensitivities.The circuit configuration consists of a full-wave rectifying circuit to detect all signals thoroughly, a peak detection circuit with a certain holding time so that the peak value of the signal can be seen easily, a comparator to turn on 12 LEDs per channel at an appropriate level, a flip-flop circuit to see the peak value simultaneously while holding the peak value, and a logic circuit.High-performance operational amplifier ICs and digital ICs are used for comparators, flip-flop circuits and logic circuits.In the Laboratory Reference Series, in which legs are attached to the lower part and metal brackets are attached to the upper part, and these are supported by metal supports, so that when the product is stacked, an excessive load is not applied to the product lying below.In addition, the legs and brackets fit together perfectly so that they do not slip or fall over.As an optional part sold separately, there was a standard rack mounting bracket of EIA standard.

sections.title: LUXMAN FL153
sections.overview: A multi-channel divider that makes FL15 more versatile and replaces it with a transistor.There are four crossover points, two channel and three channel multi-amp systems, and a mixing circuit for 3D.It is based on an emitter-follower NF demultiplexing circuit with a cutoff characteristic of 12dB/oc. It also operates as an RC1-stage demultiplexing circuit by switching the cutoff characteristic selector switch to the 6dB/oct position.For the lowest-efficiency woofer unit, a 2-stage NF amplifier circuit with a low-frequency gain of approximately 13 dB is mounted after the level set volume.In addition, the emitter-follower circuit is inserted after the level set for the mid - and high-frequency ranges to keep the output impedance low and prevent degradation and noise induction in the high-frequency range due to the shield line connecting the divider and power amplifier.The horn-type unit, which is vulnerable to excessive input, may be damaged if it is switched during a performance due to input signals outside the band of the speaker unit.In order to prevent this, a special mechanism is used for the knob mechanism. When it is turned normally, it only turns idle. When this switch is changed, it is turned while pulling the knob toward you.The level set volume is semi-fixed and is capped so that the optimum level position cannot be moved.

sections.title: LUXMAN 5L15
sections.overview: DC configuration pre-main amplifier of the laboratory reference series.The 5L15 incorporates the equalizer circuit of the preamp 5C50 into the power amplifier 5M21 of the Laboratory Reference Series.The 5L15 consists of an equalizer consists of an equalizer circuit and a power amplifier circuit. It employs a DC amplifier configuration to faithfully amplify all program sources, thereby eliminating phase distortion in the low range and transient distortion in the high range.5L15 solves the problem of DC-drift due to changes in temperature and other external conditions. This problem is solved by installing a DML-IC (Dual Monolithical Linear-Integrated Circuit), which contains a newly developed FET-based differential-amplifier circuit, a supplementary cascode circuit, current mirror circuit, constant current circuit, and other circuits.In order to eliminate the notching distortion that is a problem in power amplifiers, the elements used in the output stage have been studied and the switching speed of the driver stage has been improved in a circuit manner. Thus, the level of notching distortion is higher than that of A-class operation in spite of AB-class operation.The cascode circuit, current mirror circuit, emitter follower circuit, constant current drive circuit, etc. are arranged in the right place in order to make all circuits show the maximum power, which is useful for improving basic performance and preventing DC drift.It is designed with the minimum necessary functions, and all sound adjustment functions such as tone control are omitted.It is equipped with a large power meter of independent right and left channels which displays average output at 8   load in W.This meter is equipped with a range switching function.Equipped with a DC offset sensor, it can check DC component is input from the outside.In addition, it is equipped with an input capacitor IN/OUT switching function so that when a DC component appears at the output terminal, it can be cut off at the main input.It is equipped with a preset attenuator, two types of tape monitor function, and a tape dubbing function.As a protection circuit, a DC drift detection circuit and an excess input detection circuit that work to protect the speaker when a DC voltage of   2.5 v or more appears at the output terminal or when an excess input is input, and an eddy current prevention circuit that prevents the power transistor from being damaged by an eddy current when a short circuit occurs at the speaker terminal or the terminal of the speaker system.In the Laboratory Reference Series, in which legs are attached to the lower part and metal brackets are attached to the upper part, and these are supported by metal supports, so that when the product is stacked, an excessive load is not applied to the product lying below.In addition, the legs and brackets fit together perfectly so that they do not slip or fall over.As an optional part sold separately, there was a standard rack mounting bracket of EIA standard.

sections.title: LUXMAN L-3
sections.overview: A pre-main amplifier with low output and low sound quality.The power amplifier uses a pure complimentary service OCL system. In addition, the power transistor and other devices themselves are carefully selected and used, especially those with high high-frequency cutoff characteristics and low collector capacitance. The operating point is set in the part with good linearity of each transistor to improve the distortion factor characteristics over the entire band.The equalizer circuit, flat amplifier circuit and tone amplifier circuit of the pre-amplifier section use a two stage direct connection system. By increasing the current supplied to each circuit, low impedance is achieved and high-frequency characteristics are improved.In addition, the circuit is constructed by carefully selecting ultra-low-noise transistors, and by driving with a negative power supply, the SN ratio is improved.In order to minimize the distance of each input system and to eliminate shield wires, an input terminal board is provided at the bottom.In addition, the signal path has been simplified for flatter characteristics and higher S / N ratio.It is equipped with functions such as LUX type NF tone control, monitoring and dubbing function with two tape decks, high and low filters, and loudness control.There were 2 types of L-3, the silver type L-3 and the black type L-3B.

sections.title: LUXMAN L-5
sections.overview: This pre-main amplifier was developed in pursuit of quality in every aspect including performance, mechanism, function and design.The power amplifier section uses a DC amplifier configuration without the time constant circuit in the NFB loop, which is one of the causes of deterioration of the transient response. In addition, the problem of drift due to fluctuations in external conditions such as power supply voltage and temperature is minimized to a negligible level by taking electrical and mechanical measures at each major point.The power transistor is carefully selected to have high breakdown strength and high cut-off frequency, the driver transistor is EBT (ballast and transistor), and the pre-driver stage is driven by constant voltage and current to achieve stable high-pass characteristics with less notching distortion.The preamp section consists of a 3-stage directly connected equalizer circuit, a 2-stage directly connected flat amplifier circuit, and a 2-stage directly connected tone amplifier circuit.Furthermore, in order to further reduce the distortion factor and increase the S / N ratio, we conducted a fundamental review of the circuit and carefully selected ultra-low-noise transistors with a wide linear region, high high-cut-off frequency, and low collector output capacity. These transistors are driven by a negative power supply, and a large amount of current is passed through each circuit to achieve low impedance.A large toroidal power transformer is used for the power supply section.In addition, the preamplifier section, pre-drive stage, and power stage are separated to improve power supply efficiency and distortion factor characteristics.The input terminal board is provided at the bottom to improve performance by shortening the distance from each input terminal to the amplifier circuit and actively eliminating the shield wire.The tone control is LUX type NF. In addition, the curve point frequency is switched at two points, one for high frequency and the other for low frequency. This tone control can also be lost.Other features include a subsonic, low-cut and high-cut filter circuit, a monitor and dubbing function, a speaker selector, a loudness control, and a -20dB audio attenuator.The preamplifier section and power amplifier section can be used separately.There were 2 types of L-5, the silver type L-5 and the black type L-5B.

sections.title: LUXMAN L-10
sections.overview: This thin integrated amplifier was developed in pursuit of high density as an amplifier.All circuits use DC amplifier configuration to achieve more faithful amplification of music signals.In addition, a newly developed DML-IC is adopted to cope with the drift of DC component caused by changes in external conditions such as temperature.For amplifiers with L-10 class output, it is common to construct a push-pull output circuit with two TO-3 type power transistors. The L-10 uses a parallel push-pull connection with four TO-66 type power transistors for its output stage, which has a particularly fast switching speed.In this method, since the current per transistor can be set small, good operation with high frequency characteristics can be maintained, linearity against current can be improved, and Pc (collector loss) can be increased.In addition, the output stage is designed for class AB operation to eliminate notch distortion in the power amplifier.In order to improve the crosstalk characteristics and overall distortion factor, wires used for large currents such as speaker wires are arranged at the shortest distance and do not cross between left and right wires.For this reason, the power supply section is equipped with a low-leakage, high-efficiency toroidal power transformer for the left and right channels separately, and is combined with a small, high-capacity, low-impedance, improved sound quality electrolytic capacitor (6,800 ? Fx4) to create a substantial left and right independent power supply section.The power amplifier circuit board also has separate left and right channels, and the muting circuit relay and speaker terminals are independent on the left and right.By eliminating the speaker switch, the sound quality degradation due to the extra contact currency is prevented.There is one phono connector, which is directly connected to the equalizer section.This prevents the high impedance of the MM cartridge in the high frequency range and the deterioration of the crosstalk characteristics at the switch part.Equipped with a tone compensator.This circuit does not use any active elements and is designed so that the specified characteristic curve can be obtained from the position where the volume volume is reduced by 6 dB from the maximum position, because the characteristics of the human ear do not require correction at high volume and correction is only necessary at low volume.There is a 3-point bending point switch for both low and high frequencies, and the level control adjusts the range from + 2 dB to 2.5 dB at the normal rotation angle of the volume.New volume is used for volume adjustment.This volume is based on, and further developed from, the thitent-type volume. The volume can be adjusted continuously and smoothly. Moreover, the linking error between the left and right channels can be adjusted in a wide range of 0 dB to -80dB with less than 1/2 error.

sections.title: LUXMAN L-45A
sections.overview: Stereo pre-main amplifier with duo-beta circuit.Appropriate amount Equipped with a duo-beta circuit combining NFB and DC servo.Low distortion is achieved by improving the bare characteristics of the amplifier circuit and applying an appropriate amount of NFB. In addition, DC servo realizes low frequency reproduction with damping. In addition to suppressing DC drift, it eliminates 1/f noise, flicker noise, and other ultra-low frequency noise, and eliminates low frequency distortion during speaker driving.A highly stable discrete configuration equalizer and power amplifier completely eliminates capacitors from the signal path from the cartridge to the speakers.In particular, the equalizer, which requires high gain, is equipped with a newly developed FET input operational amplifier to enhance the servo effect in the DC region and eliminate drift.Not only MM cartridges but also MC cartridges can be directly connected to the equalizer.The amplifier circuit of the equalizer uses a cascode-connected FET differential amplifier for the input and a class A single-ended push-pull amplifier for the output. As a result, bare characteristics superior to conventional amplifier circuits by more than one digit are obtained.(In the case of the MC-2 position, the input sensitivity is 0.28 mv and most MC cartridges can be connected, but the use of the high impedance type is recommended.)It is equipped with phono straight function which makes the DISC playback system completely independent.When the phono straights are turned on, the input selector, recording output, balance volume, etc. are disconnected, only the DISC playback system is completely independent, and the influence of wiring and load is minimized.The tone control is incorporated into the NFB loop of the power amplifier to simplify the signal path.As a result, not only is the signal path simplified, but because the structure is composed of only passive elements such as resistors and capacitors, simple change characteristics without deterioration of the SN ratio are obtained.A high-speed switching transistor with high ft (high-frequency cut-off characteristics) and low Cob (collector output capacitance) is used for the base power amplifier section for both the output stage and the driver stage.The power supply section incorporates the characteristics of a general constant voltage circuit and a power supply circuit without feedback (stability in the DC range, excellent low-frequency braking force, sound elongation in the audible band, ability to reproduce the feeling of atmosphere, etc.), and also employs a circuit that eliminates the defects.The basic configuration is based on a powerful, low-impedance power supply with a large transformer and a large capacitor. In the audible band, this power supply takes advantage of its characteristics and provides feedback from the low band to the DC range to enhance stability and braking force.

sections.overview: Stereo pre-main amplifier with duo-beta circuit.LUX's unique duo-beta circuit is used for the equalizer amplifier and power amplifier.The duo-beta circuit consists of an appropriate amount of NFB and DC servo. First of all, the TIM distortion is reduced by applying an appropriate amount of NFB based on an amplifier circuit with excellent bare characteristics. This contributes to the reproduction of sound quality and atmosphere in the middle and high frequency range. The DC servo solves the problem of intermodulation distortion and DC drift due to harmful ultra-low frequency components, and at the same time achieves excellent speaker braking effect.The duo-beta circuit realizes high gain of the equalizer, and not only MM cartridge but also MC cartridge can be directly connected to the equalizer.The circuit is composed of a cascode differential input first stage circuit with bootstrap by low-noise FET and an output stage adopting A-class single-ended push-pull circuit, making it an excellent configuration with bare characteristics.In addition, because the gain of the equalizer itself is high, we have succeeded in eliminating flat amplifiers that cause poor sound quality.(The input sensitivity of the MC input terminal is 0.3 mV and most MC cartridges can be connected. However, it is recommended to use high-impedance type cartridges as much as possible.)For the output stage, a large power transistor with high ft (high cutoff frequency) and low Cob (collector output capacitance) is carefully selected and used. The driver circuit is also high-speed to eliminate switching distortion.In addition, a newly developed loop heat pipe has been adopted to increase the heat radiation effect.A line-and-straight configuration is adopted, and the configuration in which the MC equalizer and the power amplifier are directly connected enables faithful transmission.LUX type NF tone control is used for the tone control.The turnover frequency can be switched to two levels in each high and low range, and complete bypass is also possible by setting it to the defeat position.Equipped with 10-element left and right independent indicators that display peak power in real time.It uses a watt display that can read the output directly, and it can be turned off with a switch when it is not necessary.Equipped with 2 types of tape monitor, dubbing switch, subsonic filter and high-cut filter.

sections.overview: Stereo pre-main amplifier with duo-beta-plus-X circuit.The duo-beta circuit developed as a crystal of NFB technology is used for all stages of the amplifier.The duo-beta circuit is designed to set two NFBs on the assumption that it is an amplifier with excellent naked characteristics that does not require NFB. sections.title: LUXMAN L-58A
sections.overview: This is a pre-main amplifier with an original duo-beta circuit that not only improves the characteristics but also improves the quality of the amplifier to improve sound quality.Duo Beta Circuit means a circuit that combines two NFBs.This circuit does not attempt to improve various characteristics of the amplifier by investing a large amount of NFB. Instead, various characteristics are improved by creating an amplifier with good quality (bare characteristics) and combining it with a small amount of NFB and DC servo.In the power amplifier section, a pure complimentary service differential push-pull circuit using FETs for N-channel 2SK163 and P-channel (2SJ44) is adopted at the input stage to improve bare strain characteristics as a DC-amplifier configuration.In addition, everything from the input stage to the output stage is composed of a push-pull circuit, and at the same time, a transistor and FET with high ft (high cutoff frequency) and low Cob (collector output capacitance) are adopted to reduce distortion.The output stage employs MOS FETs (2SK134 and 2SJ49) with an ft of approximately 500 MHz. In addition to allowing a bias current of 300 mA or more, a high-speed driver circuit is combined to create a "notchless class A" amplifier that does not perform switching operation.In addition, the open-loop gain (bare gain) has been reduced and bare frequency characteristics have been improved by one order of magnitude through the use of an element with excellent high-frequency characteristics and a circuit device such as a local NFB.As a result, the bare distortion factor of the power amplifier has been improved to 0.4% (from 2-5% in the conventional model) and the slew rate to 300 v / ? sec (from 10 v / ? sec in the conventional model).The equalizer uses a cascode input bootstrap circuit with four FETs at the input stage, combined with a dynamic resistance circuit with transistors to reduce bare strain.In addition, in order to keep the output impedance as low as possible, a SEPP circuit (single ended push-pull circuit) with four transistors is adopted to reduce bare strain.As a result, the bare distortion factor of the preamplifier (equalizer stage) has been improved to 0.2% (previously 2-5%) and the slew rate to 150 V / ? sec (previously 10 V / ? sec).At the Duo Beta Circuit, TIM distortion is reduced by applying NFB, which is reduced to less than one hundredth of that of conventional amplifiers, to the amplifier circuit with improved bare characteristics, thereby improving sound quality in the middle and high range.The duo-beta circuit uses a unique DC servo circuit to prevent cross-modulation distortion and SN ratio degradation due to tight low-frequency playback, reduced damping factor caused by reduced NFB, cone excursion of speakers, etc.This DC servo circuit is combined in parallel with a small-volume NFB circuit and uses a low-noise FET amplifier, so a high-quality film capacitor can be used for the filter circuit, enabling tight low-frequency reproduction.In order to give priority to sound quality, the head amplifier for MC uses a DC amplifier configuration in which FETs are connected in parallel instead of connecting many input FETs.N-channel FETs with excellent noise characteristics are connected in parallel, and a constant-current circuit is combined to create a DC amplifier configuration with particularly improved high-frequency characteristics. As a result, there is a slight disadvantage in the SN ratio. However, we have solved this problem by adopting an automatic gain adjustment method that automatically adjusts the amplification factor when the impedance of the connected MC cartridge changes.A buffer amplifier is provided in front of the tone control circuit to prevent the tone control circuit from being affected by other circuits. This eliminates the flat amplifier that causes the sound quality degradation, and the power amplifier circuit covers the insufficient amplification.For the buffer circuit and tone control circuit, a cascode-connected source follower circuit with FET input is used, and for the tone control circuit, LUX system NF type with bending point switching which is easy to change characteristic is adopted.In addition, these circuits can be bypassed when tone control is not required.In the power supply circuit of the power section, high-frequency characteristics have been improved by adopting a high-capacity block and condenser for sound quality and by combining a film condenser in parallel.The constant voltage power supply for the preamplifier section employs a power transistor with a fast switching speed to sufficiently reduce the circuit impedance.In addition, a constant voltage power supply is used for the pre-driver stage of the power amplifier section to stabilize operation.In order to minimize interference between the metal chassis inside the amplifier and the wiring circuit, the chassis corresponding to the printed circuit board is hollowed out.In addition, the cabinet is a wooden box made of real wood, and the shielding of the box is limited to the minimum necessary level, and ultra-thin aluminum foil is used to completely eliminate eddy current distortion.
