sections.title: LUXMAN L-68A
sections.overview: Duo Beta plus-X pre-main amplifier that combines a duo beta circuit with a newly developed plus-X power supply.The duo-Beta circuit is used to realize a superior amplifier by taking advantage of the advantages of NFB and preventing TIM distortion due to excess NFB.By adding an appropriate amount of NFB and DC servo to the amplifier circuit that realizes a practical level even with bare characteristics, excellent medium and high frequency and tight low frequency reproduction are realized, and harmful 1/f noise and flicker noise are removed.The power supply section uses a common feedback circuit (which feeds back changes in the output voltage and keeps it constant) and a plus-X power supply that has the advantages of an unstabilized power supply and eliminates its disadvantages.The conventional stabilized power supply consists of a feedback circuit and uses a large amount of feedback, whereas the plus-X regulator uses an appropriate amount of feedback and has frequency characteristics.As a result, it is possible to realize a low-frequency band with good reproducibility and damping by avoiding excessive feedback in the audible band and making use of the bare characteristics of the power supply itself (optimum error-amplifier), and by controlling frequencies to improve stability and controlling force by providing strong feedback only in the low-frequency band.In order to realize a plus-X regulator, we are improving the bare characteristics of the power supply section.The transformer employs a large power transformer that makes full use of Lux's transformer technology. The winding diameter is large to prevent power loss. In addition, an audio block capacitor (15,000 ? Fx2) is used in the smoothing circuit to create a power circuit with excellent bare characteristics.In addition, the polarity is unified by aligning the winding direction of the power transformer on both the primary and secondary sides, and the polarity of all non-polar capacitors used in the power supply circuit is also unified.All stages use push-pull circuit with excellent linearity for the power stage.In addition to the pure complimentary service differential push-pull input stage using FET with the same characteristics of P channel and N channel, all stages use high-ft (high-cutoff frequencies) and low-Cob (collector-output capacitance) transistors and FET for push-pull. The distortion factor in bare characteristics has been reduced to 1/5 to 1/10 of conventional ones, and the frequency characteristics have been improved by approximately 10 times.The output stage employs a power MOS FET that does not generate switching distortion in principle.Power MOS FETs have characteristics such as no carrier accumulation effect (which contributes to switching distortion) that cannot be avoided in bipolar transistors and no phase shift. They also boast excellent high-frequency characteristics and linearity. They also have excellent characteristics as power amplifying devices, such as high gain, simplified drive stages, and excellent stability.In the L-68A, a large amount of idle current is supplied to the power MOS FET to set the optimum operating condition, and ultra-high-speed transistors are also used in the driver stage to be combined, completing the amplifier circuit that does not generate switching distortion.Duo-beta circuit is also used for the equalizer circuit.The circuit configuration employs a cascode-connected bootstrap differential current mirror input stage with a carefully selected low-noise FET. It is driven with a constant current to improve SVRR (ripple rejection ratio) and has a structure excellent in CMRR (in-phase suppression ratio). In addition, a constant current load cascode amplifier is connected and a shunt circuit is provided to suppress gain.In the output stage, a single-ended push-pull circuit with A-class operation is adopted to obtain high stability as well as low distortion and low output impedance.As a result, the distortion factor in bare characteristics has been reduced to 1/5 to 1/10 of the conventional one, and the frequency characteristics have also been realized with about 10 times the bandwidth. As a finishing touch, the duo-beta circuit realizes excellent sound quality.The MC head amplifier section uses a DC amplifier configuration with N-channel FET parallel connection.In addition, by installing an impedance switch, the optimum load condition of the MC cartridge can be selected and the gain is automatically adjusted.For tone control, LUX system NF type with turn-over frequency switching circuit is adopted with smooth changing characteristics and no waviness.In addition, an independent configuration is adopted in which the front stage of this tone control is used as an FET cascode input buffer. When it is not necessary, it can be completely separated from the signal path by the tone bypass switch.By controlling the polarity of film capacitors one by one and applying bias, even foil vibration is eliminated completely, and clear sound quality without coloring is achieved.In order to minimize the influence of the metal chassis on the circuit, the chassis corresponding to the circuit board is hollowed out, and overcurrent distortion is completely eliminated by using a natural plated rosewood cabinet with minimal aluminum shielding.Equipped with a phono straight function, functions not required for disk playback can be disconnected from the wiring.Equipped with a line-phase sensor, you can check the polarity of the AC power supply.

sections.title: LUXMAN L-308
sections.overview:
108,000 (released in June 1973)  120,000 (around 1974)

Integrated amplifier with almost the same configuration as the L-309.The difference from the L-309 is only the output and microphone circuit, and the appearance is almost the same.The main amplifier uses a 2-power supply system and all stages are directly connected without the capacitor. The complimentary service stage uses a pure power configuration combining PNP type power transistor (2SA680) and NPN type power transistor (2SC1080).The driver stage is composed of two differential amplification stages, and a circuit is devised to reduce crossover distortion.The preamplifier section uses a 3-stage direct-coupled equalizer circuit with ultra-low-noise silicon transistors of NPN type (2SC1222) for the first stage, PNP type (2SA640) for the second stage, and NPN type (2SC1222) for the third stage. This circuit has high power utilization and excellent linearity.The transient characteristics are also improved by applying sufficient DC feedback to this circuit.A linear equalizer circuit is installed in the intermediate amplifier section after the equalizer circuit.This circuit is a kind of tone control circuit that can provide two kinds of linear characteristics over the whole band around 1 kHz without affecting the recording output. It can compensate for deviations from the standard RIAA curve over a wide band or unbalanced sources that cannot be easily compensated by conventional tone control.The tone control circuit uses the LUX system NF type, which has a simple change characteristic, electrical midpoint, and no waviness in the frequency characteristic. sections.overview: This is a pre-main amplifier designed to simplify the signal flow by eliminating the need for a phono equalizer and simplifying the internal layout in order to achieve high quality CD playback.By eliminating the speaker selector switch and even the headphone port, it has been completely simplified to achieve pure musical reproduction.The power amplifier consists of a duo-beta circuit with a single-stage amplifier circuit of pure complimentary service directly connected to all stages.By segmenting the return current in the circuit and clarifying the reference point of operation, the transparency of each sound is ensured.In the current amplifier stage, a 3-stage Darlington connection is adopted in order to increase the driving capability at low impedance load.In the final stage, a 150W-class power transistor is used in parallel push-pull, and in the pre-driver stage, a constant-voltage power supply is inserted separately for the left and right sides, for a luxurious configuration.The power supply section is equipped with a large transformer equivalent to 340 VA to realize high drive performance with low impedance.Separate windings are used for the main amplifier circuit, power amplifier pre-driver circuit, pre-amplifier circuit and accessory circuit. The separate supply for each circuit with different characteristics prevents interference between circuits.In addition, the main winding is separated into left and right after rectification, and the power supply impedance is lowered by four block capacitors, and the instantaneous power supply capability is enhanced to support low impedance driving capability.The volume is equipped with a 32-contact rotary switch type Ultimate attenuator which was originally developed.By mounting a non-magnetic resistor on a gold-plated, patterned glass epoxy substrate and shielding it with die-cast and extruded materials, we are working to improve quality in all aspects.Measures have been taken against various types of noise that can interfere with music.The S/N ratio is improved by eliminating noise from outside the set with a line noise filter, eliminating noise sources inside the amplifier, and taking measures against high-frequency noise.For high-purity music playback, thorough measures against resonance are taken.The L-500 uses a center trans configuration to increase the strength of the entire system, and achieves an excellent vibration mode by distributing the weight equally to the left and right.In addition, the power section is completely symmetrical, and each circuit part is shielded to eliminate vibration and mutual interference, and leakage flux is also well protected.In addition, the effect of external and internal vibrations is suppressed by the adoption of a large capacity FRP bottom chassis with a thorough vibration isolation structure.Custom parts such as electrolytic capacitors and copper styrofoam capacitors are used everywhere.A tone compensator is installed as a tone correction circuit.Natural phase correction can be performed over the entire band.It is equipped with a line phase sensor that can manage power supply polarity.

However, when a DC servo amplifier is inserted into the feedback loop, different processes are introduced only in the DC region, which causes different tone colors for each band.The L-501s reduces dependence on the compensation circuit by improving the bare characteristics of the circuit. It achieves circuit stability and uniform sound quality over the entire reproduction band without using a DC servo amplifier, while feeding back the DC and AC regions separately.LUX STAR circuit is adopted, and power supply line and ground line in the circuit are not shared. Each line is connected directly from the reference point to each block and signal path to form an independent loop.This eliminates the factors that cause fluctuations in the amplification reference point due to interference between circuits and changes in signal current, thereby achieving cleaner music playback.The speaker terminal is equipped with two systems for bi-wiring connection.In addition, it uses a vise screw type that firmly holds the cable, and it is also compatible with banana plugs.It has a dedicated input for MM and a built-in phono amplifier.Motor drive system is adopted for volume and input selector.It is equipped with functions such as loudness, subsonic filter, blade less control, mono switch and tone control.It also has a straight-through switch that simplifies the signal path and provides more pure sound quality.Equipped with a phase inverter, phase switching of the balance line (XLR) input is possible.Equipped with a line phase sensor, polarity can be managed.The headphone terminal has a dedicated relay contact for the headphone, and a headphone circuit different from the output to the speaker terminal is provided.It comes with a remote control that enables basic operations such as power switch, input selector, volume control and muting.The system is also equipped with a bus line that links the LUXMAN CD-Player and remote control operations, improving the overall operability of the system.

sections.overview: This is a pre-main amplifier with improved cost performance while applying Luxman's technology.CSSC (Complementary Single Stagger Circuit) circuit is adopted for the amplifier section.This circuit is roughly divided into three parts. From the input side, the complimentary service amplifier, the second stage current transmission stage, and the last stage output circuit. The differential amplifier gains the inherent gain of the amplifier circuit. The current transmission stage uses a common-base transistor circuit that is used in high-frequency circuits that require high fT (cutoff frequency) transmission. The output circuit amplifies power.Many general amplifiers have amplification functions in the first and second stages. Since the cut-off frequencies of the first and second stages are approximate values, there is a large phase shift in the ultra-high frequency range as a total characteristic. Therefore, analog information from the output is inverted and returned to the input using NFB. This structure improves electrical characteristics. However, when a large phase shift occurs, the feedback becomes close to positive, and positive feedback oscillation or similar unstable state occurs. In order to avoid this, another local feedback loop is used as a complementary loop. However, this high-frequency correction loop itself greatly affects sound quality and causes a loss of natural feeling of sound.In the CSSC circuit, the cut-off frequency in the high-frequency range is extremely high in the second stage common-base type current transmission stage. Therefore, it can be said that the frequency characteristics of the first stage differential amplifier control almost the entire CSSC. Stable operation can be ensured with minimal correction, and high-through rate is achieved.It is equipped with LUX's unique OD ? circuit.The OD ? circuit is the ? circuit (NFB) of the amplifier, to which LUX added its own ingenuity. In a general amplifier, the NFB is fed separately in the direct current and AC regions. However, by inserting a DC servo amplifier into the feedback loop in order to ensure stability in the DC region, a difference in balance with the AC region was caused. In the OD ? circuit, excellent DC stability is ensured only by basic DC feedback without incorporating a DC servo amplifier by refining the bare characteristics of the circuit to a high degree. In addition, the NFB in the AC region has been optimized to adjust the energy balance in all bands and achieve a sense of uniformity in tone quality in all frequency bands.The power amplifier has a 3-stage Darlington configuration and uses a complimentary service circuit with low internal impedance, high current, and high fT type power transistors (Pc150W, Ic (max) 15A).In addition, stability is enhanced by using parts such as a large heat sink, high-voltage driver transistors with excellent hfe linearity, and dual transistors for differential amplification.The power supply section is equipped with a large high-efficiency EI core power transformer and a large capacity electrolytic capacitor.It comes with a wireless remote control for power on / off, input selection, volume control, muting on / off, etc.A motor drive volume is used for the volume control, and the input switch is also a motor drive type. This input switch gives a clear click feeling to the step for each position when operating on the amplifier panel. When operating the remote control, the clutch mechanism allows the remote control to rotate smoothly without clicking.The internal layout uses a partition structure to reduce interference noise and distortion by separating circuits such as the preamplifier, power amplifier, input / output terminal, power supply input, and speaker output.The interior uses LUX's own custom parts to improve the sound quality.The speaker terminal is a large terminal that can be attached to a banana plug.The speaker output is equipped with a large, highly reliable speaker relay and an independent headphone relay.We have also achieved low impedance by introducing bus bars.It has phono inputs for MM, four line inputs and one balance input.Two input / output terminals for recording are provided.It includes tone control, loudness and subsonic filter, balance control, recording selector, and mode selector.It is also equipped with a line straighter function, which can provide high quality sound by bypassing unused circuits (tone control, mode selector, left / right balance).An inverted switch is mounted, and the phase of the balance line input can be inverted.Equipped with line phase sensor, polarity can be checked when power plug is inserted.Custom type power cable and AC inlet are adopted.It is equipped with a bus line that links remote control operations of LUXMAN CD players.

sections.title: LUXMAN L-504
sections.overview: A pre-main amplifier announced as a successor to the SQ-505 model.The main amplifier section is designed to eliminate as much as possible the crossover distortion that is difficult to remove with a class B push-pull amplifier, especially the notching distortion in the high frequency range.The class B driver stage uses PNP and NPN type transistors with excellent high-frequency characteristics, and the power stage uses pure complimentary service power transistors developed for LUX with excellent breakdown resistance without loss of high-frequency characteristics.The pre-driver stage employs a differential amplifier circuit driven by constant current and is driven by a constant current from no signal to maximum output to keep the class B operation stage stable and minimize notching distortion. The transistors in this stage have a high cutoff frequency (ft) and a low collector output capacitance (Cob). The distortion factor in the high frequency range is almost the same as 1 kHz over all outputs.The transistors used in the main amplifier are all can-type to ensure moisture resistance, durability and high reliability.The tone control circuit uses LUX system NF type with simple variable characteristics. Mechanically, it is equipped with high / low level adjustment with click stop, high / low bending point frequency switching by 2 points, and independent tone defeat switch.The equalizer circuit is a 3-stage direct-coupled circuit consisting of NPN, PNP, and NPN ultra-low-noise transistors with excellent voltage utilization factor. Excellent linearity and high signal-to-noise ratio are obtained. Excellent strain values are obtained by using transistors with high current amplification factor (hfe) and good linearity.DC feedback is sufficiently applied to this circuit to improve DC stability, and deviation from the RIAA curve is kept within   0.5 dB by reducing the tolerance of the parts used to minimize variation.The capacitors used in the input and output circuits are carefully selected from among the Meiler type and tantalum type capacitors with low leakage current, thereby minimizing the unpleasant shock noise when switching the switches.Two 6800 ? F electrolytic capacitors are used in the filter circuit of the power supply section. In combination with a well-regulated power transformer, a stable power supply is realized.As a countermeasure against shock noise when the power is turned on or off, a muting circuit is provided to separate the speaker circuit when the power switch is turned on or off. sections.title: LUXMAN L-505V
sections.overview: This pre-main amplifier is one of the V Series products and is the fifth generation from the SQ505 released in 1968.The circuit quality has been improved by introducing technology developed for the power amplifier M-6000 and the control amplifier C-1000.The main amplifier section uses a pure complimentary service OCL system directly connected to all stages of 2-stage differential-amplification with two positive and negative power supplies.Like the M-6000, the emitter follower circuit is installed after the pre-driver stage to improve the load condition in the high-frequency range of the pre-driver stage and to obtain excellent distortion factor characteristics. This emitter follower circuit electrically insulates the pre-driver stage for class B operation from the output stage for class A operation, and prevents the pre-driver stage from receiving impedance changes caused by the speaker load.The equalizer circuit of the preamp section combines carefully selected operational amplifier ICs with the output stage of a class A inverted Darlington push-pull circuit applied with high voltage to obtain excellent distortion factor characteristics as well as excellent input resistance characteristics.The intermediate amplifier circuit is a 2-stage direct connection type combining NPN-PNP transistors, and the tone control circuit is a LUX system NF type. F are used for the filter circuit of the power supply section, which is combined with a well-regulated power transformer to supply a stable power supply.

sections.title: LUXMAN L-505SII
sections.overview: As an improved version of the L-505s, this pre-main amplifier incorporates the circuit technology and parts of the L-509s.The power amplifier section uses Pc150W class large-capacity transistors, high-voltage transistors, and dual transistors for differential amplification. Thus, the output is increased while the size of each element is increased.CSSC (Complementary Single Stagger Circuit) with ultra-wide bandwidth and high-slew rate characteristics is adopted as circuit technology.This circuit has a complimentary service configuration. The cut-off frequency can be set extremely high by switching on a grounded base type current transmission stage in the second stage. This ensures the bandwidth of the entire amplifier only by phase rotation in the first stage. As a result, the initial slew rate can be set extremely high and natural sound quality is achieved without any extra correction.Uses LUX's unique OD ? circuit.A general amplifier uses the NFB method, in which DC and AC feedback are used separately. A servo amplifier that controls DC feedback, which has a large effect on the low-frequency range, is used to provide a large amount of NFB, thereby creating a sense of inconsistency between the tones of the mid-range and low-frequency ranges.In the OD ? circuit, the DC servo amplifier is eliminated by improving the bare characteristics of the circuit, and the sound quality is unified over the entire band.A large capacity EI core power transformer is used for the power supply.In addition, the microcomputer circuit that controls the remote control is equipped with a dedicated transformer, which is completely separated from the audio circuit to prevent noise from entering through the loop of the power supply circuit.Uses newly developed ultra-low noise custom resistor used in L-509s, C-10II and B-10II.This resistor is based on a carbon film resistor with excellent acoustic characteristics. sections.title: LUXMAN L-505F
sections.overview: The pre-main amplifier of the f series was developed by completely reviewing the circuit structure and design of the existing integrated series.The power amplifier section is equipped with the ODNF circuit that is also used for M-7f/C-7f.In order to realize this circuit, we first developed and adopted an ultra-wide-band, high-slew rate, low-distortion circuit that does not require phase correction for the amplification circuit of the music signal. Phase correction, which cannot be avoided with conventional negative feedback circuits, is eliminated.We also pay attention to the nature of NFB itself. We pick up only the distortion component from the output and feed it back to the final stage of the amplifier circuit so as to cancel it. This removes only the distortion component from the output waveform. By separating the NFB from the music signal, we have achieved a high initial slew rate and ultra-wide bandwidth that rise instantaneously. In addition, by eliminating the DC servo amplifier for ultra-low frequency control, which had been the cause of unnatural coloring in the low frequency range in the NFB circuit, we have achieved uniform tone quality in all bands.The output power of the f series is drastically increased in order to increase the driving force at low impedance load.Thorough measures are taken against noise caused by unwanted vibration or interference between circuits.Based on a chassis base excellent in vibration absorption mode, parts are firmly fixed in a thick chassis to realize a housing structure that reduces vibration noise.The layout is such that the power transformer, electrolytic capacitor, and amplifier block do not directly interfere with each other. The BOX structure is adopted in which each block is shielded by a shield plate. The internal filter is reinforced to eliminate mutual interference due to flux and to suppress the influence of external noise.It is designed as a separate pre-main type and can be upgraded to a separate system by combining with other power amplifiers and control amplifiers.It can also be expanded to bi-amp or multi-amp systems by adding a power amplifier.Uses custom parts exclusively for Luxman.The resistor is based on an acoustically excellent carbon film resistor, and is studied in various fields such as selection of alumina, etching, carbonization, terminal material, terminal shape and press-fit shape. This improves the information transfer fee and enables richer music reproduction.Custom parts are also used for power transformers, block capacitors, electrolytic capacitors, copper bus bars, and high-purity cables.Equipped with a large power meter.This meter uses a logarithmic compression display system and is designed to be easy to read while moving. In addition, the thickness of acrylic is 8 mm and attention is paid to the luminescent color and the illumination effect of the brand logo.The input terminal is equipped with RCA terminal and balance terminal.The speaker terminal uses an independently developed large speaker terminal that is compatible with banana plugs and Y lugs.The exterior has a high quality design with a precision hairline treatment.Wireless remote control is included.For the f-Series, the optimum position is the -14dB position of the main volume so that it can be enjoyed in a multi-channel environment such as home theater.By simply adjusting the volume to this position, it is possible to combine the channels set by the AV processor without losing the volume balance of each channel.

sections.title: LUXMAN L-507
sections.overview: This pre-main amplifier was announced as the highest level of the 500 series which represents Lux.The main amplifier uses a pure complimentary service system directly connected to all stages.NPN type and PNP type power transistors are Darlington connected to the B-class operation part of the power stage respectively. In order to make the switching characteristics of the upper half cycle and the lower half cycle perfectly symmetrical, a pair of power transistors with the same current amplification factor (hfe) is adopted. In both the output stage and the B-class driver stage, transistors with excellent high-frequency characteristics and breakdown resistance are adopted to increase reliability when the output terminal is short-circuited.The pre-driver stage employs a transistor with a high cut-off frequency and a particularly small collector output capacitance, making up a two stage differential amplifier circuit with low current drive. By driving with a constant current from no signal to maximum output, the B-class operation stage is kept in a stable state and notching distortion is suppressed.The equalizer stage of the preamplifier section employs a 3-stage direct-coupled circuit composed of NPN type, PNP type and NPN type transistors, which are advantageous in voltage utilization factor, to obtain excellent linearity and improve DC stability by providing sufficient DC feedback.The deviation from the standard RIAA curve is kept within   0.5 dB by reducing the tolerance of the parts used and suppressing dispersion.The tone control circuit is an NF type of Lux-type with a simple variable characteristic. The frequency at which the curve point begins to change can be switched by 3 points at each of low and high frequencies, making it possible to adjust the sound quality more precisely.Tone defeat is also possible.The filter circuit is CR type for low-cut and NF type for high-cut.The low boost circuit is an NF type.The SN ratio has been improved by using ultra-low noise transistors in all stages of the pre-section.In addition, the input and output circuit capacitors are selected from among Meiler capacitors and tantalum capacitors with less leakage current, thereby suppressing shock noise when switching switches.Two 10,000 ? F electrolytic capacitors are used for the filter circuit of the power supply.In addition, a muting circuit is installed to suppress shock noise when power is turned on or off.

sections.title: LUXMAN L-509S
sections.overview: This is a pre-main amplifier with improved cost performance while applying Luxman's technology.CSSC (Complementary Single Stagger Circuit) circuit is adopted for the amplifier section.This circuit is roughly divided into three parts. From the input side, it consists of a the second stage current transmission stage, and the final stage output circuit. The differential amplifier gains the inherent gain of the amplifier circuit. The current transmission stage uses a common-base transistor circuit that is used in high-frequency circuits that require high fT (cutoff frequency) transmission. The final stage is the output circuit. The control amplifier converts impedance, and the power amplifier amplifies power. complimentary serviceMany general amplifiers have amplification functions in the first and second stages. Since the cut-off frequencies of the first and second stages are approximate values, there is a large phase shift in the ultra-high frequency range as a total characteristic. Therefore, analog information from the output is inverted and returned to the input using NFB. This structure improves electrical characteristics. However, when a large phase shift occurs, the feedback becomes close to positive, and positive feedback oscillation or similar unstable state occurs. In order to avoid this, another local feedback loop is used as a complementary loop. However, this high-frequency correction loop itself greatly affects sound quality and causes a loss of natural feeling of sound.In the CSSC circuit, the cut-off frequency in the high-frequency range is extremely high in the second stage common-base type current transmission stage. Therefore, it can be said that the frequency characteristics of the first stage differential amplifier control almost the entire CSSC. Stable operation can be ensured with minimal correction, and high-through rate is achieved.It is equipped with LUX's unique OD ? circuit.The OD ? circuit is the ? circuit (NFB) of the amplifier, to which LUX added its own ingenuity. In a general amplifier, the NFB is fed separately in the direct current and AC regions. However, by inserting a DC servo amplifier into the feedback loop in order to ensure stability in the DC region, a difference in balance with the AC region was caused. In the OD ? circuit, excellent DC stability is ensured only by basic DC feedback without incorporating a DC servo amplifier by refining the bare characteristics of the circuit to a high degree. In addition, the NFB in the AC region has been optimized to adjust the energy balance in all bands and achieve a sense of uniformity in tone quality in all frequency bands.The power amplifier has a 3-stage Darlington configuration and uses a complimentary service circuit with low internal impedance, high current, and high fT type power transistors (Pc150W, Ic (max) 15A).In addition, stability is improved by using parts such as a large heat sink with a shape that reduces unnecessary noise while maintaining heat radiation characteristics, a high-voltage transistor, and a dual transistor for differential amplification.The power supply section uses a high-efficiency large EI core power transformer and a large-capacity capacitor with excellent instantaneous charge / discharge characteristics.The low impedance design low-impedance design makes it possible to supply music in accordance with the phase of music.The speaker terminal uses a vise screw type made of a unique material so that the cable can be firmly fixed.This connector is also compatible with a banana plug.It comes with a wireless remote control that controls basic functions such as power on / off, input select, volume control, and muting on / off.The volume and input selector are motor-driven, and the input selector is equipped with a clutch mechanism to give a click feeling when manually operated and to improve operability. In addition, the remote control can be operated smoothly.Equipped with bus line terminals, it is possible to link the remote control operation with the LUXMAN CD player.The internal layout is designed to prevent unnecessary vibration and noise. The overall structure is symmetrical to maintain weight balance. Each section is laid out in minimize interference while ensuring extremely high stability. In addition, a box isolation structure with shield plates is employed to completely eliminate high-frequency noise and leakage flux.The aluminum front panel has a special satin finish, which is combined with a lustrous wooden box finish to create a luxurious feel.The front panel is equipped with a power meter.This meter uses a logarithmic compression method and realizes a unique atmosphere by focusing on the color scheme.The internal circuit uses custom-made parts designed for L-509s.It includes tone control, loudness and subsonic filter, balance control, recording selector, and mode selector.It is also equipped with a line straighter function, which can provide high quality sound by bypassing unused circuits (tone control, mode selector, left / right balance).The headphone jack has a dedicated relay contact to eliminate the influence on the speaker jack.An inverted switch is mounted, and the phase of the balance line input can be inverted.Equipped with line phase sensor, polarity can be checked when power plug is inserted.Custom type power cable and AC inlet are adopted.It is equipped with a bus line that links remote control operations of LUXMAN CD players.

sections.title: LUXMAN L-509F
sections.overview: The pre-main amplifier of the f series was developed by completely reviewing the circuit structure and design of the existing integrated series.The power amplifier section is equipped with the ODNF circuit that is also used for M-7f/C-7f.In order to realize this circuit, we first developed and adopted an ultra-wide-band, high-slew rate, low-distortion circuit that does not require phase correction for the amplification circuit of the music signal. Phase correction, which cannot be avoided with conventional negative feedback circuits, is eliminated.We also pay attention to the nature of NFB itself. We pick up only the distortion component from the output and feed it back to the final stage of the amplifier circuit so as to cancel it. This removes only the distortion component from the output waveform. By separating the NFB from the music signal, we have achieved a high initial slew rate and ultra-wide bandwidth that rise instantaneously. In addition, by eliminating the DC servo amplifier for ultra-low frequency control, which had been the cause of unnatural coloring in the low frequency range in the NFB circuit, we have achieved uniform tone quality in all bands.In the f series, the output power is drastically increased in order to increase the driving force at low impedance load, and in the L-509f, excellent drive capability is realized by changing the power transistor from 2 parallel to 3 parallel push-pull.The power supply section uses a 670 VA large-capacity power transformer and four 10,000 uFx large electrolytic capacitors to ensure a stable supply of power required for signal amplification.Thorough measures are taken against noise caused by unwanted vibration or interference between circuits.Based on a chassis base excellent in vibration absorption mode, parts are firmly fixed in a thick chassis to realize a housing structure that reduces vibration noise.The layout is such that the power transformer, electrolytic capacitor, and amplifier block do not directly interfere with each other. The BOX structure is adopted in which each block is shielded by a shield plate. The internal filter is reinforced to eliminate mutual interference due to flux and to suppress the influence of external noise.It is designed as a separate pre-main type and can be upgraded to a separate system by combining with other power amplifiers and control amplifiers.It can also be expanded to bi-amp or multi-amp systems by adding a power amplifier.Uses custom parts exclusively for Luxman.The resistor is based on an acoustically excellent carbon film resistor, and is studied in various fields such as selection of alumina, etching, carbonization, terminal material, terminal shape and press-fit shape. This improves the information transfer fee and enables richer music reproduction.Custom parts are also used for power transformers, block capacitors, electrolytic capacitors, copper bus bars, and high-purity cables.Equipped with a large power meter.This meter uses a logarithmic compression display system and is designed to be easy to read while moving. In addition, the thickness of acrylic is 8 mm and attention is paid to the luminescent color and the illumination effect of the brand logo.The input terminal is equipped with an RCA terminal and two balance terminals.The speaker terminal uses an independently developed large speaker terminal that is compatible with banana plugs and Y lugs.The exterior has a high quality design with a precision hairline treatment.Wireless remote control is included.For the f-Series, the optimum position is the -14dB position of the main volume so that it can be enjoyed in a multi-channel environment such as home theater.By simply adjusting the volume to this position, it is possible to combine the channels set by the AV processor without losing the volume balance of each channel.

sections.title: LUXMAN L-550X
sections.overview: The L-500X series pre-main amplifier is based on the L-500 series equipped with a single-stage amplifier, and has been improved overall with the aim of refining the ground circuit and enriching the input system.The L-550X employs a class A operation method in which the bias current is fixed. In addition, it employs a single-stage amplifier with dramatically improved bare characteristics of the amplifier.This single-stage amplification is a circuit that extracts a gain equivalent to that of multi-stage amplification at one stage by using an amplification element with excellent bare characteristics. In addition, the second stage is eliminated after eliminating the effect of the first stage by making the output stage independent. This eliminates problems such as the adverse effect of power supply noise and the deterioration of the slew rate due to the high-pass correction of the stagger.In addition, the amplifier circuit is stabilized by using symmetric differential push-pull for the equalizer and power section and by installing the input to ground.In order to solve the problem of interference between music signals caused by the slight fluctuation of the ground potential, the ground circuit is refined.First, we removed the power source reference amplifier, which was a factor of fluctuation, from the inside of the amplifier, and constructed all clean earth reference type amplifier circuits. Then, we reviewed the input / output current loops of each amplifier circuit and separated and coupled each amplifier circuit to make each amplifier circuit independent. We also devised the ground circuit pattern to fix the reference potential.Head amplifier is mounted to support MC cartridge.The input part of the head amplifier uses a low-noise transistor superior to FET in S/N, and the output part is equipped with a high-speed transistor superior in linearity.A pure focus capacitor is used for the block capacitor in the power supply.Equipped with a linear equalizer, you can adjust the recording frequency of analog discs that tend to rise or fall toward higher frequencies. You can also adjust the sound field characteristics of the listening room.The tone control allows you to select nine turnovers for both high and low frequencies.Copper plating is applied to important parts of the chassis to eliminate electro-magnetostriction.

sections.title: LUXMAN L-570
sections.overview: This is a pre-main amplifier developed by combining the know-how for ultra-low frequency expression obtained with the M-07 and techniques for processing very small signals obtained with the C-06 and E-06.The power amplifier section uses a pure class A operation method. In this method, a constant bias current is always supplied up to the maximum output, so that there is no fluctuation in the operation point due to the signal, and the high-quality power characteristic of class A operation is achieved.The power supply uses a large-capacity power transformer that is 30% larger than a normal same class amplifier.In addition, the constant voltage power supply section of each stage independent winding has been thoroughly designed to have low impedance to improve instantaneous response capability. In particular, the current capacity to the power stage has a margin of 1.5 times that of the normal one to achieve ultra-low impedance.The signal path from the input terminal to the speaker terminal is structured to completely eliminate complicated routing and unnecessary small objects.For input switching, the wiring is shortened by remotely switching only the selected terminal including the ground terminal at the optimum position near the input terminal. For switching, a nitrogen gas sealed contact relay is used to improve sound quality.In addition, the speaker terminal is dedicated without A/B switching, and the headphone terminal is also eliminated so that it is directly connected to the power stage without any extra circuit.PC-OCC for sound quality control is used at important points for internal wiring.A non-resonant bottom chassis has been adopted for the bottom chassis. Together with the construction with symmetric weight balance on the left and right, we are promoting non-resonance.The amplifier for MC cartridge and the amplifier for MM cartridge are composed independently, and each of them is installed separately.The MC amplifier uses a super-low-noise, high-Gm FET in parallel, and a low-noise reference voltage power supply combining constant current and constant voltage for the power supply part to realize an extremely low-noise power supply with low-impedance output.The equalizer amplifier also operates in class A mode to enable high-quality analog disk playback.The volume part uses an Ultimate attenuator.The conventional continuously variable volume has a limit in sound quality due to the stray current of the sliding part and the material of the contact because metal slides on the carbon film. The Ultimate Attenuator used in the L-570 is a 32-contact rotary switch type attenuator that is based on a newly developed slide rotary switch and consists of a glass-epoxy gold-plated substrate with non-magnetic resistors mounted one by one, and a shield case made of die-cast extruded material. This reduces sound quality degradation in volume.In order to ensure stable operation, we have newly developed and adopted a high efficiency radiator using pure copper fins with high heat radiation effect.The sound quality is further improved by using the same material as the power amplifier M-07 in various parts such as the resistance of the gold plated cap. The L-570 uses parts for sound quality such as high-performance Styrol condenser and pure focus electrolytic condenser.A tone compensator is used as the tone correction controller.When the Recording Selector is in the OFF position, the recording output is disconnected from the signal system to prevent deterioration of sound quality.Line phase sensor is used and the power supply polarity (direction of plug insertion) can be adjusted correctly.

sections.title: LUXMAN L-570XS
sections.overview: As the third generation 570, while inheriting the elements of L-570, the know-how obtained in L-570Z's was incorporated and the technology was further elaborated to complete the pre-main amplifier.Inheriting the track record and know-how of A-class amplifiers, we have adopted a pure A-class system that always supplies a large amount of current.In addition to the concept of "Simple is best" pursued in the L-570, a newly designed circuit board has been adopted to eliminate complicated routing and sound quality neckpoints in the signal path from the input terminal to the speaker terminal and ensure a simple and smooth flow.In addition, a new type of gold contact relay is adopted for the switching of the input section, and by switching the input at the optimum position close to the input terminal, the routing of the signal path is minimized. Since this relay circuit switches not only the hot side but also the ground side, everything except the selection signal circuit is completely disconnected, enabling pure signal transmission.In addition, the A/B switching of the speaker and even the headphone terminal are eliminated for complete simplification.The power supply section is equipped with a newly designed power transformer that enhances dynamic energy supply capability rather than static characteristics.In addition, we use our own custom parts for regulator circuits and constant voltage circuits.The low impedance drive capability is improved by this power supply, and the load drive capability of 200W + 200W at 2   load is obtained according to the theoretical value.The volume uses a rotary switch type Ultimate Attenuator, eliminating the limitations of sound quality due to the stray current of the sliding part and the contact material that were generated in the continuously variable volume.This is based on a 32-contact rotary switch made of a glass-epoxy gold-plated substrate, and non-magnetic resistors are mounted one by one. Further improvements such as higher gap accuracy have improved usability.In order to achieve higher sound quality, many custom parts are used.Other audio parts include non-magnetic resistors with gold-plated caps, polystyrene capacitors with copper foils, pure focus electrolytic capacitors, and high-purity copper cables.The bottom chassis is made of high-rigidity and large-mass ceramic special FRP, eliminating resonance as a construction with symmetric weight balance.In addition, a 5-point grounding insulator reduces the effects of external and internal vibrations.A tone compensator is installed as a tone correction circuit.This circuit allows natural phase correction rather than large f-specific movement as in conventional tone control.

sections.title: LUXMAN L-570ZS
sections.overview: An integrated amplifier developed with the aim of reproducing music expression more pure.The circuit system uses a pure A-class system that always supplies a large amount of current, ensuring extremely high power quality.In addition, by utilizing the characteristics of the pure A-class system with excellent instantaneous response and by controlling the auditory phase of the music against the time axis, it is able to cope with constantly fluctuating music playback.The power supply section is equipped with a large capacity power transformer, and the regulator circuit and constant voltage circuit are equipped with many unique custom parts.By eliminating the complex routing of signal paths and bottlenecks in sound quality, we have increased the ability to play music by simplifying it.For example, a nitrogen gas sealed contact relay is used to switch the input terminal at the optimum position close to the input terminal to minimize the routing of the signal path. In addition, since this relay circuit switches not only the hot side but also the ground side, all parts except the selection signal circuit are completely disconnected, realizing an extremely pure signal path.In addition, in order to simplify the signal path, the speaker A/B switching and the headphone terminal are eliminated.The volume uses an Ultimate attenuator.Since the contact surface of a general continuously variable volume slides on a resistor, the sound quality has been considered to be limited by stray current in the sliding part and contact material.The Ultimate Attenuator adopted in the L-570Z's is a rotary switch type attenuator. It is based on a 32-contact rotary switch made of glass epoxy gold plated substrate, and non-magnetic resistors are mounted one by one. This overcomes the sound quality defect of continuously variable volume.In addition, the L-570Z's has been improved for its exclusive use and is housed in a shield case made of aluminum die-cast and extruded material.The bottom chassis is made of high-rigidity, large-mass ceramic-containing special FRP, which completely eliminates resonance that makes sound muddy. In addition, the legs are equipped with 5-point grounding insulators to reduce the influence of external and internal vibrations.For the heat sink, we have independently developed and adopted a high-efficiency radiator made of pure copper with high heat radiation effect and steep attenuation characteristics.High-grade audio parts such as non-magnetic resistance using gold plated cap, copper foil styrene condenser, pure focus type electrolytic condenser, 6N (99.9999% Cu) cable are adopted.A tone compensator is used in the tone correction circuit.In this circuit, it is possible to perform natural phase correction instead of moving the f-special by a large amount as in tone control.

sections.overview: An integrated amplifier that uses a vacuum tube and MOS FET to pursue high-quality music playback.The know-how of the Brid series is further refined as a music player and upgraded in all aspects including the power supply circuit.FET is applied to the first stage differential circuit, 3-pole vacuum tube is applied to the second stage differential section, and MOS FET is applied to the power stage. By this, the power of MOS FET is obtained while the taste of vacuum tube is brought out.As a result of a result of adopting a vacuum tube, the first stage input circuit can be handled by a P-channel FET, which is more advantageous than an N-channel FET in terms of gate leakage current, etc. In addition, the use of a high-gain, low-noise FET, 2SJ75, also shows superior sound quality.The f characteristic is improved by further increasing the input impedance with the booth trap and cascade connection.The circuit configuration consists of a current mirror + vacuum tube differential, and music signals are amplified based on a fixed reference point, enabling highly accurate information transmission.In the power supply section, a large super regulation transformer with a capacity of 50 VA is used as the power transformer.A block capacitor with a total capacity of 32800 ? F is used to supply power to the power stage for low impedance. sections.title: LUXMAN LX38
sections.overview: This tube type stereo integrated amplifier is the fourth generation of 38 series from the first stage SQ38F released in August 1973.The preamp section consists of a flat amplifier circuit that also functions as an equalizer circuit and tone control circuit. Each circuit is fully developed to improve the characteristics.The equalizer circuit employs a two stage P-K ? NF method (a method in which a blowing sensation is applied from the second stage plate to the first stage cathode) that provides low distortion characteristics and excellent stability over the entire band. In addition, the equalizer circuit is set at an operating point where the current of the output stage is increased to improve the input resistance in the mid - and high-frequency range.The tone control circuit, which also serves as a flat amplifier, adopts the 2-stage P-K ? NF method to improve the distortion factor characteristics.Low-noise type 12AX7 and 12AU7 are used in the pre-section. Especially, ultra-low-noise type is used carefully for the first stage of the equalizer circuit.For the output tube of the power amplifier section, a 3-pole tube 50CA10 with low internal resistance and excellent bare characteristics is used for AB class operation. In order to bring out the performance of this sphere, a newly designed output transformer is used.This transformer reduces the power loss to less than 1/2 compared with the conventional OY15 type by increasing the diameter of the wire used, and realizes improved frequency characteristics, phase characteristics and AC balance by unifying the secondary winding using the wide optimum load range of the 3-pole output tube.The driver circuit is based on a Mulard type drive circuit (cathode-coupled phase-inversion circuit) that has few time-constant circuits in the low-frequency range and is more stable and can gain more gain. The first stage 6267 uses three connections, and the latter stage of phase-inversion uses a triode 6AQ8 and triode in all stages to improve the distortion factor characteristics in the high-frequency range. In addition, the operating point of this driver circuit is made variable, and it is adjusted one by one to cancel out the distortion in the output stage.The tone control function consists of a 3-point bending point switch for both low and high frequencies. The level adjustment is linked to the left and right channels. The adjustment volume uses a new multi-slider type volume and is equipped with a defeat switch.The CR type filter is used for both high and low frequencies, and can be switched at 2 points each.Other built-in functions include a low boost function, a tape monitor circuit, a tape dubbing function, a Rec out off function to disconnect the recording output terminal, and a -20dB attenuator.The mechanism has been completely reconsidered, and by simplifying the signal path and adopting a printed circuit board, the characteristics and stability are improved.In addition, the speaker switching and impedance switching of the output circuit are eliminated to prevent deterioration of sound quality caused by excessive switch contact passage.The volume and balancer employ a highly accurate multi-slider type volume that can almost ignore the linkage error between the left and right channels.We have also adopted film type coupling capacitors and highly reliable switches.There was a wood cabinet sold separately.

It has a slightly higher gm compared to 2A3 and has improved efficiency, but the essential advantages are inherited as they are.The output transformer uses the Lux OY type, which was created through more than 30 years of transformer manufacturing experience.This transformer uses an Orient Core (grain-oriented cold-rolled core) and adds handcraft winding technology to realize a high-quality transformer.The driver circuit is a 12AU7 and 6267 leak type (used in the Point One Amplifier by LEAK in the UK), and the output tube is operated by a fixed bias method.The NFB is multiplied by 16 dB the damping factor is 16.The power supply consists of a power transformer with low magnetic flux density, a silicon diode voltage doubler rectifier, and a choke coil.The DC ignition system is adopted for all stages of the preamplifier section to eliminate hum completely.The equalizer stage is NF-type and the tone control stage is NF-type.The tone control uses a lux-type and can be restored to a flat characteristic without being defeated.Equipped with a tape monitor and DIN connector.

This is a bulb-type pre-main amplifier that is the fourth generation of the SQ38 series.50CA10 is used for the output tube, and OY15 type is used for the output transformer.The main amplifier section is based on a Mulard type circuit. sections.title: LUXMAN SQ-38SIGNATURE
sections.overview: A bulb-type pre-main stereo amplifier commercialized to commemorate the 70th anniversary of the company's founding.It has inherited the title of 38, which is a long-seller for the past 7 models.Williamson circuit is used for the power amplifier section.The inverted signal is formed by PK division with little degradation of sound quality, and the output tube EL34 (6CA7) is operated by push-pull so that the total NFB is kept to a minimum.The output tube EL34 is carefully selected from the special line of Golden Dragon. In addition, 12AU7 is used for the first stage and 12BH7 is used for the driver stage. This is an orthodox element and circuit configuration.For the output transformer, which has a significant impact on sound quality, we have adopted the traditional OY type, which determined the reputation of Lux as a transformer manufacturer.It uses an orient core material and has been newly designed to meet the specifications based on OY's unique split winding. This gives excellent sound quality with little phase rotation and an honest response extended to the low and audible band.In addition, the main body of the transformer is tightly sealed and filled with fixing material. Moreover, it is housed in an iron case to completely eliminate leakage flux.The pre-section is equipped with a custom volume control to improve the distortion and sound quality.The tone control circuit consists of a vacuum tube 12AU7. This circuit allows more natural correction by separating the high and low frequencies.Attention is also paid to basic parts, and consideration is given to sound quality by newly improved composite electrolytic capacitors, high-precision mold resistors, and double-sided glass-epoxy circuit boards.Source Select can switch between line input and tape input / output independently.In addition, if you use a 3-head deck, you can monitor recording simultaneously with the monitor switch.In addition, the line-straight switch allows the source signal to be sent in a purer state by skipping over the monitor switch and balance volume.In order to support CD and DAT, four line inputs are installed.It also has a high-precision phono equalizer.In order to secure the vacuum tube securely and to eliminate the influence of external vibration, the chassis is designed to have an appropriate weight and a rigid structure.In addition, high-density materials are used for the side panels, and materials with different vibration modes are used for vibration control measures.Volume control and selector switch knobs are a combination of blast finish and hairline finish.AC inlet is used for the power cable.In addition, polarity management is also possible by adopting the line phase sensor.

sections.title: LUXMAN SQ65
sections.overview: A high-output pre-main amplifier developed on the basis of technologies obtained with medium-output amplifiers.It is designed not only for high power but also for high power and low distortion, and achieves an output of 28W.A cathode NF circuit is used for the output circuit.In addition to the commonly used NF circuit, the cathode NF circuit is a type of multiple NF circuit method that applies local feedback to the output tube. By this method, the internal resistance of the output tube is greatly reduced and NFB is stably applied over a wide band.The output transformer uses a special winding designed for the cathode NF circuit.As the output tube, Nova tube 7868 of 7591 is used.The Nova tube is a large 9-pin MT tube with the capacity of the GT tube in addition to the shape of the MT tube. It eliminates problems caused by the lacerations of the stem base and poor soldering, which were considered as defects of the GT tube.The 7581 (7868) is an output tube for Hi-Fi that was used in the McIntosh 225 model and established a reputation. It is a high-sensitivity type ball of 6L6GC and can take out a large output of over 40W (AB class P. P.).Each pair of output tubes is fully AC-balanced by independent regulators, and the output tubes are operated in a fixed bias mode.The driver circuit uses the so-called LEAK-type, which was used in the point-one type amplifier by LEAK in the UK.In addition, DC ignition is used for the first stage tube of this main section, and the overall SN has been successfully improved.The preamp section uses the all-NF type as the rack type, which is used in the SQ5B and SQ38. A 5-pole tube is provided to prevent the increase of distortion and only to increase the input sensitivity.There are two types of equalizer circuits for tapes : one for 19 cm of NAB standard and the other for 9.5 cm at low speed.A lux-type tone control is used.Extra Bass circuit is mounted.This circuit is a kind of MFB circuit for low frequency compensation, and can automatically shift fo to low frequency according to the characteristics of the speaker.For example, on a system with a fo of 80 Hz, the frequency can be reduced to 40 Hz, which is half of that, and the playback capability can be extended substantially by one octave into the lower range.However, this circuit can only be used in closed speaker systems.It features two types of low and high filters, a tape monitor with a 3-head tape recorder, and a blend control that adjusts the spread of the stereo sound source.

sections.title: LUXMAN SQ202
sections.overview: The top-of-the-line model of Luxman Pre Main Amplifier at that time.The main amplifier section has an emitter-follower circuit at the first stage to make the input sensitivity variable.The circuit configuration is a semi-differential SEPP system using a complimentary service amplifier circuit. All stages are directly connected by using two power supply circuits and eliminating the coupling capacitors at the outputs stage.A 3-stage direct-coupled NF type circuit is used for the equalizer circuit. In particular, high voltage transistors are used to increase the maximum allowable input voltage to approximately 30 V.This equalizer circuit has separate Phono1 and Phono2. The input signals are directly connected to each other, and the type of input is switched on the output side. As a result, there is almost no shock noise when switching functions, external noise is reduced, and the S / N ratio is improved.The output of the equalizer circuit is sent to the next stage via a selector switch and volume balancer.This amplifier stage consists of two different circuits. Normally it passes through an 18 dB gain amplifier stage, but when the attenuator is operated, it is switched to an emitter-follower circuit without amplification.The output of this stage is directly connected to the input stage of the main amplifier section if the tone control circuit and filter circuit which follow are turned off.The tone control circuit uses the NF type of Lux-system, and the bending point can be switched between 3 points for high and 3 points for low.The filter circuit is an NF type of -12dB per octave, and there are two high and low frequencies.This circuit is also equipped with four circuits for each frequency, and a signal is sent to each circuit as required. High sound quality is achieved by switching the entire circuit instead of switching the CR element.The protection circuit uses a current limiting method and operates while the performance continues.Equipped with a VU meter.When the selector switch is set to the PRE position, this meter can be used for the output of the preamplifier section. 0 vu is 1 v. When the output of the main amplifier section is monitored, set it to the position of Main0dB or Main-14dB.The microphone's head amplifier is also independent and can be mixed with other signals. The volume of the microphone is also variable and the degree of mixing can be controlled.The front panel is equipped with a recording output terminal (tape-out) and a monitor terminal (tape-in).The preamp section and main amplifier section can be independent.

sections.overview: As the economic type of the SQ505X, this pre-main amplifier is designed with emphasis on practicability and without waste.The main amplifier section uses   2 power supply system and all stages are directly connected without the output capacitor, so that the power character and damping factor up to the ultra-low frequency range are sufficiently secured.Pure complimentary service system composed of PNP type power transistor and NPN type power transistor, and crossover distortion is also removed.The first stage consists of a constant-current differential amplifier with a low-noise PNP transistor to maintain high stability against DC drift.The equalizer stage of the preamplifier section consists of a 2-stage direct connection circuit. The PNP and NPN transistors are used to improve the linearity by improving the power supply utilization factor. The stability is also improved by applying DC feedback from the second stage collector to the first stage emitter.The pre-section uses ultra-low-noise silicon transistors in all stages, and is composed of carefully selected PNP transistors with superior noise figure in nature, which further reduces the harsh mid-to-high-level noise characteristic of transistors.In addition, tantalum type and Mylar type capacitors with low leakage current are used as coupling capacitors between stages to eliminate unpleasant shock noise when switching switches.LUX type NF type is used for tone control.The left and right channels are independent, and the bending point can be switched by two points each for both low and high frequencies.With an attenuator, the gain can be reduced by 18 dB without using volume.Equipped with two types of speaker terminals.Equipped with a tape monitor and DIN connector.The front panel is made of aluminum material with hairline processing. It is white gold anodized.

sections.title: LUXMAN DU-10
sections.overview: Universal player compatible with DVD audio and SACD.To maximize the capabilities of both multi-bit DVD audio and DSD SACD, we have installed a PCM D/A conversion route for multi-bit and a DSD DAC for SACD playback. Also, SACD sources recorded in DSD can be converted to multi-bit and played back.Furthermore, in order to realize high-quality reproduction of CDs, detailed studies have been carried out such as re-washing of circuit constants, review of materials, and optimization of casing current.The D/A conversion part is equipped with Luxman's original FE (Full Embassy) DAC.The FE / DAC was installed in the D/A converter DA-07 released in 1989. In the past, it was impossible to install it in an integrated CD player because it was very large. The DU-10 uses a full enclosure interpolation DSP that has been realized by advances in DSP processing capability, and while being compact, it has acquired spatial reproducibility equivalent to that of the DA-07.The difference between the FE-DAC full enclosure method and the conventional Shannon method lies in the interpolation function, and the difference appears in the impulse response waveform. In the full enclosure method, there is no vibration seen in Shannon, and the waveform is clean, reducing the effect on the waveform modulation that occurs at the start of music. In addition, in the frequency characteristic, while Shannon drops sharply at a fixed frequency, full enclosure draws a relatively gentle slope, making it possible to create a space that can reproduce frequencies above 20 kHz in CD playback.The DU-10 is equipped with two types of DACs, a full enclosure type and a Shannon type, and can be switched with a switch on the front panel.The Shannon method is most suitable for electronic music and other genres, and the Full Encie method is most suitable for classical music and other genres, which can naturally express rich a feeling of oppression.For transformer and power supply, the mechanism, video system and audio system are separately arranged, and each circuit is separated by a chassis to increase rigidity and reduce interference between units.In addition, each circuit part is made with an abundance of audio-only parts that have been carefully examined for sound quality to further improve sound quality.The front panel and side panel are made of thick aluminum material, and the upper panel is made of a composite material of aluminum and steel plate to improve damping performance against external vibration.In addition, in order to reduce vibration from the floor, FRP, which has twice the normal specific gravity and is reinforced with glass fiber, is used.Equipped with a decoder for 5.1 ch Dolby Digital (AC-3) and dts surround.The 6-channel circuit is equipped with a common grade audio circuit to ensure high quality.It is equipped with a progressive video circuit and can display twice the amount of information compared to the interlaced method on progressive TV by video interpolation and can obtain images with less flicker.Equipped with a digital input, it can be used as a D/A converter.Wireless remote control is included.

sections.title: LUXMAN D-7
sections.overview: A CD player that inherits the design philosophy of the D-10 and supports HDCD.It is equipped with an HDCD decoder and supports HDCD.In addition, when performing 8 x oversampling interpolation, the dither signal has energy distribution frequency characteristics that do not give a sense of incongruity to the music signal, and the minimum bit is stored. As a result, natural realism is achieved even during normal CD playback.The D/A converter uses PCM1702, which is a 20 bit sign magnitude DAC, to solve 0 cross distortion, which is the largest defect of multi-bit DAC. In addition, the D-7 uses highly selected K-rank high-reliability devices to achieve thorough low distortion.The power supply section employs a newly developed large-capacity custom capacitor with low loss and excellent rapid charge / discharge characteristics. The power supply is composed of a real-time instantaneous power supply, thereby realizing the stability corresponding to the current change of the multi-bit DAC.In addition, by dividing the winding of a sufficiently large power transformer into four systems according to the application and using know-how to prevent current interference such as STAR circuits, interference via the power supply part of each circuit is prevented.The I/V converter with this function uses Luxman's original SSC circuit, and an analog circuit that reacts in real time to the response of the DAC realizes extremely accurate voltage conversion.To prevent interference between digital and analog circuits, the D-7 incorporates an RF amplifier that amplifies the small signal of the laser pickup, and digital signal processing components such as EFM demodulation and error correction into the drive mechanism. The output of these components passes through a shield box and is input to the nearest digital filter. A control microcomputer that controls the entire process is also located immediately adjacent to the digital filter.In this way, the rational layout design that fits the digital circuit in a very small area prevents degradation of the digital signal and ensures a high-purity analog signal.A high-density FRP resin tray with moderate internal loss is used for the disk tray. This tray is mechanically fixed during rotation, overcoming the weak point of the tray which is vulnerable to vibration.In addition, the mechanism is firmly mounted by a solid rigid housing structure with two channels passing through the center of the chassis and both sides of the mechanism in front and back. This structure divides the inside of the housing into three shield compartments to almost completely prevent the functional units contained in each compartment from interfering with each other. In addition, the entire center mechanism is covered to prevent contamination of the laser pickup output signal due to light leakage.The base chassis uses FRP base chassis containing glass fibers with rigidity and moderate internal loss.It uses plenty of high-quality custom parts.Especially for analog circuits such as I/V converters, high-quality parts such as special coated carbon resistors and copper tube shielded Styrofoam capacitors are used.It is equipped with coaxial digital output by pulse transformer with large toroidal core and AES/EBU balance digital output.In addition to the RCA pin terminal, the analog output is also equipped with a balanced XLR terminal.Includes metal body wireless remote control.It also has a display off function, and you can turn off the display by remote control operation according to the brightness and situation of the room.

sections.title: LUXMAN D-10
sections.overview: HDCD-compatible CD player developed with technologies such as Tower DAC.The D/A converter uses the sine magnitude method to solve the 0 cross distortion, which was the biggest drawback of a multi-bit DAC.The structure of the D/A conversion section adopts 4-stage stack tower DAC method.In general, various characteristics such as distortion factor and SN ratio can be improved by driving multiple DACs in parallel. The Tower DACs were developed to take full advantage of the advantages of parallel use. The current balance is maintained in the vicinity of the strictly selected DACs, the boards with the shortest high-frequency bus are stacked on top of each other, and the number of stacks is determined to be four by precise data analysis.This tower DAC structure has the advantage of minimizing the data / clock lines to individual DACs, improving jitter and signal-to-noise ratio by using a shield case, and reducing the influence of mutual interference and straight capacitor by inserting a high-speed buffer into the data line to the tower DAC.The D-10 has a built-in HDCD decoder can play high-quality HDCD discs.HDCD is a CD-compatible disc with the equivalent of 20 bits of information and employs a mapping and dither addition algorithm based on auditory psychological experiments.In addition, the technology that interpolates the lowest bit using a dither signal with energy distribution frequency characteristics that do not give a sense of incongruity to the music signal at the time of 8 times oversampling interpolation provides natural realism even during normal CD playback.High-inertia power supply is used for the power supply part.This power supply circuit employs a newly developed large-capacity custom capacitor with low loss and excellent rapid charge / discharge characteristics. This circuit is able to cope with sudden current changes in DAC where discrete pulse signals and continuous analog signals exist.In addition, a sufficiently large power transformer is adopted, the winding is divided into four systems according to the application, and the interference through the power supply between circuits is suppressed by current interference prevention technology such as STAR circuit.The analog low-pass filter uses a high-purity design passive low-pass filter.The filter with sharp roll-off characteristics is composed of an air-core coil with a shield case developed as a custom part and a copper foil styrene condenser, enabling natural reproduction sound while minimizing group delay characteristics in the audible band.The analog outputs of the SSC circuit make use of Lux's amplifier technology, enabling high slew rate and wide bandwidth. The gain of this SSC circuit is the most suitable amplifier for a high-output CD-player, realizing a high Tyner mix range and high linearity.The power supply section, including the power transformer and rectifier diode, has a box structure, and the power supply circuit is divided into digital and analog circuits to avoid interference from the power supply of each signal system.In order to prevent interference between digital and analog circuits, the D-10 incorporates an RF amplifier for amplifying the small signal of the laser pickup, digital signal processing for EFM demodulation and error correction, etc. in the drive mechanism. The output is passed through a shield box and input to the nearest digital filter. In addition, a control microcomputer for controlling the entire process is placed right next to the digital filter to store the digital circuit in a very small area.The disc tray is made of high-density FRP resin and has a tray locking mechanism during play to eliminate the adverse effect of resonance. The central mechanism section is also covered to prevent contamination of the laser pickup output signal due to light leakage.The base chassis uses FRP base chassis containing glass fibers with rigidity and moderate internal loss.Custom parts developed in-house are used everywhere to further improve the sound quality.The digital outputs include coaxial digital output using a large toroidal pulse transformer, AES/EBU balanced digital output and AT&T/ST link.The analog output has a balanced output in addition to the RCA pin terminal.System remote control is included.This remote control not only controls the CD player, but also controls the basic functions of the Luxman control amplifier and pre-main amplifier via the bus line.

sections.title: LUXMAN D-100
sections.overview: This is a FLUCON size disc player developed as the second generation model of Luxman.A 3-beam system is used for the pickup part.In the 3-beam system, two sub-beams are mounted in addition to the main beam for reading signals, enabling more accurate tracing.A tracking servo is used in the servo circuit, and by reading the tracking error of the main beam by the sub beam, even slight positional deviation can be accurately detected and corrected in real time.As the sensitivity of the servo circuit is increased, it becomes more resistant to vibration and external shocks. However, it may detect even dirt or fine scratches on the disc that are unrelated to the music signal, which may cause malfunction. Therefore, the D-100 sets the servo gain corresponding to the variation from the information storage track, and sets the appropriate servo gain for each condition so that the appropriate servo operates under all conditions.Luxman's original S. T. A. R. circuit is used for all analog signal circuits after the D/A converter.In this method, the ground line and feed line to each circuit block are supplied directly to each point without sharing them, and the shared impedance of each circuit is completely eliminated.In the D-100, the main clock is the clock of the D/A converter. The microcomputer clock and the system clock are synchronized by sending out the clock divided from the main clock. This prevents the beat phenomenon that occurs when multiple clocks are used.The digital and analog power and analog systems prevent deterioration of sound quality due to high-frequency pulse components.It is equipped with functions such as 16-track random memory, search monitor, and all tracks / program repeat.Equipped with timer standby mechanism, alarm clock playback is possible by combining with a separately sold timer.FL tube is used for the display.Equipped with headphone volume.The disk tray uses a touch sensor system, and the sensor operates by simply swinging it to the front of the CD tray without pressing the open / close button, and the tray is stored.Wireless remote control is included.
