sections.overview: A CD player with a 3-pole vacuum tube for output circuit.Bi-triode 6CG7 is adopted as cathode follower circuit.The 3-pole vacuum tube has linear characteristics and excellent ability to draw out music, such as less harsh odd-order harmonics. In addition, the cathode follower, in which the active element is composed of the minimum unit (1 unit), simplifies the circuit.An output line transformer newly developed for the D-107U has been adopted.As well as enabling advanced musical expression, the transformer coupling realizes stable transmission even under low impedance loads.By utilizing the natural attenuation characteristics of the line transformer, we have succeeded in completely removing the analog filter, which is harmful to sound quality. This realizes a simple circuit configuration in which the analog signal enters the vacuum tube directly after the DA conversion and is output through the output transformer.In order to prevent the CD player from outputting pulses when the power is turned on, a muting circuit is used to prevent the CD player from outputting pulses for a certain period of time.This muting circuit uses relay contacts, making it an ideal output circuit in which the ground line and the DC line are completely disconnected when the muting is released.Digital output is eliminated in order to thoroughly pursue the taste of analog circuits using vacuum tubes.In addition, it is equipped with 2 systems of variable output and fixed output by electric volume, and both systems realize pure line out which is not affected by radiation.Anti-vibration measures are provided to suppress external vibration that is harmful to sound quality.The optical pick-up base is separated from the assembly base, and a special rubber damper and coil spring are combined between them to block vibration. It uses a unique high-rigid lock mechanism.In addition, a center-mounted low center of gravity structure, which is placed in the center, makes the structure resistant to external vibration.Built-in editing and fade-out functions are useful for recording.It is also equipped with a time fade-out function that allows you to specify the time, and you can set the fade-out time up to 99 minutes in units of minutes.When time comes, it fades out naturally and then returns automatically to the initial output level.Equipped with a preheating switch that warms the vacuum tube heater in advance, stable operation can be obtained in a short time.Equipped with a display adjustment function that can adjust or turn off the brightness of the FL display tube according to the brightness of the room.Uses gold-plated terminal with low contact loss.

F block capacitor, which is equivalent to a power amplifier, is adopted for the power supply of the analog section, a fast recovery diode is adopted for the rectifier diode, and the stabilization power supply circuit is a differential amplifier type to ensure low output impedance from low to wide range.The power supply for the D/A converter is stabilized by using a double regulator so that noise does not occur in the analog filter or output circuit.The digital filter uses a 2 x oversampling 80th linear phase FIR type digital filter.The D/A converter uses a 16-bit current addition type based on serial input resistance ladder method. sections.title: LUXMAN D-500
sections.overview: This CD player inherits the design philosophy and basic configuration of the D-500X's and D-500X' sII, and has been reconsidered with the aim of further perfection.By adopting a top-loading system and eliminating unstable structures such as slide mechanisms, harmful resonance caused by unstable moving parts and effects of turbulence on the disk itself are suppressed.In addition, the entire loading section has a floating structure and is mounted on a solid base to prevent internal and external vibrations and improve tracing capability. In addition, the shape of the recess used to eject the disc is designed to reduce turbulence during rotation.The Philips CDM-3 pickup mechanism is used for the pickup part.In the CDM-3, a die-cast swing arm with a clear fulcrum and a pantograph-structured focus mechanism that keeps the disc in parallel are mounted on the die-cast frame. In addition, the single-beam system, which eliminates the influence of the side-beam, ensures high optical performance. This high-precision pick-up mechanism suppresses excessive load fluctuations in the servo circuit, reducing the influence on the power supply and jitter.The digital filter uses an 8 x oversampling digital filter and the D/A converter is equipped with a high-precision 18-bit DAC. The requantization error and distortion associated with DA conversion are overcome by the pursuit of accuracy, and the configuration is simple enough to cover the basics of the converter. This reduces the burden of complex arithmetic processing and minimizes digital noise.The top panel and bottom plate face each other obliquely, and the body is sandwiched in a wedge shape to form a strong structure. This eliminates natural vibrations and twisting, and ensures excellent stability against external vibrations.In addition, materials with different vibration modes, such as FRP, aluminum, steel plate, and wood, are placed in appropriate positions to minimize resonance and enhance synthesis of the entire structure.By separating the substrate of the servo circuit, which is sensitive to vibration, from the mechanism, the effect of slight vibration is shielded.The power supply section is equipped with a 100 VA class power transformer to achieve excellent regulation.In addition, the DAC / analog section, control section, accessory section, FL display section and FL heater section are each supplied with power from separate windings. By configuring an independent power source in the Line 5, interference between circuits is suppressed and noise is prevented from entering the signal path.The power supply for power supply for the analog section is provided with an electrostatic shield from the winding inside the transformer for thorough cleaning. Moreover, by forming a strong power supply circuit, the instantaneous movement of the mechanism that consumes a large current is prevented from affecting the log signal.A bus bar is used for the power supply circuit, and by suppressing impedance fluctuation when power is supplied to each circuit, a margin for instantaneous current supply is secured.Noise reduction measures are taken by utilizing know-how acquired in amplifier manufacturing such as selection of appropriate circuits and processing of more advanced ground patterns. In addition to eliminating noise sources by adopting shield plates and changing layout, the SN ratio in the sense of hearing is improved by thorough measures against high-frequency noise.High-quality parts are used everywhere to maximize performance from a simple circuit configuration.Custom parts such as pure focus condenser for sound quality, RMA resistance, originally developed electrolytic condenser for sound quality, and copper foil styrene condenser with copper tube are adopted.Analog output is equipped with one fixed output, and digital output is equipped with one coaxial output terminal.The D-500 has a thorough internal polarity control.It is also equipped with a line phase sensor that can control the power polarity (plug insertion direction).Wireless remote control is included.

sections.title: LUXMAN D-500XS
sections.overview: A top-loading CD player.The D-500X's uses a front loading system that eliminates unstable structures such as trays, and the recess for disk ejection is designed to prevent turbulence, thereby eliminating the cause of unnecessary vibration from the root.In addition, the entire loading section has a floating structure and is attached to a strong base to provide a mechanism that is extremely resistant to external vibration. By taking measures against such vibration, tracing performance has been dramatically improved.The Philips CDM-3 mechanism is used as the pickup mechanism.This pickup is a die-cast swing arm with a clear fulcrum. The pantograph shape of the arm has a focus mechanism mounted on the die-cast frame that always traces perpendicular to the disk. The single-beam system eliminates the influence of the side-beam and ensures excellent optical performance.A resistor ladder type DAC is used for the D/A conversion part.The high-precision DAC and 4-times over-sampling enable a low-gradient output waveform, which is processed only by a natural low-order analog filter, making it possible to play music without distortion.The power supply is equipped with a 100 VA class powerful power transformer, and the Line 5 windings of the DAC analog amplifier, decoder, operation, display and accessory sections are separated to provide a completely independent power supply with independent regulators for each section.In particular, the power supply for the analog section is thoroughly cleaned by applying an electrostatic shield to the winding inside the transformer.The chassis is designed to be completely non-resonant and vibration-free.First of all, the overall structure is wedge-shaped to eliminate natural vibration and torsion, ensuring extremely high stability against various external vibration modes. In addition, the main mechanism section has excellent rigidity and vibration resistance, such as reinforced glass fiber reinforced plastic, heavy-weight aluminum top panel, and sidewood, and resonance and vibration are suppressed by using materials with different vibration modes.In addition, the internal structure is designed to achieve high rigidity, non-resonance and non-vibration by combining a double-bottom plate design in which the mechanism part, power supply part and signal system are divided and a thick top panel.The front panel has a simple layout of the minimum necessary keys, which is combined with a multi-functional wireless remote control to improve operability.Each key has its own unique face full touch, providing a light touch but a sharp and reliable switching feeling.FTS is used for the program function. Once a program is stored, it can be recalled as many times as necessary regardless of power ON/OFF. In addition, a total of 137 discs can be stored (one disc can store five songs).The volume uses a mechanical electric volume with an emphasis on sound quality.You can check the volume level with the rotary indicator.The display system uses FL (fluorescent display tube), which generates less noise.In addition, noise control is provided by an independent power supply dedicated to the display and a ferrite core line filter.The output terminal is equipped with one digital output and two fixed / variable analog outputs.We use pure focus capacitors, RMA resistors, newly developed original parts such as electrolytic capacitors for sound quality and copper tube containing Styrofoam capacitors, etc. everywhere, and we use 70-micron copper foil circuit boards with extremely low circuit resistance.In addition, thorough measures against vibration have been taken, such as a copper heat sink, a strong mounting base for power transformers, and a thick copper plate on the DAC.PC-OCC oxygen-free copper wire is used for the part that affects sound.Copper plating is applied to the entire chassis.

sections.title: LUXMAN D-500XSII
sections.overview: This CD player has been further improved based on the technology cultivated in the D-500X's.The mechanism uses a top-loading system to eliminate unstable structures such as trays, and the recess for disk ejection is designed to prevent turbulence, thereby eliminating unnecessary vibration.In addition, the entire loading section has a floating structure and is attached to a strong base to provide a mechanism resistant to external vibration.CDM-3, a pickup mechanism made by Philips, is used for the mechanism.This mechanism employs a die-cast swing arm with a clear fulcrum, and has excellent features in principle such as mounting a focus mechanism on the die-cast frame that always traces in equilibrium with the disk according to the pantograph shape.In addition, high optical performance is maintained by the single-beam system that eliminates the influence of the side beam.The D/A converter uses the double crown mark TDA1541A, which boasts the highest level of accuracy among resistance ladders.This crown mark is attached only to items that have been certified as excellent selection items, and the double crown is a lighting with excellent accuracy.A newly designed pocket circuit board is used for the printed circuit board to reduce the influence of the printed circuit board on sound quality.In addition to pure focus capacitors and RMA resistors, we use newly developed original parts such as electrolytic capacitors for sound quality and copper-based polystyrene capacitors with copper tubes. We also use a circuit board with a copper thickness of 70 microns, which is less resistant to heating.In addition to the adoption of a copper heat sink, the bottom of the power transformer is covered with steel plates, and the top of the DAC is also clamped with thick copper plates. As a result, vibration control measures are taken to completely suppress delicate squeals.High-purity copper wires are used for important parts of internal wiring, especially for audio systems and power supply routes, which affect sound.In order to eliminate resonance and vibration of the chassis, the overall shape is wedge-shaped to prevent natural vibration and twisting. In addition, the influence of resonance and vibration is eliminated by using materials with excellent rigidity and vibration resistance and different vibration modes, such as fiberglass reinforced plastic for the main mechanism part, aluminum top panel of 4 mm thickness and side wood.In addition, by separating the circuit board of the servo pocket, which is sensitive to vibration, from the mechanism, the influence of slight vibration is eliminated, and by structurally separating the mechanism, power supply and signal system, mutual interference is eliminated.In addition, the entire chassis is copper plated.The power supply section is equipped with a 100 VA class powerful power transformer.In addition, the DAC analog amplifier section, transport section, accessory section, and display section have no dedicated windings, and each section is equipped with an independent regulator. The power supply for the analog section in particular is made clean by providing electrostatic shielding from the windings inside the transformer.FTS is adopted, and once stored programs can be called up any number of times regardless of power ON/OFF.This function can store up to 137 discs (1 disc / 5 songs).It uses a motor drive volume that has less influence on sound quality.You can check the volume level with the rotary indicator.The output terminal is equipped with one optical digital output and two fixed / variable analog outputs.A new type of highly reliable pin jack terminal is used on the rear panel, and large pin plugs can be used by expanding the interval to 18 mm pitch.Wireless remote control is included.

sections.title: LUXMAN D-600S
sections.overview: A CD player with an HDCD decoder.Equipped with an HDCD decoder, you can play HDCD.When performing 8 x oversampling interpolation, the dither signal is given an energy distribution frequency characteristic that does not give a sense of incongruity to the music signal, and the lowest bit is interpolated, so that natural realism can be reproduced even during normal CD playback.The D/A converter uses PCM1702, a 20-bit sign magnitude DAC, which eliminates the 0 cross distortion that is a disadvantage of multi-bit DAC.With 8 x oversampling, the folded noise associated with the D/A conversion is distributed over 300 kHz, so the analog filter uses a third order Butterworth filter, which is low order and has little effect on sound quality.In addition, in order to minimize adverse effects on sound quality, the filter element uses high-quality custom parts developed for the Luxman separate amplifier.In the power supply section, the regulator circuit for each supply destination with different characteristics such as analog circuit and digital circuit is subdivided. In particular, the power supply to the analog section is designed to ensure sufficient current capacity.In addition to using a sufficiently large power transformer, the windings are divided into four systems according to the application. By using know-how to prevent current interference such as STAR circuits, mutual interference via the power supply is prevented.The drive mechanism has a built-in digital signal processing section for RF amplifier, EFM demodulation, error correction, etc. which amplifies the small signal of the laser pickup. The output is passed through the shield box and input to the nearest digital filter. The control microcomputer which controls the whole process is also placed right next to the digital filter right next to the digital filter. The j-value circuits are grouped into a small area. This increases the area of the digital circuit and prevents a large amount of noise from being radiated to the surrounding area.A front loading system is adopted for the mechanism part.In order to achieve stable top-loading operation while maintaining the operability of the front-loading system, the D-600s uses a high-density FRP resin tray with low resonance and moderate internal loss, and is mechanically fixed while the disc is rotating.In addition, two channels pass through the center of the chassis to the front and back to stabilize the mechanism by forming a rigid structure that divides the interior of the chassis into three shielded compartments and virtually eliminates interference between the functional units contained in each compartment.The D-600s tray is designed to apply a slight brake just before closing to enable smooth and reliable setting.The transport section, including the tray section, has an isolated structure that blocks the influence of external light, making it possible to read signals with higher precision.Uses custom parts developed independently by LUXMAN.Not only the RCA pin terminal but also the balanced output XLR terminal is mounted on the output terminal.The digital output is equipped with a coaxial RCA pin.It has a headphone port.System remote control is included.This allows you to control the basic functions of the LUXMAN remote control amplifier and pre-main amplifier via the bus line.

sections.title: LUXMAN D-700S
sections.overview: A CD player equipped with an HDCD decoder and developed with the goal of playing CDs at the best quality.This is the first HDCD decoder installed in a Japanese model.In HDCD, recorded information exceeding the frame of the basic format, which cannot be recorded in ordinary CDs, is encoded in an empty area of the track, and this information is analyzed by a decoder and output during playback.The D/A converter is equipped with a sine magnitude 20-bit D/A converter to eliminate 0 cross distortion, which is a problem in multi-bit systems.In order to prevent interference between digital and analog circuits, the D-700s controls the effects of unwanted radiation by placing digital and analog circuits with sufficient space between them and limiting the area in which digital signals are exchanged.We also ensure audio signals of higher purity by designing boards with a rational layout that smoothes the flow of signals through digital filters, DACs, output amplifiers, and other devices.In order to achieve both the operability of the front loading system and the stability of the top loading system, we have adopted a disk tray locking mechanism that automatically locks the tray when the disk is stored inside.In addition, vibration from the outside is avoided by isolating the whole mechanism.The disc tray is designed to provide soft braking just before closing, ensuring that the CD is loaded securely.In addition, the tray section, including the transport section, has an isolated structure that blocks the influence of external light, enabling more accurate signal reading.In addition, high-density FRP material with appropriate internal loss is used for the tray to strengthen the structure, and it is supported by a rigid shaft to ensure sufficient stability and smooth movement.The power supply consists of five windings separated from the secondary side of the transformer and taken out, and the power supply for each circuit is divided by a regulator to eliminate interference through the power supply between each circuit.The drive motor is equipped with a leakage isolated motor with a structure to isolate leakage magnetic flux, reducing the influence of interference noise on digital and analog circuits.The analog output has RCA and XLR pins, and the digital output has a coaxial RCA pin.Gold-plated terminals are used for all terminals.System remote control is included.This remote control not only operates the CD player itself, but also operates basic functions such as L-507s/L-505s via the bus line.

sections.overview: CD transport with separate D/A converter and independent mechanism and control for complete non-resonance and non-vibration.The chassis has a structure in which a heavy class non-resonant FRP base, an aluminum die-cast chassis and a mechanical part are integrally connected, and in addition, it is floating supported by a special shock absorber. In addition, the recess for disk mounting / removal is made into a ammonite shape to prevent turbulence.In addition, 12 mm thick solid aluminum is used for the top panel, and by tapering the inside, external light which disturbs the digital code and air vibration by sound pressure are cut off.The internal structure isolates and shields the pickup section, microcomputer section and power supply section for each block to eliminate electrical interference.In addition, the chassis is coated with black paint on top of copper plating, which is desirable for sound quality, so that both thickness and sound quality can be improved.The digital output is equipped with optical and coaxial terminals, and an ultra-high-speed LUX type with a transfer rate several tens of times higher than that of the conventional type.The LUX type is connected using a special cable.The power supply unit is equipped with 2 transformers that are independent of the signal processing system and drive system. In addition, the use of 10 independent regulators for each stage eliminates mutual interference.High-quality parts such as copper plating, glass epoxy 70 ? thickness OFC pattern substrate and PC-OCC wiring material are used for all cases including capacitors, resistors, and transformer cases with sound quality measures.The switches on the top panel are kept to the minimum necessary, and programming functions are performed from the included remote control.

sections.title: LUXMAN KD-117
sections.overview: This DAT deck was developed by combining the know-how of LAX and the latest digital technology.Two digital input / output terminals, coaxial and optical, are mounted.A NEW pulse transformer is used for the coaxial output terminal of the KD-117 to improve the delivery efficiency.3-mode sampling frequency is supported.A sampling frequency of 48 kHz is set as the standard recording / playback mode of DAT and allows recording from line input, digital recording, and playback of tapes recorded in 48 kHz sampling mode.A sampling frequency of 44.1 kHz is a playback-only mode, and a sampling frequency of 32 kHz can play digital recordings such as BS broadcast A mode and tapes recorded in 32 kHz sampling mode.The sampling frequency of the tape during recording and playback is displayed on the sampling mode display.The mechanism uses a recording and re-recording system with a rotating drum head (R-DAT).In this method, the tape comes into contact with the head rotating at a high speed of 2000 rpm. Although the tape speed is as low as 8.15mm/sec, the relative speed is as high as approximately 3m/sec. In addition, the head is laid out obliquely with respect to the tape travel direction. The helical scan method is adopted, which enables high-density recording by using the tape space efficiently.In the KD-117, the drive system such as the rotary head is controlled by a digital servo system with a computer in order to realize accurate reading. In addition, by developing and adopting a unique travel system mechanism, stability and responsiveness are dramatically improved, and a trace without distortion is realized. This has succeeded in smooth tape travel and significant reduction of drop-out.The power supply section is a digital-analog separate power supply to prevent the high-frequency pulses from the digital circuit from entering the power supply line and ground line.In the KD-117, the power transformer is separated by five secondary windings to eliminate power fluctuations caused by mutual interference of each circuit. On the other hand, a group of high-capacity capacitors with a total capacity of 92,000 ? F is used to realize a pure power supply.In addition, an S. T. A. R circuit is used in the analog circuit from the power supply circuit to the signal circuit, eliminating sharing of the power supply line and ground line, and realizing smooth signal flow without mutual interference.Audio parts are used everywhere to improve sound quality.Dual D/A converters are used in the D/A converter section.The KD-117 uses a 16-bit 4 x over-sampling digital filter, while the D/A converter uses a ladder network type and L/R-independent dual configuration to provide excellent phase characteristics during playback and sound with a good sense of location.A GIC type 7th-order analog filter is used for the low-pass filter to effectively cut out harmonic components.A low-pass filter defeat circuit is installed in the through input of CD.The CD analog output has already passed the low-pass filter. By eliminating the low-pass filter on the DAT side, the quality of CD dubbing is improved.By using subcodes, various tape playback is possible.The Start ID and Skip ID can be used with the KD-117. In addition, a new mechanism that allows the start ID contained in the master tape to be copied as it is during digital dubbing has been adopted to improve usability.Equipped with 3-speed fast forward function up to 150 times speed.24-track program setting is available.Equipped with REC END search, which automatically detects unrecorded parts.It is equipped with a timer rerecording function that can be used for playing an alarm clock or recording messages.Equipped with a function to display the remaining amount of tape.Slide tray system is used for the tape insertion part.Gold-plated input / output terminals are mounted.Wireless remote control is included.This remote control can control two KD 117 s with one unit, improving the operability of dubbing etc.If the copy prohibited code is recorded in the digital source, digital copying is not possible.Digital direct dubbing from CDs is not available.There was a side wood sold separately.

sections.title: LUXMAN 5K50
sections.overview: Stereo cassette deck with dual capstan system.The mechanism section employs a closed-loop dual capstan system in which two sets of capstan and pinch rollers securely hold the tape. This keeps the tape tension in the loop constant and reduces level fluctuations and dropouts.In addition, hard stainless steel is used for the capstan shaft. The hardness is increased by quenching treatment, and the shaft diameter is increased to approximately 1.5 times the normal diameter.In addition, the roundness of the capstan has been reduced to less than 0.2 ? m and the accuracy of the pinch rollers and flywheels has been improved to achieve a wow flutter value of less than 0.03%, which is almost the limit value for a cassette deck.A 3-motor configuration with independent dedicated motors for the capstan, feed reel, and take-up reel is adopted.A crystal-controlled PLL direct drive type motor is used to drive the capstan. This motor is used for the take-up side capstan, while the send-out side capstan is driven by a belt with minimal thickness unevenness to obtain excellent tape running performance.In addition, coreless motors are used for both the delivery side and the take-up side of the reel to achieve stable pulling torque and back tension.The head section uses an independent 3-head configuration.It uses a Sendust head for the playhead, a ferrite head for the recording and erasing heads, and an ideal gap setting for each head, with a playhead gap of 1 micron and a recorder gap of 4 microns.Metal tape can be handled by replacing the head housing and bias block.The recording amplifier uses BRBS (Bridge Recording by Bias current & Signal current) method, a new recording drive method unique to LUX, in order to make the recording amplifier DC.In the conventional recording method, a signal current and a bias current are superposed by an adder circuit to drive a recording head, and a peaking coil and a trap circuit are indispensable for high-frequency correction in recording. However, when these circuits composed of coils and capacitors are inserted into the NFB loop of a recording amplifier, they cause transient distortion and phase shift, which adversely affects sound quality.The BRBS system adopted in the 5K50 is a circuit that takes note of the fact that current flows into the load when the balance of the bridge circuit is lost. It drives the recording head by obtaining a superimposed current with the signal current by swinging the bias current with the signal voltage. This enables high-frequency correction in recording without using a peaking coil or trap circuit.The playback amplifier section is also a DC amplifier configuration.In addition to reducing the distortion of the bias oscillation circuit, the recording bias output line and the erase bias output line are separated to prevent interference, thereby reducing the distortion factor of the erase signal.This eliminates most of the residual bias noise that is likely to remain during erasing.Bias variable method is adopted, and the bias value according to the tape condition can be freely set.In the recording mode, set the internal oscillator to 400 Hz, turn the bias adjustment knob slowly from the min position, and the indicator will light. This position will be the under-bias point of -0.25 dB, and turn it further to turn the indicator off. This position will be the over-bias point of -0.25 dB.The peak bias value is 1/3 to the right of the position where the indicator first lights up.Equipped with an azimuth adjustment mechanism.If the two azimuth beacons turn on simultaneously when the built-in oscillator is set to 6 kHz after recording and re-recording, the proper azimuth state is obtained. If the azimuth is out of alignment, the proper azimuth state can be obtained by adjusting while watching the azimuth beacon.A keyboard control circuit with highly reliable logic ICs enables feather-touch operation, and an automatic take-up mechanism is activated when a loose tape is attached, and instruction action begins after this is completed.In addition, the tape is designed to be safe against accidental operation.Equipped with a digital electronic display type tape counter using 4-digit 7-segment LED.With this counter, you can display the accumulation time for normal cassette tapes and the time for LUX cassette tapes. The selection of tapes is automatically switched by an electronic circuit.In the case of a general cassette tape, the rotation of the reel table on the tape winding side is optically detected and counted. The display is a general accumulation method, and the total count number is approximately 3100 for one side for C-60 and approximately 4650 for one side for C-90.In the case of LUX cassette tapes, the time detection roller mounted on the cassette body is designed to be 4.75cm/sec. (standard speed) in two rotations. The rotation of this roller is optically detected and the running time of the tape is displayed in real time.A 24 dot / ch. fluorescent indicator tube is used for the peak level meter.It has a wide indication range of -40dB to + 6 dB, and can hold -5dB to + 6 dB (1 dB interval). The attack time is set to 10 ms, the recovery time is set to 700 ms, and 0 dB is set to 200nWb/m, which is the Dolby NR standard level.For metal tapes, the maximum saturation level can be set higher, but a different scale is displayed so that the maximum is + 10 dB.By integrating the mechanism of the cute review into one lever, the operability of the heading is improved.Equipped with a recording mute function and an equalizer 3-stage switching function (CrO2, normal, EX).Equipped with a Dolby noise reduction system with calibration.Remote control unit AK-I (sold separately) allows remote operation.The AK-I has the same layout of operation buttons as that of the main unit. In addition to normal operation, autoplay and autorewind are possible as operation functions. Although these functions are switchable, they can be combined for autorepeat operation.The cord length of AK-I is 5m.

sections.title: LUXMAN K-03
sections.overview: This is a cassette deck that inherits the techniques used in the K 05 and K 04.GT transport is adopted for the mechanism part.The GT Transport has a structure that reconsiders the driving system mechanism as a whole and pursues accuracy. The capstan bearing and pinch roller bearing are integrally molded into the motor frame chassis using technology applied to camera body manufacturing, etc. This ensures that the capstan and pinch roller axes are strictly perpendicular to the chassis and that the axes are perfectly parallel to each other.In addition, the two capstan bearings provide a difference in peripheral speed to give a stable tension to the tape and ensure proper tape touch to the head.The head part uses LUX original ultra-precision combination head.With this head, the head gap positions for recording and playback are very close, and the position can be fixed accurately. The K-03 has finished the azimuth adjustment at the time of head manufacturing with accuracy of micron order.Equipped with 2-speed FF/REW function which adds high-speed FF and high-speed REW.Also, a music search that automatically searches for and plays a song just by specifying the number of songs you are listening to. By setting the length of the tape in advance, it displays the remaining time of the tape during playback and FF/REW. It is equipped with functions such as a time memory that automatically stops the tape after running it for any time.It also includes 18 other features such as blank search, auto-space, and MPX filter.

sections.title: LUXMAN K-05
sections.overview: A cassette deck equipped with GT transport and computer tuning.GT transport is adopted for the mechanism part.The GT Transport uses a dual capstan system, in which two pairs of capstan bearings and pinch roller bearings are integrally molded at high temperature and high pressure into a thick die cast alloy motor frame chassis. This ensures that the capstan shaft and pinch roller shaft are strictly perpendicular to the chassis, and that the shafts are perfectly parallel to each other.In addition, the difference in peripheral speed between the two capstan shafts gives a stable tension to the tape, making the tape touch to the head more reliable.In addition, the mechanism as a whole is designed to be robust, so that the vibration generated around the pinch roller is absorbed, and sound quality by stable tape running is ensured.DD motor is used as the drive motor.It is a 2 + 1 motor configuration that employs motors dedicated to each function for capstan, reel, and assist for lifting and lowering the head and driving the brake.Equipped with CTS (Computer Tuning System) as auto-calibration function.This function automatically adjusts the tape characteristics based on the best position determined from the correlation of the bias level and equalizer. It selects the tune mode that best matches the characteristics of the tape from among 1,048,576 combinations in approximately 20 seconds, and displays the entire process on the panel.The head part uses a combination head.A typical azimuth adjustment is to ensure that the head gap between the recording head and the reproducing head is exactly parallel to each other, but this is not sufficient, and it is essential that the head gap is positioned exactly the same relative to the tape on a three dimensional level, i.e., perpendicular and parallel orientation of the head relative to the moving tape, alignment of the orientation of both tracks, and head-base penetration.By using a combination head, the head gap positions for recording and playback are very close, and the precise positional relationship can be fixed, making precise azimuth adjustment possible.There were 2 types of wireless remote control and wired remote control which were sold separately as options.

sections.title: LUXMAN PD300
sections.overview:
Turntable equipped with vacuum disk stabilizer.

Vacuum disk stabilizerIt employs a vacuum disk stabilizer that adsorbs and integrates the phonograph record onto the turntable, and completely eliminates harmful resonance caused by the material and warpage of the phonograph record.In order to realize an adsorption system, PD300 uses a vacuum pump. This vacuum pump is simple, applying the principle of bellows, and is the driving force for reliable adsorption operation. In addition, two grooves and an inlet are provided on the turntable surface as an air suction path, and an air passage is provided inside the turntable, which is connected to the pump by a tube.When the pressure applied to the sound groove portion by this absorption system is converted into gravity, it is equivalent to mounting a stabilizer of approximately 50 kg, and an excellent stabilizer effect can be obtained.Suction and release operations are performed by operating the suction lever installed on the front of the cabinet. The suction operation is performed when the normal position is horizontal and vertical. At this time, when the specified suction condition is achieved, the indicator beside the suction lever changes from light to blue. This indicator detects the vacuum between the record and the turntable and operates.The vacuum disk stabilizer was originally inspired by the suction system of the cutting machine.Since the cutting machine system is designed to maintain the suction state by continuously sucking air, it is accompanied by noise and vibration, and there is a problem when it is introduced directly into the player. Therefore, in order to maintain the sealing degree of the suction state, the PD300 is equipped with a sealing pad on the turntable surface. This pad is installed on the outer and inner sides of the sound groove of the LP record. When the sound groove portion adheres to the turntable, it flexibly adheres to the record and creates a sealed state. This allows the specified suction state to be maintained for a long time even if the suction operation is stopped once the suction is applied.This sealing pad has been selected to be stable over time and is designed to be compatible as a service part.

Turntable partA belt drive system is adopted for the turntable drive part, and the effect of vibration and flux is eliminated by moving the motor away from the trajectory of the cartridge.The motor uses a brush and slot-less DC servo motor that reduces vibration by operating at a low speed of 10 x rotation speed. In addition, an aluminum die-cast turntable with a weight of 3.5 kg is mounted to obtain a strong inertial mass. This realizes quiet and smooth record rotation using inertial energy, which is essentially different from servo systems such as direct drives.The bearing part that supports the turntable is made of solid material and structure. The shaft is made of stainless steel and has a diameter of 10 mm. It is received by a bearing ball made of cemented carbide. Moreover, it is firmly supported by a large bearing made of brass and fixed to the chassis with a large nut of 36 mm  .

Cabinet partIn the PD300, the bearing and the arm base mounting part are integrated as the main chassis and are rigidly molded with aluminum die-cast. The heavy weight arm base is also firmly integrated with 6 bolts.This integrated structure eliminates the source of unnecessary vibration from the room of the reproduction system of the phonograph record, turntable and tone arm together with the effect of the absorption system.As a countermeasure against external vibration, we have adopted a cabinet with sufficient durability and weight. In addition, three main insulators are installed between the cabinet and the main chassis, and a large sub insulator is installed in the legs of the cabinet for double insulation system.This double insulator eliminates the influence of external vibration.The main insulator is installed in the main chassis, and the integrated regenerative system is suspended from the cabinet and dumped at the same time.This insulator adopts LUX's unique 2-stage braking system to block external vibration regardless of amplitude. In this system, the shaft is first supported by special rubber to cut small vibration by internal loss, and in addition, large amplitude vibration is blocked by a combination of viscous braking of silicon grease and spring.The horizontal balance of the turntable can be adjusted with this insulator.Sub-insulators are installed on the legs of the four corners of the cabinet.This insulator is used to support the player as a whole and to dump it from the stage. It is made of large natural high quality rubber.Sub-insulators allow you to adjust the horizontal balance of the entire player.

OtherEquipped with a turntable rotation fine adjustment mechanism, it can adjust both 33 rpm and 45 rpm independently with a strobe installed in front of the turntable. This strobe displays the pattern engraved on the back of the turntable with flashing light from the built-in quartz oscillator, making extremely accurate adjustment possible.The adjustment knob is provided at the bottom of the cabinet.Equipped with an overhang adjustment mechanism.The PD300 is designed to allow easy adjustment of the overhang when the arm base is mounted. When the arm base is mounted, the main chassis is held between the arm base and the mounting bracket and fixed with bolts. However, since the arm mounting hole of the arm base is located at an off-center position, the overhang can be adjusted by rotating the arm base. In addition, since the hole of the main chassis through which the bolt is passed has a shape with allowance, the appropriate overhang can be obtained by fine adjustment.The arm base is detachable so that the tone arm can be easily replaced. This arm base is 8 mm thick aluminum machined heavy weight, and it is fixed firmly with 6 bolts.Four types of arm bases were prepared depending on the shape of the arm mounting hole.Equipped with line phase sensor, polarity of PD300 can be checked.

sections.title: LUXMAN PD441
sections.overview: A player system with a floating motor.The PD441 has the same design as the PD444 and is compact in size because it is for one standard tone arm.Quartz lock type direct drive system is adopted for the drive part.By quartz lock system, disturbance load fluctuation of DC range and 1 Hz or less is suppressed, and instantaneous drift and temperature drift are suppressed.In addition, in order to suppress disturbance load fluctuations in the relatively high frequency band of 5 Hz to 10 Hz or more, which is beyond quartz control, it is necessary to utilize the flywheel effect of the turntable. However, bearing life is a problem. To solve this problem, we have adopted LUX's unique load-free spindle system. In this system, the weight of the turntable is canceled by attracting the rotor upward using the magnetic force inside the motor. This reduces the load of the turntable on the bearing to about 1/5.The chassis has a sandwich structure in which a high-density chip board is sandwiched between two 3.2 mm steel plates, realizing a structure with high rigidity and low resonance.Low-fo2-stage damping type insulator is adopted.This insulator is effective for both micro-amplitude vibration, which causes howling, and large-amplitude vibration, which is likely to occur during player operation.The arm base part uses a sliding arm base, allowing easy arm replacement and adjustment of the overhang.The arm base is a combination of a zinc die-cast base and an aluminum extruded material panel. It has a structure that slides on the arm rest rail and is fixed by the lever operation.Equipped with a platter mat, it dumps a turntable by improving adhesion with a record.4 mm thick acrylic board bonded dust cover has been adopted.

sections.title: LUXMAN PD444
sections.overview: This armless player system was developed as a player that can use two tone arms including a long arm in a minimum space.The drive system is a direct drive system that uses a quartz lock system.We have adopted a newly developed LUX's unique load-free spindle system has been adopted to reduce the bearing load on the turntable.The quartz lock system has the effect of suppressing the disturbance load fluctuation of low frequency components of 1 Hz or less from the direct current region. However, the flywheel effect of the turntable is important to suppress the disturbance fluctuation of relatively high frequency components of 5 Hz to 10 Hz or more, which is beyond the control of quartz. However, the bearing life is a problem. In the load-free spindle system, the weight of the turntable is offset by attracting the rotor upward using the magnetic force inside the motor, thus reducing the load of the turntable on the bearing to about 1/5.In the PD444 system, the motor itself has the power to float the turntable, so it is different from the conventional Magne-float system in which the turntable is floated using the repulsive force of the magnet afterwards.The chassis uses a thin, ultra-heavy sandwich chassis.The PD444 uses two 3.2 mm steel plates with a high-density chip board sandwiched between them. The high-density chip board with high internal loss and sufficient resonance absorption is sandwiched between the steel plates which tend to resonate, and it is tightened with screws to realize a chassis with high rigidity and low resonance.The legs are equipped with a 2-stage braking type insulator.The lower fo (lowest resonance frequency) and the higher Q (sharpness of resonance) of an insulator, the better cutoff characteristics can be obtained. However, if Q is simply set too high, the insulator becomes unstable against large amplitude vibration near fo, making it difficult for the player to operate.In order to cope with these conflicting conditions, a two stage damping type insulator was developed. The shaft of the insulator is supported by neoprene rubber to ensure high insulation against micro-width vibration, which causes howling. In addition, for large amplitude vibration, which is likely to occur during player operation or due to the structure of Japanese houses, viscous damping of neoprene rubber coated with silicon grease and structure of spring are used to improve operability.It uses a platter mat that matches the shape of the record, and there are many contact surfaces with the record so that there is no unnecessary space between the record and the mat.The surface uses special synthetic leather that is easy to match with records. Also, the turntable itself uses high-density rubber so that it can be dumped powerfully.The dust cover uses a 2.5 kg total weight dust cover with excellent howling characteristics made of a 4 mm thick acrylic board bonded together.By incorporating a dust cover hinge into the thin chassis body, it fits into a slim player. In addition, a semi-free stop hinge is adopted so that all the weight of the dust cover is applied to the player body when it is closed.The arm base has a sliding structure that can be attached and detached with one touch.It is structured so that it can be fixed by operating the lever at the optimum position according to the overhang gauge written on the panel surface while sliding.For the arm base material, zinc die-cast is adopted in consideration of the howling characteristics, and for the arm panel, aluminum extruded material of 5 mm thickness is adopted in consideration of the beauty of mounting and surface treatment of various tone arms.

sections.title: LUXMAN PD555
sections.overview:
Set :   450,000 (released in April 1980)Body PD555:   330,000 (released in April 1980)Unit VS555 :   120,000 (available April 1980)

Turntable equipped with vacuum disk stabilizer.

Vacuum disk stabilizerIt employs a vacuum disk stabilizer that adsorbs and integrates the phonograph record onto the turntable, and completely eliminates the resonance of the phonograph record and the low-frequency resonance (5Hz-10Hz) of the arm and cartridge caused by warping.The PD555 has a structure to connect an external stabilizer unit to a groove and an inlet on the turntable surface for air intake and an inlet passage inside the turntable. When the stabilizer is turned ON, the atmospheric pressure presses the record against the turntable. When the pressure is converted into weight, approximately 250 kg of stabilizer is applied to the adsorption part.In order to realize an adsorption system, PD300 uses a vacuum pump. This vacuum pump is simple, applying the principle of bellows, and is the driving force for reliable adsorption operation. In addition, two grooves and an inlet are provided on the turntable surface as an air suction path, and an air passage is provided inside the turntable, which is connected to the pump by a tube.Air-tightness is maintained for a long time after the stabilizer absorbs the phonograph. This is due to the sealing effect of the sealing pad installed on the turntable surface and the sealing ring and liquid packing (silicone) used to keep the air passage airtight.Therefore, the stabilizer unit only needs to operate when air is sucked in and when air is released, so there is no effect of noise caused by the operation of the stabilizer unit.The stabilizer can be turned on/off with the switch on the top of the player.In addition, only one touch connection between the remote cable and the suction tube is required for the connection to the player body. Each of them is 2m long, so it can be installed freely according to the conditions of the installation place and room.The degree of adsorption can be monitored by a vacuum meter on the top of the player.When the stabilizer switch is turned on, the pump in the unit operates for one stroke. At the same time, the vacuum meter displays the degree of vacuum between the record board and turntable as the difference (unit : cmHg) from the outside air pressure.High-precision meters for commercial use have been adopted to increase reliability as monitors.Equipped with auto-stabilizer function.With this function, the stabilizer can be linked to record rotation ON / OFF. If the auto-stabilizer selector switch located under the player board is set to ON, the auto-stabilizer is attracted at the start of record rotation and released at the stop.

Turntable partThe PD555 uses a turntable and sub-turntable structure.The drive section uses a belt drive system, which is driven by a brush and slotless DC servo motor. Weight 8.5 kg, moment of inertia 1.2t ? cm2By utilizing the powerful energy of the high inertia turntable, quiet record rotation is realized.The turntable uses a cast system.Instead of the die-casting method for mass production, we adopted a casting method that provides more precise accuracy. Using high-purity aluminum material, we created a new shape relatively slowly under pressure, and finished it with precision. This not only achieves high surface accuracy, but also thoroughly removes bubbles generated inside, making the density highly uniform. In addition, resonance is eliminated by making the shape close to a shape that can be called a mass with few inner dents.The sub-turntable uses a surface receiving structure with a wide contact surface to completely eliminate the resonance of the turntable.In addition, as with turntables, aluminum casts have been used to improve rotational accuracy. In particular, high accuracy has been given to the contact surface with the internal bearing part and the air intake passage part, and sufficient measures have been taken to maintain airtightness.

Cabinet partThe chassis structure consists of a 3-mm-thick steel plate and a 24-mm-thick laminated plywood sandwiched between extruded aluminum plates and aluminum plates. In addition, a damping adhesive tape with internal loss is used between the aluminum and plywood to ensure strength and eliminate resonance.Uses LUX's original 2-stage braking type insulator for the leg part.When an insulator is used to dump unwanted vibrations that are caused by external factors, the lower the fo (lowest resonance frequency) and the higher the Q (sharpness of resonance) at fo, the better the isolation characteristics against general vibrations. However, simply increasing the Q simply causes instability against large amplitude vibrations near fo.In the PD555, the shaft is supported by neoprene rubber in a high-compliance state, and Q is raised to cut off small vibrations. For large amplitude vibrations, viscous braking of silicon grease is combined with a spring. This is a two stage braking system.

Arm baseIn PD555, 2 arms including long arm can be mounted with one touch.The arm is attached and detached using a sliding arm base. This method is inspired by the slide bed used in lathes. It can be attached securely with simple operation and can be positioned precisely. Slide the base along the arm rail and fix it at the optimum position by looking at the overhang gauge written on the panel surface.The arm base is made of zinc die-cast considering the howling characteristics.

OtherEquipped with a rotating speed fine adjustment function, the rotating speed can be finely adjusted while watching the strobe installed beside the turntable.The PD555 can be switched between 33 rpm, 45 rpm and 78 rpm. In addition, the strobe can be accurately adjusted by displaying a unique pattern on the back of the turntable with flashing light from a crystal oscillator.Equipped with an overhang gauge.Generally, it takes time to adjust the overhang by loosening the fixing screw of the cartridge. However, with the PD555, it can be done only by sliding the arm base. Moreover, the arm and cartridge can be easily replaced with a gauge provided on the panel surface.It can also be used as a high inertia belt drive turntable without using the vacuum disk stabilizer.For this purpose, it comes with a platter mat shaped to support only the sound groove part.

The LX77 has been made even more compact in size and is a speaker system that pursues sound quality.A 25 cm diameter high-compliance unit is adopted for the low frequency band, and a long voice coil realizes a strong and light low sound.A 4 cm diameter dome type unit is adopted for the middle area.In addition to improving directivity, it eliminates split vibration in the audible band that prevents sound clarity, and improves transient characteristics and distortion characteristics.Cloth is used for the edge, the fo is greatly lowered, and the low frequency range is smoothly connected by melting.A 3.3 cm diameter Lux-type direct ring type is used for the high band.This tweeter drives the split vibration out of the audible band, only the complete inertial control range, and flatts the response to 22000 Hz.Directivity is also excellent due to the well-considered diaphragm shape and the effect of equalization.The network is assumed to be -12dB/oct.The speaker unit is designed to match the impedance characteristics of the speaker unit. For example, in order to improve the connection between the woofer and the squaker, a network with a unique circuit arrangement is adopted to solve the peak of the shoulder characteristics on the low-cut side of the middle range that appears in the speaker load, or the effect of the squaker on the fo characteristics, so that the sound connection is smooth.Lauan plywood is used for the enclosure, with 25 mm thick upper and lower panels and 18 mm thick front, rear and side panels.The reinforcement is T-shaped in the front and back, and reinforcing bars are passed through the side to prevent harmful resonance, and the finish is Shiraki finish.In addition, a sufficient amount of Bond Acetate Fiber, which has excellent sound absorption effect, is contained in the sound absorbing material to dump low frequencies and prevent standing waves from occurring.

sections.title: LUXMAN MS-10
sections.overview: This is a speaker system using aramid fiber that was developed over five years starting from the development of each unit.A 20 cm cone type woofer, C2038K is mounted in the low range.The diaphragm of this unit uses aramid fiber plastic cone made of two or more kinds of composite materials. The braided material (aramid fiber) is subjected to chemical treatment and then heat-molded to produce a lightweight and highly rigid diaphragm. The damper is also made of the same material as the cone, providing excellent tracking, response, and control capability.The edge is made of polyurethane foam in consideration of transient characteristics to achieve high compliance and low fo.In addition, a bar-arm type aluminum die-cast is used for the frame, and ventilation holes are made to reduce air strain generated behind the damper.A 2.5 cm dome type tweeter, D2501F, is mounted in the high range.A dome-shaped diaphragm made of polyester film as the base is used for the diaphragm. By using the same plastic material as the low-frequency unit, the sound connection is made smoother.In addition, a large ferrite magnet with an outer diameter of 70 mm, an inner diameter of 36 mm and a thickness of 30 mm is used for the magnet, ensuring a magnetic flux density of 11,000 gauss. In addition, a large power handling and capacity are obtained by using Nomex for the bobbin material.Both the low-pass and high-pass sides of the network section are designed to be -18dB/oct. In addition, the network section is designed to be driven according to the rate of change of each unit for ideal operation as a filter. A compensation circuit is also provided to reduce interference between units to prevent masking effects near the crossover frequency.We use carefully selected materials, such as low-loss type coils with low DC resistance and metalized film type capacitors.The enclosure is designed using a multi-vent tuning method. Based on a sealed enclosure, several small holes are made in the rear of the box to reduce the air pressure in the box to an appropriate level. This method has the advantages of a sealed system and a bass-ref system. This eliminates excessive pressure on the cone and provides excellent characteristics.?????? rigid particle board is used for the material, and super seal (foamed sound absorbing material containing visco-elastic material), which has high sound absorption effect and can effectively suppress vibration of the particle board, is attached inside to reduce unnecessary radiation from the enclosure.The speaker terminal uses a highly reliable and easy-to-use lead-insertion terminal.

This prevents excessive pressure on the diaphragm, which is a problem with the sealed system, and also reduces the peculiar peculiarity of the bass reflex system.

sections.title: LUXMAN MS-20
sections.overview:
56,000 (1 unit, released in September 1979)

This speaker system is based on the MS-10 and uses a multi-woofer system to expand the low-frequency range.The multi-woofer method has been used to increase the sound pressure level in the low-frequency range by driving small-diameter woofers in parallel, giving them a sense of impact. However, this method has caused problems due to interference between units, such as degradation of sound image localization and intermodulation distortion due to the fluctuation of frequency characteristics and phase distortion in the high-frequency range of the woofer.To solve this problem, in the MS-20, in order to prevent interference between two mid - and low-frequency units, a partition plate is placed in the enclosure to provide an independent space, and the volume ratio of each is set at 3 : 2. The fo (lowest resonance frequency) and Qo (height of the lowest resonance point) of the main and sub woofers are changed.In addition, regarding the deterioration of sound localization due to phase distortion, consideration is given to the operation of the two woofers, such as the receiving band and attenuation characteristics. In particular, the network is examined from various angles, and the receiving band and attenuation characteristics are determined to solve the problem of sense of localization. For this reason, the main woofer covers the range from 45 Hz to 3 kHz, and the sub woofer is set to be 6 dB lower than the sound pressure level of the main woofer at the maximum point (250 Hz). With a special filter, the sound is received up to 3 kHz while being gradually attenuated at a slope of -3dB/oct. In addition, in order to reproduce clearly the band from 50 Hz to 500 Hz, which is the base of sound localization, we fine-tune the multi-network in which the main woofer and sub woofer are independent.A 20 cm cone type woofer C-2038K, which is also used in the MS-10, is used for the middle and low frequencies.This unit uses an aramid fiber-based plastic cone made of two or more composite materials for the diaphragm, making it lighter and more rigid, and reducing the sound inherent to the material.A 2.5 cm dome type tweeter D-2501F, which is also used in the MS-10, is used for the high-frequency band.The diaphragm is a 25 mm diameter semi-hard dome type made of polyester film as a base and has excellent directional characteristics. It is also made of the same plastic material with an emphasis on connection with the middle and low frequency units.The network uses a coil made of a core material with a low distortion factor, a film type condenser with excellent mid - and long-range characteristics, and a lead-insertion type speaker cable.In addition, in the layout of network parts, sufficient distance between coils is taken to avoid interference between the parts to improve sound quality.The enclosure uses a multi-vent tuning method.This system is based on a sealed enclosure (cabinet) with several small holes in the rear of the box to reduce the air pressure in the box to the optimum condition.This eliminates excessive pressure on the cone and realizes excellent transient characteristics.

sections.title: LUXMAN T-4
sections.overview: FM/AM tuner that adopts CLL (Closed Loop Locked) system.A CLL-type tuning system unique to LUX is used for tuning.This method is based on the transmission frequency of an FM broadcasting station controlled by a crystal oscillator. It is a total control method including the front end of the tuner, the IF stage (intermediate frequency amplification stage), and the detection stage. The basic circuit of the tuner is not affected by fluctuations in external conditions such as temperature, and a stable reception state can be obtained.This CLL tuning system has a capture range to adjust to the center frequency of the broadcasting station and a lock range to maintain a stable reception state, similar to the PLL circuit of the quartz lock system and the synthesizer system. Therefore, once the radio wave of the broadcasting station enters the capture range and is locked, a highly tuned reception state is maintained by a powerful feedback circuit.A built-in re-lock circuit (Dynamic Kick System) eliminates the need for re-tuning when the tuner is turned off.It is equipped with an Accu-touch mechanism in order to catch the accurate tuning point.The Accu-Touch mechanism detects an accurate center point using the control voltage of the CLL circuit and mechanically locks the tuning knob. When the tuning knob is turned at a normal speed, the knob is locked temporarily (for approximately one second) with a sense of force.The front-end of the FM tuner section uses a double varicon type with an emphasis on input-resistant characteristics. It uses an RF stage with excellent input-resistant characteristics using a MOS-type FET and a local oscillation circuit to obtain excellent characteristics. The AGC (Automatic Gain Control) circuit further improves input-resistant characteristics and enables clear reproduction of high-field-strength radio waves.The IF stage is designed for low distortion, and in order to make this perfect, the detection stage is combined with NEW Cadmium Racea ICs and special detection transformers.The MPX stage employs carefully selected PLL-ICs with high separation characteristics. In addition, a 3-pole type low-pass filter is independent on the left and right sides to improve the separation characteristics in the high-frequency range.The audio stage is equipped with an operational amplifier IC to keep the output impedance low and suppress the high-frequency attenuation caused by the shield wire.The IF stage of the FM tuner section can switch between two levels of bandwidth.For wide operation, two sets of ceramic filters focusing on group delay characteristics are used to obtain low distortion rate characteristics. For narrow operation, a narrow band ceramic filter is added to obtain high selectivity characteristics.In addition, a beat prevention circuit is installed in order to perfect the interference countermeasure at narrow time.Equipped with FM muting level control, FM muting switch, 5-level signal strength indicator, center indicator, etc.The T-4 comes in 2 color variations, the silver type T-4 and the black type T-4B.

sections.overview: AM/FM tuner equipped with an accurate touch mechanism and CLL-type tuning system.It is equipped with an accurate touch mechanism. If you turn it slowly when you approach the target station, it will be locked there.This feature can also be turned off with a single switch.The center point can be detected accurately because it is obtained from the control voltage of LUX's unique CLL circuit which locks to the transmission frequency of the FM station itself.The CLL tuning system locks the transmission frequency of the FM station itself, including the front-end / IF stage (intermediate frequency amplification stage) / detection stage, to ensure more reliable locking.The capture range of the CLL circuit is set to a narrow range for high tuning accuracy.The front-end is equipped with a MOS FET structure with excellent input resistance characteristics. The detection stage is equipped with Kado Racea detection that provides low distortion and high SN over a wide band. The detection stage is equipped with a stereo demodulation that employs a PLL IC with high separation characteristics. The circuit structure emphasizes basic performance.It is equipped with functions such as a test tone circuit for recording, an FM muting circuit and switching between near ground and long distance reception.

sections.title: LUXMAN WL500
sections.overview: An FM/AM tuner developed to match the SQ500X series.The FM tuner uses a dual-gate MOS-type FET for the front-end high-frequency amplifier circuit and frequency conversion circuit to enhance sensitivity, cross-modulation characteristics, and stability against excessive input in strong electric fields.In addition, the use of 4-row variable capacitor ensures sufficient selectivity.The intermediate frequency amplifier circuit combines three ICs and a block filter to improve various characteristics.The block filter has a selectivity comparable to that of the crystal filter and has excellent phase characteristics, so it is effective in reducing distortion.The multiplex circuit uses a switching method.This circuit improves the separation characteristics by adding a cross-talk cancellation circuit that cancels out the components that leak into the reverse channel from the left and right signals separated in advance. In addition, a low-pass filter that cuts out the frequency components of 16 kHz or higher is added to almost eliminate carrier leakage.The AM tuner section consists of one stage of high frequency amplification and two stages of intermediate frequency amplification to ensure sufficient stability.The intermediate frequency amplifier stage is combined with a wide-band transformer to obtain good sound quality, and the strong AGC suppresses distortion in the high-field region.A 2-meter system is adopted, and the signal strength meter and the center tuning meter are configured independently.It is equipped with a pure electronic muting circuit to eliminate unpleasant inter-station noise.A high-blend noise filter is used to eliminate high-frequency noise during FM stereo broadcast transmission.Many of the multi-path detection signals used for oscilloscope vertical signals are of low power, but WL500 is designed to amplify this signal to provide sufficient output, so that most oscilloscopes can be used for multi-path observation.The power supply section uses a constant voltage power supply circuit.

sections.title: LUXMAN 5T10
sections.overview: FM tuner of the laboratory reference series.In order to ensure high tuning accuracy and stability for all receiving frequencies, it is equipped with LUX's unique CLL method. This method is a total control method that includes the front end of the tuner, the IF stage (intermediate frequency amplification stage), and the detection stage based on the transmission frequency of the crystal-controlled broadcasting station. Therefore, it is resistant to external conditions such as temperature and enables stable reception.Like the PLL circuits that make up the feedback loop, the CLL circuit has a capture range that precisely matches the center frequency of the broadcasting station and a lock range that ensures stable reception. Therefore, once the radio wave of the broadcasting station enters the capture range and locks it, a strong feedback circuit keeps the reception state accurately synchronized. Therefore, even if a drift (reception frequency shift) occurs due to changes in external conditions, feedback is applied in the direction that follows the transmission frequency of the broadcasting station controlled by the crystal, and stable reception can be obtained.The CLL circuit has a built-in re-lock circuit so that you don't have to re-lock the tuner when you turn it off.It is equipped with an Accu-touch mechanism so that all tuning circuits can be adjusted to the accurate center frequency of the broadcasting station.The Accu-Touch mechanism uses the control voltage of the CLL circuit to detect an accurate center point and mechanically lock the tuning knob. When the tuning knob is turned at the normal speed, the knob is temporarily locked (for approximately one second) as well as the response.The IF stage is equipped with two IF stage bandwidth switching, wide and narrow, to achieve both excellent distortion factor characteristics and excellent selectivity characteristics.At the standard wide position, two sets of wide-band block filters focusing on group delay characteristics are used to achieve low distortion rate characteristics, and at the narrow position, two sets of narrow-band ceramic filters are added to achieve high selectivity characteristics.For the front end, a 5-row varicon dedicated for FM has been adopted in order to demonstrate various excellent characteristics after the IF stage, and the selectivity of each high-frequency amplifier circuit has been raised to ensure sufficient interference removal capability.The IF stage combines a Kado Racea wide-band detection circuit that realizes low distortion and high SN ratio, and the MPX circuit with a pilot canceler to improve the phase characteristics of the low-pass filter.In addition, DC amplifier configuration is adopted for the audio stage.

sections.title: LUXMAN 5T50
sections.overview: Laboratory Reference Series digital synthesizer FM stereo tuner.In the digital synthesizer method, the oscillator circuit, which can be called the heart of the tuner, is composed of a frequency synthesizer controlled by a phase locked loop (PLL), and the number of visits is determined directly by digital code.As a result, we have achieved tuning accuracy and frequency stability that cannot be compared with conventional analog tuners.The front end uses MOS-type FETs for the high-frequency amplifier stage and mixer stage, and a buffer circuit is provided after the low-distortion local oscillator circuit to improve the interference removal characteristics.In the intermediate frequency amplifier stage, two sets of 4-pole block filters with special emphasis on phase characteristics and ceramic filters are combined to achieve both high selectivity and low distortion by taking advantage of the advantages of both filters. In addition, a quadrature broadband detection circuit that is resistant to overmodulation also contributes to low distortion.The multiplex circuit employs a low-distortion PLL IC and is designed to provide excellent separation characteristics.A full-scale constant voltage power supply circuit is used for the power supply part.Built-in memory tuning function.The 5T50 uses a C-MOS IC memory element and employs a purely electronic memory circuit that is stored in a digital code. It can store and erase desired stations. There are seven stations that can be stored in memory. Stored stations are not erased even when the power is turned off.Auto tuning moves automatically when the tuning key is pressed in the UP or DOWN direction until the next station is located, and stops when the radio wave is caught.In manual tuning, if you lightly touch the UP or DOWN tuning key, the receiving frequency will change up or down in increments of 100 kHz. If you press and hold the tuning key, the receiving frequency will change at the preset speed. If you release the key, tuning will stop.It is equipped with functions such as a signal quality indicator that displays the reception status of the broadcasting station as a number from 0 to 5, a test tone oscillation circuit that determines the recording level of the tape deck, a multipath detection circuit, muting level adjustment function, scanning speed adjustment, output level adjustment, etc.An LED dial scale is installed so that the dial scale can be judged intuitively by taking into account the operation sense of the analog tuner. This system is equipped with 14 LEDs that display the FM broadcasting band from 76.1 MHz to 89.9 MHz every 1 MHz and 10 LEDs that display between 1 MHz every 100 kHz. The reception frequency can be judged by the double display of numbers and LEDs.In the Laboratory Reference Series, in which legs are attached to the lower part and metal brackets are attached to the upper part, and these are supported by metal supports, so that when the product is stacked, an excessive load is not applied to the product lying below.In addition, the legs and brackets fit together perfectly so that they do not slip or fall over.As an optional part sold separately, there was a standard rack mounting bracket of EIA standard.

sections.title: LUXMAN T-12
sections.overview: FM stereo tuner using quartz lock system.Equipped with an accu-touch mechanism.This mechanism uses the control voltage of the quartz lock circuit to detect an accurate center point, which is then mechanically locked. When you turn the tuning knob slowly to look for a broadcasting station, the knob is temporarily locked (approximately 2 seconds) with a sense of response, and it stops at the exact same point including the RF stage.Generally, FM tuners that use the quartz lock system have the advantage of being able to ensure extremely stable reception even under changes in external conditions such as temperature. However, this system operates to keep only the intermediate frequency constant, and the RF stage does not benefit from this system. In addition, depending on the tuning operation, a tuning error of up to 100 kHz occurs.By adopting the Accu-touch mechanism, this problem is solved and the advantage of the quartz lock system is utilized.It uses a loop gain equalizer that maintains a constant lock range across the receiving scale from 76 mhz to 90 mhz.This detects whether the receiving frequency is high or low and controls the control ability of the frequency control element to keep the optimum lock range at all times over the receiving scale.In the conventional quartz lock system, since the capacitance of the control element connected to the local oscillation circuit is constant, the influence on the local oscillator circuit is greater when the local oscillation frequency is higher than when it is low. Therefore, when the lock range is adjusted to be appropriate at a point with low reception frequency, the lock range becomes too wide at a point with high reception frequency. One station occupies a considerable width on the dial scale, and the pointer can be received anywhere within this width. This resulted in the tracking error of the RF stage.To keep the locking controlling force at the highest level, a loop gain equalizer is used.It uses a Dynamic Kick System, and even if the power is turned off with the quartz lock engaged, it will automatically return to the locked state when the power is turned on.In the conventional quartz lock method, when the power is turned off, the loop of the PLL circuit is cut off. Therefore, when the power is turned on again, it was necessary to reset the tuning to the locked state. This problem has been fixed.For the front end, a 5-row varicon dedicated for FM is adopted to take advantage of the excellent characteristics after the IF stage. In addition, by increasing the selectivity of each high-frequency amplifier circuit, sufficient interference removal capability is ensured.To further reduce the distortion factor, we have adopted a quad Racea detector circuit and a multiplex circuit with a pilot signal canceller to improve the phase characteristics of the low-pass filter.DC amplifier configuration is used for the audio stage.The IF stage has a 2-stage bandwidth switching function.At the wide position, ultra-low-frequency distortion characteristics are achieved by two sets of LC-type block filters with excellent phase characteristics, and at the narrow position, high selectivity characteristics are achieved by combining a block filter with a ceramic filter.
