sections.title: LUXMAN T-300X
sections.overview: A dedicated FM tuner with contents similar to 5T10 of the laboratory reference series.A proprietary C. L. L method (Closed Loop Locked System) is used for tuning.This system is based on the transmission frequency of the crystal-controlled FM station and controls everything from the front end, which is the center of the tuner, to the IF stage (intermediate frequency amplification stage) and the detection stage. It is not affected by fluctuations in external conditions such as temperature conditions such as temperature.To further improve the tuning accuracy, the capture range of the C. L. L. circuit is set to a narrow range.Because conventional tuning methods that rely on the center meter make tuning difficult, the T-300X uses the control voltage of the C. L. L. circuit to detect an accurate center point, which is then mechanically locked by the Accu-touch mechanism.The front end is equipped with a 5-row varicon dedicated to FM, and each high-frequency amplifier circuit is highly selective, ensuring sufficient interference removal capability.In addition, bandwidth switching is provided at the IF stage, and ultra-low distortion characteristics are achieved by two LC-type block filters with excellent group delay characteristics at the wide position, and high selectivity characteristics are achieved by adding a narrow-band ceramic filter at the narrow position.In addition, by reducing the distortion factor of the quadracher wide-band detection circuit, a high S / N ratio is achieved.The MPX circuit is equipped with a pilot signal canceler circuit.The audio stage uses a DC amplifier configuration.

sections.title: LUXMAN T-117
sections.overview: FM/AM/TV tuner equipped with an optimum twin detector, etc.High-sensitivity dual-gate MOS-FET is used for the front end part.It also consists of carefully selected devices such as ceramic filters with excellent group delay characteristics and high-voltage type tuning varactors.The T-117 is equipped with an optimal twin detector with both pulse count detection and PLL detection circuits.Since the pulse count detection method has excellent linearity over a wide band, the input signal can be faithfully converted into the output waveform. On the other hand, the PLL detection method stabilizes the tuning by dividing the local oscillation frequency of the front end, comparing it with the reference frequency, and feeding back the difference to stabilize the tuning. This method is advantageous in the weak electric field.Both of these circuits are mounted and used according to the radio wave condition to enable stable reception.Equipped with auto-tuning function of IF count method.Since the IF frequency is directly counted by the microcomputer during tuning, it is possible to tune with high precision within   10 khz for FM and   3 khz for AM.The TV tuner section supports sound multiplex broadcasting.The split-carrier detection method eliminates the possibility of buzzing due to video signals or sound quality degradation due to intermodulation.A 24 station random preset station memory is installed, and each FM/AM/TV station can store up to 24 stations.Equipped with timer program function.With this function, if you repeatedly turn the power ON/OFF using an external timer, you can call up the stored stations from 1 to 5 in order. This function enables long-time multi-station out-of-band recording exceeding FM/AM/TV and band.Equipped with a birdie noise canceler and a pilot canceler.By canceling the stereo pilot signal and its harmonic components, the high-frequency separation and frequency characteristics have been greatly improved compared to the conventional filter operation.The system remote control terminal I/O is mounted, and by combining the AV surround controller F-105, the T-117 can be operated with the F-105 remote control.Equipped with IF band switching function of Wide and Narrow.Equipped with 400 Hz reference level REC CAL function.Equipped with center tuning indicator and 4-dot signal strength indicator.Equipped with high blend function.

sections.title: LUXMAN 5C50
sections.overview: Stereo DC preamplifier of laboratory reference series.The 5C50 consists of two stages, an equalizer stage and a flat amplifier stage, and uses the same circuit configuration.In addition to improving the bare characteristics before applying NFB, nonlinear distortion that does not appear in simple continuous wave measurement is eliminated. Furthermore, by adopting a DC amplifier configuration, faithful amplification to the program source is made possible.DC drift due to changes in external conditions such as temperature is a problem with DC amplifiers.In order to solve this problem, the 5C50 has developed and adopted an FET with less noise and a large forward transfer admittance (Gm), and with a well-balanced balance between both units. This FET is used to construct a first stage differential amplifier circuit, and DC drift is suppressed by effectively combining cascode circuits, current mirror circuits, constant current circuits, etc.In addition, we have developed a Dual Monolithical Linear-Integrated Circuit (DML-IC) that blocks all of these circuits to isolate them from the outside and reduce DC drift. The 5C50 uses DML-02, which was developed for a preamplifier.The subsonic filter uses a variable dip type subsonic filter based on a twin T-type filter circuit. This filter effectively removes ultra-low frequency noise from 5 Hz to 10 Hz without affecting the audible frequency band as much as possible.The high-cut filter uses an NF type filter with attenuation characteristics of -12dB/oct. to eliminate unnecessary high-frequency noise without affecting the audible frequency band as much as possible.Equipped with functions such as 2-channel tape monitor function, tape dubbing function, attenuator with preset and Phono input impedance adjustment.The general tone control function is omitted, and it is equipped with LUX's own linear equalizer for active compensation of program source.A stable DC amplifier is realized by the use of semi-fixed VR and resistors with excellent temperature characteristics and low noise, as well as silbird mica type capacitors with excellent high-frequency characteristics.It uses a newly developed lever switch that is highly reliable and comfortable to the touch, as well as a precision-class detent volume with less left-right tracking error.In the Laboratory Reference Series, in which legs are attached to the lower part and metal brackets are attached to the upper part, and these are supported by metal supports, so that when the product is stacked, an excessive load is not applied to the product lying below.In addition, the legs and brackets fit together perfectly so that they do not slip or fall over.As an optional part sold separately, there was a standard rack mounting bracket of EIA standard.

sections.title: LUXMAN C-05
sections.overview: A preamplifier that uses a single-stage amplifier along with the M-05.The C-05 employs a class A symmetrical push-pull operation in all stages of the head amplifier, equalizer amplifier and flat amplifier, making it an amplifier circuit with extremely stable open-loop characteristics.The C-05 uses a single-stage amplifier developed from duo-beta technology.Luxman's original duo-beta circuit combines an appropriate amount of NFB for sound quality with a DC servo that tightens the sound image from outside the audible band. In addition to improving performance in the open loop before applying NFB, a small amount of NFB is applied to improve the performance not only in pursuit of characteristics but also in music reproduction performance.This duo-beta circuit eliminates the need for high open-loop gain, which is required when applying a large amount of NFB, and realizes a single-stage amplifier configuration without the second stage amplifier, thereby simplifying the circuit.The adoption of a single-stage amplifier realizes two epoch-making improvements.In conventional amplifiers, the second amplifier stage is an amplifier circuit with a reference to the power supply. Therefore, the power supply used as the reference for amplification fluctuates due to changes in the input signal, and the music signal is modulated. In addition, noise is induced from the power supply to amplify and reproduce the music signal. In the single-stage amplifier, this problem is solved completely by realizing an amplifier circuit with only a ground reference, and amplification with only a ground reference is realized.In addition, in the amplifier circuit, a high frequency correction stagger is provided for each amplification stage. In the case of two stage amplification, the two staggers interfere with each other, which significantly deteriorates the freshness of music. However, this can be eliminated by one stage amplification.In order to make the reference potential = 0 absolute, the common power supply and theoretical mid-point grounding are not left unattended, and the ground is thoroughly grounded. Moreover, since the impedance becomes high when grounding the wiring board, the chassis ground is directly grounded. In addition to simply grounding the chassis, the ground line for each stage is concentrated at one point to make it more perfect. This point is also the center point of the left and right channels.The oxygen-free copper wire is used for the tumor part.The head amplifier is a single-stage amplifier with a differential cascode using carefully selected low-noise transistors. The output section is also a Class A SEPP with a small power transistor with a heat sink. As well as a high S/N, high drive performance is achieved.The equalizer amplifier employs a symmetrical differential double-cascode push-pull circuit using a low-noise dual FET with the highest Gm at that time, and achieves both low distortion rate and high S/N by performing one step amplification with minimum load resistance.The C-05 equalizer amplifier has exactly the same circuit structure as the flat amplifier in the circuit diagram. It is designed with the idea of combining the NFB circuit that performs RIAA correction with the amplifier that allows complete faithful reproduction as a base. In addition, the load of the NFB element is given a sufficient margin so that the nuance and atmosphere of the music intended by the recording side can be reproduced with a sufficient margin, and the output impedance is low.In addition, by removing the output capacitor, coloring of sound between stages is eliminated.The flat amplifier section uses a symmetrical differential double-cascode push-pull single-stage amplifier circuit using a low-noise dual FET with the highest Gm at that time as well as the equalizer amplifier. The DC servo circuit is equipped with an operational amplifier with FET input.The power supply section is equipped with a large power transformer with a well-controlled winding. This transformer employs a compact and highly regulated circular transformer. We also select electrolytic capacitors for signals with extremely low leakage and distortion. Both the primary and secondary sides of the power transformer are subject to strict polarity control, and together with the line phase sensor, the transformer achieves perfect polarity control.For the power supply, the head amplifier and servo circuit are equipped with an independent power supply.In order to eliminate the adverse effect of electro-striction, the chassis itself is made of aluminum and the structure is composed of two layers of copper plates at important points. The copper plates and chassis are firmly fixed to prevent slight vibration.An extension shaft is used to install a changeover switch at a required point on the circuit to minimize the wiring itself.Carefully selected parts are used. Even non-polar film capacitors are used with the same polarity. oxygen-free copper wires and gold-plated pin jacks are also used.The input attenuator uses a precision continuously variable detent volume with excellent linearity and sound quality.There were an adapter for rack mounting and a wood case sold separately.

sections.title: LUXMAN C-06
sections.overview: A control amplifier that pursues faithful transmission capability and rich musical expression capability.The C-06 is equipped with a duo-balanced amplifier with excellent balance characteristics, and the configuration is simplified by a DC amplifier with pair-balanced operation for both balanced and unbalanced inputs.In addition, it minimizes the degradation of the negative-phase output caused by passing through a different amplifier (usually an inverted amplifier with a gain of 1) after passing through the amplifier, and achieves clearer sound quality by simplifying the signal path.The volume is equipped with a newly developed 4-string altimemate attenuator.This attenuator is a 4-channel 32-point attenuator that supports a balance input. By installing a separator in the center of the 4-channel attenuator, crosstalk between the L and R channels is eliminated. In addition, the attenuator is equipped with a glass-epoxy board, a gold-plated finish, a non-magnetic resistor, and a die-cast and extruded shield to improve the quality.The power supply section is equipped with independent L/R toroidal transformers in copper-plated cases. In addition, considering the interference of magnetic lines of force from the transformers, even fuses are installed separately to prevent mutual interference.In addition, in order to prevent spike noise generated when the first stage power supply circuit is rectified and charged, and digital noise mixed from the power supply circuit, the plus and minus windings of the power supply circuit are separated, and a noise filter with bifilar winding is inserted.The output terminal is not only a balanced cannon connector, but also an ordinary coaxial terminal with positive (positive phase) output and negative (negative phase) output.In addition to the line-phase sensor that can detect the polarity of the AC power supply, the voice quality has been improved by unifying the polarity of the total system. The C-06 achieves the effect of unifying the polarity because both the primary and secondary sides of the power transformer are strictly controlled for polarity.In order to keep the signal freshness by reducing the number of contacts in the signal system as much as possible, 34 nitrogen gas sealed contact relays are used. Moreover, one relay is used only for one channel to eliminate mutual interference.PC-OCC (single-crystal high-purity oxygen-free copper wire) is used as wiring material.In addition, it is designed with an emphasis on sound quality by using bus bars designed to reduce power source impedance, first stage blocks with reinforced shielding, glass-epoxy boards with monolithic layout with L/R separation shielding, non-magnetic chassis and rigid wooden cabinet that eliminate the influence of noise and vibration on signals.

sections.title: LUXMAN C-06A
sections.overview: A control amplifier that thoroughly pursues the ideal form of a modern control amplifier.By adopting an all-stage operational amplifier circuit, more ideal balance operation has been realized. Phase shift in the high-frequency range, which is harmful to balance transmission, has been eliminated, and reproduction power has been raised to a level comparable to that of RCA input.In addition, the coaxial input has been upgraded.The volume part uses an Ultimate attenuator.This large-sized attenuator is a 4-row 32-point fixed resistance type high-precision attenuator capable of balance input. It has an L/R separation structure to eliminate crosstalk. In addition, glass epoxy boards, gold-plated contacts, and non-magnetic resistance are arranged, and shielding and vibration prevention are provided by die-casting and extrusion materials.The power supply section is equipped with large-capacity toroidal power transformers independent of L/R. Considering the interference of magnetic lines of force from the transformers, fuses are also installed separately to eliminate mutual interference.In addition, in order to prevent the spike noise generated in the first stage rectifying circuit and the digital noise mixed in from the primary power supply, the entire regulator circuit is composed of discrete components. By preventing various types of noise that affect sound quality, music playback with a more quiet feeling is possible.Function relays and LEDs are separated from the main power supply as secondary independent windings.This prevents the relay and LED of the amplifier circuit from having a unique characteristic when connected to the power supply and affecting the sound quality.Output 2 of the output jack is not only a balanced cannon connector but also a common coaxial jack with positive (positive phase) and negative (negative phase) outputs. This allows the system to take advantage of the negative output.Also, by inputting a positive output and a negative output to the L/R respectively of a general stereo power amplifier, a monaural bridge (BTL) connection without using an inverting amplifier is possible.It is equipped with a line phase sensor that can detect the polarity of the AC power supply. By unifying the polarity of the total system, sound quality can be improved. Both primary and secondary sides of the power transformer of the Lux products are strictly controlled for polarity.In order to maintain the freshness of the signal, 27 nitrogen gas-sealed contact relays are used. Moreover, only one relay is used for one channel, giving careful consideration to sound quality.PC-OCC is used for the wiring material and high-purity 6N wire is used for the transmission line that determines the sound quality of the amplifier.Newly developed original parts are introduced everywhere. The first stage block with reinforced shield, glass epoxy board with monolithic layout with L/R separation shield, non-magnetic chassis and rigid wooden cabinet are used to cut off the influence of noise and vibration to the signal.

sections.title: LUXMAN C-08
sections.overview: A control amplifier developed with the aim of becoming a power amplifier driver that can obtain sufficient signal level required by the power amplifier and drive reliably.CSSC (complimentary service Single Stagger Circuit) circuit is adopted to improve basic circuit characteristics while minimizing excessive control.The CSSC circuit is a single-stage amplifier circuit of pure complimentary service directly connected to all stages. In order to remove the filter effect on the sound quality of the voltage amplification stage, the multi-stage voltage amplification is not used. Moreover, the transparency of the filter is improved by increasing the bare characteristics, and the natural reproduction sound is obtained.The first stage is a complimentary service circuit of FET differential and cascode-connected transistor with clear operation reference point with high impedance. The problem of vertical asymmetry in this configuration is solved by using dual-chip FET and transistor and thermal coupling.In the driver stage, a Darlington connected complimentary service emitter-follower circuit with improved current gain and reduced output impedance is used to enhance the power amplifier driver function.OD ? (optimized Dual NFB) B) circuit which makes full use of original NF technology.Because the circuit configuration is fully developed with bare characteristics of the circuit, 100% DC feedback is possible, and the circuit configuration that eliminates the DC servo amplifier that was unnecessary for sound quality is realized.The power supply section uses a power transformer with a double shield consisting of a copper core and an exterior case.Two independent secondary windings are used for the flat amplifier and the accessory circuit. For the flat amplifier, L/R individual regulators are installed after rectification to eliminate mutual interference through the power supply.In addition, the circuit and dedicated regulator are placed on a single board to minimize the power supply line.In addition, a high-inertia power source is adopted to further improve the musical performance.This is designed to increase the instantaneous supply capability and capacity of the power supply part, which is the basic performance of the power supply circuit, minimize NFB, and when the fluctuation is small due to time delay control, reduce the control to make the fluctuation more gradual. This enables natural supply with small fluctuation range even on a short time axis.Eight input terminals are installed, and in order to give priority to sound quality, relay switching by nitrogen gas sealed charge contact is adopted.In addition, by separating the ground side as well as the hot side, the noise around through the ground loop is taken into consideration.It uses a unique 32-point fixed resistance switching rotary switch type ultimate attenuator.Non-magnetic resistors corresponding to the attenuation at each point are mounted one by one on a glass epoxy substrate with a gold plating pattern. In addition, a shield structure made of extruded aluminum die-cast material is applied to ensure high sound quality.In the chassis structure, each stage is separated by a shield plate, and a 9-box structure with increased rigidity of the case is adopted, which effectively blocks leakage flux and high-frequency noise.In addition, noise inside and outside the chassis has been greatly reduced and eliminated by adopting a mechanical floating mounting system in which the transformer is floated from the main chassis, by installing shield wires on the entire surface, and by introducing anti-noise parts.In addition, a 5-point grounding FRP bottom chassis with high rigidity and high mass is adopted.Special attention is put into each part, and custom parts such as non-magnetic resistance, electrolytic capacitor, copper styrene capacitor, cohabiting bus bar, high purity 6N copper cable are used.In addition, a newly designed output transformer with a permalloy core and strict electrostatic and electromagnetic shielding is adopted.Uses unique seesaw tone control.By varying the feedback resistance in the NF loop, a linear slope is given to the frequency characteristics in a seesaw manner. Instead of separately performing low and high band peaks and attenuation, the balance of energy around 1 kHz is corrected gradually as a whole, enabling practical sound quality correction with excellent phase characteristics.Equipped with left and right independent balance attenuators.In consideration of sound quality, a fixed resistance switching type with non-magnetic resistance is adopted instead of sliding variable resistor.Relay is used for on / off, and L/R can be adjusted in 3 steps of + 1 dB, + 2 dB and + 3 dB in 1 dB steps.Equipped with line phase sensor, polarity management of power supply circuit is possible.

sections.title: LUXMAN C-5
sections.overview: This is a preamp that inherits the quality from the top end of the separate series and pursues more usability.The circuit is a double SSC (Single Stagger Circuit) circuit capable of high-quality balanced input.In this circuit, the amplifier circuit operates as if the amplifier circuit is composed of a single stage, increasing the wide frequency range and the potential of the whole circuit. In the C-5, high-density integrated circuits constituting the SSC are put into the input buffer stage and the flat amplifier stage. By drastically improving the frequency characteristics in the ultra-high frequency range outside the audible band, stable operation with almost no need for local phase correction is realized.In addition, a fully balanced amplifier stage composed of 4 amplifiers with low noise and wide range with high slew rate is formed by IC.The power supply section is equipped with a high-inertia power supply.In the high-inertia power supply, the sound quality is improved and natural music expression is realized by configuring the power supply part with sufficient space so that it does not excessively depend on the regulator.The power supply section employs a newly designed large toroidal transformer with a high-efficiency R core to reduce magnetic flux leakage. In addition, it has a thorough shield structure called an independent power supply room, making it the most suitable power supply section for preamplifiers.Equipped with an NF-type phono equalizer amplifier for both MM and MC cartridges.This circuit is designed by combining a FET differential circuit with a high input impedance and an SSC circuit to realize an amplifier with low noise and accurate equalizer characteristic curve.There are nine input terminals : four line inputs, two balanced inputs, and two tape inputs. There are two RCA pin outputs and one pre-output terminal with a balanced terminal.The Top Model B-10 and C-10 use Lux Custom Parts which were created in the development process. It is equipped with a custom-made copper foil styrene condenser and sealed gold-plated contact relay for Lux Specifications.The internal construction is a separate chassis structure in which each block is completely separated by shield partition walls. sections.title: LUXMAN C-7
sections.overview: A control amplifier that employs a fully balanced CSSC circuit.The C-7 adopts a fully balanced configuration of CSSC (Complimentary Single Stagger Circuit) circuit of pure complimentary service configuration directly connected to all stages.In the second stage of the CSSC circuit, a grounded base type current transmission circuit is adopted. The cut-off frequency is set high enough to realize natural signal amplification without extra phase correction. In the C-7, this CSSC circuit is made into a fully balanced configuration, and the ground potential difference is completely eliminated to clarify the reference point. This allows each amplifier to operate on the same time axis to completely eliminate the phase difference and cancel out the noise mixed in the signal to further improve sound quality.For impedance conversion to ensure input signal stability, a discrete buffer amplifier of complimentary service configuration with extremely high-speed characteristics is adopted to keep input impedance sufficiently high.It adopts OD ? (Optimaized Dual NFB) circuit which integrates NFB technology accumulated by LAX for many years.In general amplifiers, NFB is used to adjust the sound quality in the playback band. AC NFB affects the sound quality in the middle and high range, and DC NFB affects the sound quality in the low range. In this DC and AC separate feedback method, a DC servo amplifier is inserted to control DC feedback, which has a large influence on the low range. Therefore, the sound quality in the middle and low range is inconsistent.The OD ? circuit used in the C-7 incorporates the bare characteristics of the circuit. By applying 100% DC feedback, DC stability is ensured while eliminating the DC servo amplifier. All bands are unified with natural tones.A unique high-inertia power supply is used for the power supply.In the high-inertia power supply system, the instantaneous power supply capability is improved by the adoption of custom electrolytic capacitors, while the regulation is enhanced. The total stability of the regulator circuit itself is ensured by improving the bare characteristics. In addition, excessive control that is delayed from the real time of music is minimized. By performing only the minimum necessary control, unnatural voltage fluctuations that fluctuate little by little are changed into loose fluctuations, making it possible to supply power that produces sound quality that is natural to the listener.It is based on a large mass FRP chassis base of 5-point grounding type with excellent vibration absorption mode, and realizes high rigidity construction which suppresses unnecessary vibration by firmly fixing parts to a thick hard chassis.In addition, noise countermeasures are taken thoroughly. In order to prevent the generation of flux and noise caused by the general arrangement of adjacent power transformers, chemical capacitors, and amplifiers, they are laid out in a positional relation so that they do not directly interfere with each other, and each block is cut off by a shield plate.Furthermore, each stage is reasonably segmented to eliminate high-frequency noise and leakage flux.An independent power supply room system has been adopted as a countermeasure against leakage flux in the power supply section.The external power supply system used as a a countermeasure against leakage flux, the instantaneous supply capability is lost due to an increase in supply impedance, and the efficiency as a regulator power supply is reduced.The C-7 uses an independent power supply room structure that completely separates power supplies such as transformers, rectifier diodes, and block capacitors from the signal path. This structure allows the power supply to be contained within the same housing and eliminates leakage flux. In addition, the C-7 is connected to the chassis of the main body in a semi-floating manner so that it is insulated from various vibration and noise.In addition, the constant voltage circuit is placed on the amplifier side to suppress the effect of control time delay and interference noise.Custom parts are used everywhere to achieve a high level of sound quality.The C-7 uses large non-magnetic high-sound-quality carbon film resistors, electrolytic capacitors, copper-styrene capacitors, and other custom-made products that meet the rack specifications. In addition, a closed-type gold-plated contact relay is used for various switching functions, and the contact area is increased by polishing the contact to improve the information transmission capability.For the level control, 4-row type level control with low distortion rate and low noise for perfect balance is adopted.This volume has been newly developed considering various aspects such as noise and phase problems caused by contact points.The tone control uses a NF type Lux-type tone controller.The input jacks are equipped with a coaxial Line 5 and two balanced systems, and the output jacks are equipped with two coaxial and two balanced systems. Bi-amp drives can be connected in both balanced and unbalanced modes.Two tape input / output systems are installed.Equipped with a line phase sensor, the polarity of the power supply can be checked at a glance.The power cable uses custom-made products with particular attention to sound quality.This cable is an AC inlet type.It is equipped with a remote terminal. By connecting to the B-10 or M-7 power amplifier of Lux, the power on / off of the power amplifier can be linked with the C-7.A 15 mm thick aluminum panel is used for the front panel, and a glossy wooden cabinet is used for the cabinet.There was a version upgrade service from C-7 to C-7i.

sections.title: LUXMAN C-7I

In the C-7i, this CSSC has been developed into a fully balanced CSSC circuit configuration, and the performance of the balanced configuration circuit is brought out by taking advantage of the characteristics of the CSSC circuit with a clear amplification reference point.Uses Luxman's original OD ? circuit.In general amplifier circuits, NFB can be divided into AC and DC regions. The DC region is relatively difficult to control and requires stronger correction than the AC region. For this reason, methods such as DC servo amplifiers have been used to improve correction. However, only in the low frequency region related to the DC region, colorization of sound quality occurs, resulting in inconsistency of sound quality with the middle and high frequency region.In the OD ? circuit, DC stability is ensured without using a DC servo amplifier by refining the bare characteristics of the circuit. By using the same correction method for all bands, uniform tone quality is obtained over all bands.A unique high-inertia power supply is used for the power supply.In this system, we have developed a large-capacity special electrolytic capacitor with extremely excellent instantaneous discharge characteristics to keep a loose power supply in the power supply section at all times and minimize delay control, which enables a natural power supply for the amplifier circuit.Exclusive parts for Lux's custom-made audio are used.In C7i, we have newly developed and adopted an ultra-low-noise custom-made audio resistor that improves reproducibility at the minute level by improving information density. This resistor is based on an acoustically excellent carbon film resistor. We have improved the amount of information transmitted by examining a wide range of matters including selection of alumina, which is a body porcelain, etching, carbonization, terminal material, terminal shape, and press-fitting method.It uses a large mass FRP chassis base of 5-point grounding excellent in vibration absorption mode, and vibration noise is reduced by firmly fixing parts to a thick hard chassis.In order to reduce internal and external interference noise, we have reviewed the internal structure and finished the layout so that it does not directly interfere with each other. In addition, each block is shielded by a shield plate and the internal filter is strengthened to eliminate interference of flux and noise.An independent power supply room system has been adopted. The power supply section is separated by a partition structure, and semi-floating processing has been adopted for connection with the main body chassis. By this system, leakage flux can be completely shut off in the same case by isolating both electromagnetic and structural.It is equipped with an internal filter to cut off noise from digital devices such as personal computers, power supply noise, radio waves, etc., reducing the influence of peripheral devices.The input terminals are equipped with a coaxial Line 5 and two balance systems, the output terminals are equipped with two coaxial and two balance systems, and two tape input / output systems are also installed.

sections.title: LUXMAN C-7F
sections.overview: Control amplifier developed as a successor to C-7 and C-7i.The C-7f is designed as a power amplifier driver with an emphasis on this point. It not only controls the audio signal, but also emphasizes the form of the sound, adds thickness to the harmony, and clarifies the character of each sound.ODNF circuit is mounted on the flat amplifier section.In this circuit method, we developed an ultra-wide band, high-slew rate, low-distortion circuit that does not require phase correction for the amplification circuit part of the music signal, thereby eliminating the complementation that cannot be avoided with conventional NFB. In addition, we focused on the part where distortion was suppressed for each music signal in conventional NFB, and by changing the method to feed back only the distortion component from the output to the final stage of the amplification circuit, only the distortion component is removed from the output waveform. This realizes a high initial slew rate that rises instantaneously and an ultra-wide band.In addition, by eliminating the DC servo amplifier for ultra-low frequency control, which has been the cause of unnatural coloring in the low frequency range in the NFB circuit, we are attempting to unify the timbre of all bands.High-inertia power supply is used for the power supply section.In the conventional method of controlling power supply according to music signals, the power supply is always delayed from the real time of music, which is a factor inhibiting the sense of dynamism. Therefore, a special electrolytic capacitor with excellent instantaneous discharge characteristics is installed in the high-inertia power supply to minimize the delay control by creating an environment in which a comfortable power supply can always be pooled.Noise isolation structure and independent power supply are adopted for the internal construction, and unnecessary vibration and noise are completely suppressed.The C-7f is based on an FRP chassis base with excellent vibration absorption mode. Vibration noise is eliminated by firmly fixing parts in a thick chassis. The layout is designed so that the power transformer, electrolytic capacitor, and amplifier board do not directly interfere with each other. In addition, each block is shielded by a shield plate, and the internal filter is strengthened to eliminate flux and noise interference.In addition, the power supply section is separated by a partition structure, and is connected to the main body chassis by semi-floating processing in an independent power supply room system. By isolating both electromagnetically and mechanically, leakage flux is strictly shut off within the same housing.It uses custom-made parts exclusively for Luxman.Based on an acoustically excellent carbon film resistor, we have studied a wide range of materials, including selection of alumina, etching, carbonization, terminal material, terminal shape, and press-fitting method, to improve the information transmission cost.In addition to large power transformers and large-capacity block capacitors, we use electrolytic capacitors, copper-styrene capacitors, copper bus bars, and high-purity cables to improve sound quality.High-quality 4-series volume is used for the balance circuit.The C-7f has a new gain-1 position for this volume so that you can take advantage of the C-7f without losing the balance of the audio levels of each channel set by a home theater multi-channel audio processor, etc.It has a coaxial Line 5 and two balanced inputs, two coaxial and two balanced outputs, and bi-amplier balanced / unbalanced operation.There are two input / output terminals for the sound recorder.The front panel is treated with hairline processing.There was a glossy wooden cabinet as an option sold separately.

sections.title: LUXMAN C-8F
sections.overview: As a power amplifier driver, it is a control amplifier that uses ODNF circuit and 4-row Altimemate volume.A flat amplifier with the same circuit configuration as the power amplifier M-8f is equipped with a control amplifier that increases the acoustic energy to the level that drives the power amplifier.With sliding volume as the theme, we pursued the problem of volume control from every point of view and adopted the developed ultimate volume.The ultimate volume with 4-row brass machined parts for a fully balanced circuit configuration has achieved high precision and low distortion with a maximum attenuation of -120dB and an interlocking error of   0.5 dB or less (0 ~ -90dB).The ODNF circuit is used to achieve a fast initial slew rate that captures the instant the sound rises and to unify the tone quality of the entire band from low to wide range. This circuit consists of a main amplifier, which is a non-NFB amplifier, and a sub amplifier, which amplifies only the difference between the input and output waveforms. The distortion component for cancellation amplified by the sub amplifier is sent to the main amplifier.For the C-8f, we have developed an ultra-wide-band, high-slew rate, low-distortion circuit that does not require phase correction for the amplification circuit part of the music signal, eliminating the phase correction that cannot be avoided with the conventional negative feedback circuit (NFB). We also focused on the nature of NFB, feeding back only the distortion component from the output to the final stage of the amplification circuit, removing only the distortion component from the output waveform, and separating the NFB method from the music signal. By separating the NFB method from the music signal, we have achieved a high initial slew rate and ultra-wide bandwidth.In addition, the NFB circuit eliminates the DC servo amplifier for ultra-low frequency control, which causes unnatural coloring in the low frequency range, and the tone color of all bands is unified.The C-8f uses a fully balanced amplifier configuration and the power supply system of the S. T. A. R. circuit that clarifies high-grade parts and the amplification reference point to bring out the true value of the balanced amplifier.High-inertia power supply is used for the power supply section.By installing a special electrolytic capacitor with excellent instantaneous discharge characteristics, we have created an environment in which we can always pool a wide range of power sources, minimizing delay control, and enabling dynamic power supply which is important for amplifier circuits.To prevent unwanted vibration and noise, the chassis uses a box isolation structure.Based on a 5-point FRP chassis base with excellent vibration absorption mode, parts are firmly fixed in a thick chassis to suppress vibration.In addition, the power transformer, electrolytic capacitor, and amplifier block are laid out so that they do not interfere linearly with each other. sections.title: LUXMAN C-9
sections.overview: A control amplifier that inherits development concept, circuit technology, construction and finish from Top Endomo Dell C-10.It uses the Ultimate volume that was developed as a sister model of the Super Ultimate Attenuator adopted in the C-10.In the Ultimate Volume, by improving the sound quality and accuracy of the sliding continuous variable resistor, we have obtained high performance such as an interlocking error within   0.5 dB (0 ~ -90dB) and a maximum attenuation of -120dB or less.For this volume, we have developed and adopted a new carbon composite that enables high-density distributed coupling as a material for resistors that determine sound quality. This material has an extremely low specific resistance component of the material itself and provides a uniform carbon layer, thus realizing an ideal resistor plate that does not contain any irregular R components other than resistors.In addition, in the conventional volume, when observed at the micro level, there were irregularities and gaps in part of the distribution of carbon particles, and unstable contact resistance was generated in this area, causing distortion and noise such as the third harmonic wave. This problem becomes more pronounced in the contact resistance between the resistor and the brush. Therefore, in the C-9 Ultimate Volume, the surface of the resistor plate is mirror-finished, making contact conditions with the brush more advantageous. This finish is not dependent on polishing treatment, and a special treatment is used to ensure mirror-finished surfaces, and a light surface finish achieves extremely high-quality contact surfaces.In addition, 80 0.1   multi-wire brushes are used to make contact with the resistor plate. These brushes are laid out linearly along the entire width of the resistor. The contact point with appropriate contact pressure and gold-plated tip enables pure signal processing without current distortion.In order to cope with mechanical vibration, which tends to be a particularly harmful factor in the case of sliding type, it has a robust structure from the structure such as the shield case made by scraping from solid brass to the mechanical part such as the 8   brass shaft rotating shaft made of the same material. Especially, oil-containing metal is used for the bearing part composed of 2 point support, and high accuracy without clear balance and backlash is achieved. In addition, the problem of magnetostriction is relieved by the adoption of non-magnetic brass material.A fully balanced CSSC circuit is used for the flat amplifier section.The CSSC circuit is a single-staggered circuit with pure complimentary service configuration directly connected to all stages. Since it is a circuit with excellent phase characteristics, stable operation is realized with minimum compensation.In the C-9, this circuit is placed on the hot / cold line and the two amplifiers are driven under the same condition. This eliminates the problem of potential difference and time phase difference caused by the amplification reference point. In addition, a buffer amplifier of the complimentary service configuration is inserted at the input to the CSSC circuit to feed the signal to the fully balanced CSSC circuit at high speed while maintaining high input impedance.It is equipped with an OD ? circuit to unify all bands with natural sound quality.The C-9 uses a CSSC circuit to dramatically improve DC stability. Moreover, by refining the bare characteristics of the circuit to a high degree, it is possible to eliminate the DC servo amplifier. In the NFB of all bands, the optimum feedback amount is set for each circuit, and by controlling the energy balance of all music bands, natural musical expression power is obtained.A unique high-inertia power supply is used for the power supply.In a typical power supply circuit, stabilization was achieved by NFB. However, the power supply voltage was constantly fluctuating due to the time difference between the real time of music and the feedback until the control was activated. Moreover, at a point slightly away from the feedback point on the time axis, the fluctuation became large, which had a significant effect on the music signal.In the high-inertia power supply, the concept itself of stabilizing the power supply by NFB control of the conventional voltage is changed. The power supply energy is saved by a unique large-capacity custom electrolytic capacitor with excellent instantaneous discharge capability, and a sufficient margin is provided for it, so that constant energy is always maintained without depending on NFB control.The power supply section uses a custom capacitor developed for the high-inertia power supply.The ideal high-inertia power supply is not only capable of storing a large amount of electric charge, but also excellent in instantaneous response performance, with as low output impedance as possible in all frequency ranges, and with little influence of the character of the part itself on sound quality.In LUXMAN, we have succeeded in tuning a special instantaneous charge / discharge capacitor for audio equipment through joint development with a capacitor manufacturer. By satisfying the conflicting requirements of large capacity and high response, we have achieved a high-inertia power supply.An independent power supply room system is adopted. By storing power transformers, rectifier diodes, block capacitors, etc. in a power supply room independent of the chassis structure, it not only blocks leakage flux, but also isolates mechanical vibration from the main chassis with vibration-proof material. This structure cuts off electromagnetic and mechanical noise sources and eliminates external influences.The chassis structure is a high rigidity construction with a large mass FRP base.Weight class 5-point installation By mounting each part with the bottom structure of the FRP base and the thick and hard chassis material, the influence of unnecessary vibration and resonance is shielded.High-quality custom parts are used abundantly, and small capacity condenser, copper foil Styrofoam condenser with copper shield, and sealed gold-plated contact relay used for switching signal system are custom-made products of LUX special specification.It is equipped with a coaxial Route 6 and two balanced systems for input, and two coaxial and two balanced systems for output. Either coaxial or balanced can be selected for bi-amplifier drive.It is equipped with two tape input / output systems, and the balance / unbalance conversion amplifier for recording output uses a newly developed hybrid IC chip to achieve high-precision conversion.In addition, metal type XLR terminals are used for the balance connection terminal, and materials with high reliability and durability are used.Equipped with an inverted switch for switching between hot and cold at the balanced input.Equipped with a reverse mode switch for exchanging L/R for output.Equipped with NF type tone control.It is equipped with a line straight switch that bypasses the tone control and balance circuit.It uses an aluminum machined extra-thick front panel with a special pearskin surface finish.The version upgrade service from C-9 to C-9II was provided, and the version upgrade of the flat amplifier board was possible.

sections.title: LUXMAN C-9II

This ensures stable operation with the minimum necessary compensation. In addition, in order to increase the signal energy to be sent to the power amplifier, a two stage Darlington grounded complimentary service emitter-follower circuit is adopted for the output stage. This circuit reduces the sending impedance and enhances the musical expression power as a power amplifier driver.In addition, the C-9II has a fully balanced configuration that combines two CSSC circuits to obtain high reproducibility of minute signals.It adopts OD ? circuit which is a unique NFB method.In general NFB circuits with DC and AC separate feedback, a servo amplifier is used to apply a large amount of NFB in order to control the DC region, which is relatively difficult to control. However, the difference in the method between the middle and low frequencies has created a cause of inconsistency in sound quality.In the C-9II, the DC servo amplifier is eliminated by refining the bare characteristics of the circuit, and the tone color is unified over all bands.Ultra-low strain rate, high rigidity structure Ultimate volume is used for the volume.In this volume, the accuracy and sound quality accuracy and sound quality in the sliding continuous variable resistor, high performance of within   0.5 dB (0 to -95dB) linking error of both L and R channels and maximum attenuation of -120dB or less is realized.STAR Circuit Pattern Technology is used to supply power from the power supply to each circuit. By supplying power to each amplifier stage in an individual route, the reference point of amplification is kept constant and contamination noise is eliminated.High-inertia power supply is used for the power supply section.In a general power supply, there is a difference between the actual music signal and the time from feedback of the signal until control is performed, which always acts as a delay control. This time difference appears as a small fluctuation of the power supply voltage and has a significant effect on sound quality.In the high-inertia power supply of LAX, we have newly developed and adopted a large-capacity special capacitor with extremely excellent instantaneous discharge characteristics at the output side of the regulator circuit with sufficiently high regulation at the AC level. By always pooling a spacious power supply inside the amplifier, we solve the problem caused by delay control.Large mass FRP chassis base of 5-point grounding is adopted for the chassis part. sections.title: LUXMAN C-10
sections.overview: Control amplifier with Super Ultimate Attenuator.The volume is equipped with a Super Ultimate Attenuator, which is an attenuator composed of four 58 contacts.In this attenuator, a fixed volume of 58 points is set by independent resistance voltage divider circuits and switched by ultra-large high-precision rotary contacts. By this, all setting of each volume is always composed of only two resistors (0 dB and one -   position), and the other resistors are completely disconnected. In order to make this into a balanced circuit, it is composed of four circuits. Carefully selected 456 high-precision fixed resistors are mounted discretely on each ultra-large rotary contact. The signal attenuation at the volume section is minimized by this super-ultimate attenuator.When you control the level of the Super Ultimate Attenuator, the waveform of the music may sound click-like in synchronization with the operation. This is due to the principle of the attenuator that the waveform becomes a step-up or step-down waveform.The C-10 uses a balanced CSSC (Complementary Single Stagger Circuit) circuit.The CSSC circuit is a single-staggered circuit with pure complimentary service configuration connected to all stages. The first stage of the circuit consists of a voltage amplification stage using a transistor / complimentary service circuit. While ordinary circuits require positive phase correction, the second stage of the CSSC has a sufficiently high cut-off frequency and realizes stable operation with minimum correction. As a result, a natural sense of freedom and sound field without atrophy can be obtained.The two stage Darlington complimentary service emitter-follower circuit ensures a sufficiently low output impedance.The C-10 uses a fully balanced complimentary service single-stagger circuit configuration that combines two CSSC circuits. In addition, the amplifier reference point, which is an absolute condition for the balanced configuration, is obtained by the CSSC circuit that completely eliminates the ground potential difference and clarifies the reference point. This realizes a fully balanced amplifier. By driving two amplifier blocks under the same condition, the potential difference and phase difference in time axis caused by the reference point are resolved.A buffer amplifier of the complimentary service configuration is inserted at the input to the CSSC circuit.The first stage of this circuit is a low-noise, high-admittance type silicon junction FET, and the second stage is high-f.TAnd emitter follower with high-Hfe-type transistors to ensure high input impedance while transmitting signals to the CSSC circuit with high-speed characteristics.A unique OD ? circuit is used to unify all bands with natural tones.In general amplifier circuits, NFB compensation is used to improve electrical characteristics. In particular, in order to ensure stability as an amplifier in the DC range, DC feedback is applied in a separate loop from the normal NFB. In addition, a DC servo amplifier is inserted into the feedback loop to provide powerful control. However, the servo amplifier affects the tone quality in the low-frequency range, resulting in inconsistency between the sound quality in the mid - and low-frequency ranges.The C-10 uses a CSSC circuit to dramatically improve DC stability. In addition, by refining the bare characteristics of the circuit to a high degree, the DC servo amplifier, which causes harmful effects on sound quality, is eliminated. In the NFB of all bands, the optimal feedback amount is set for each circuit by pouring the know-how of the Lux tradition, and the sound quality is unified by controlling the energy balance of all music bands.High-inertia power supply is used for the power supply part.The conventional stabilized power supply is controlled by a large amount of NFB, and by keeping the impedance of the virtual power supply low, the fluctuation of the power supply voltage is apparently reduced. However, there is a time lag between the response of music, which fluctuates rapidly, and the feedback of the response until the control is activated. When observed microscopically, the power supply voltage fluctuated little by little. Moreover, at a point slightly away from the feedback point, the fluctuation was large, causing a remarkable fluctuation in the music signal.In the high-inertia power supply, power is supplied to the load through a large-capacity capacitor, which is a reservoir of power supply energy, instead of stabilizing the power supply by conventional voltage control using a regulator circuit, etc. In addition, high-quality large-capacity capacitor with excellent instantaneous supply capability developed by LUX's unique know-how to realize this circuit is adopted, and a power supply part that retains constant energy without being affected by fluctuations in current flowing to the load is realized.In addition, the regulator circuit for charging the capacitor does not reduce the output impedance of the circuit unnecessarily, but uses the minimum necessary NFB control to keep the potential of the capacitor constant. This eliminates the problem of small power fluctuations caused by excessive feedback.The large-capacity custom capacitor used in the high-inertia power supply meets the conflicting requirements of large-capacity and high-response. It has been developed jointly with capacitor manufacturers for many years to tune the instantaneous charge / discharge capacitor for use in audio equipment. It was originally a capacitor with special specifications. This capacitor meets the conflicting requirements of large-capacity and high-response.In order to realize a cleaner and more stable power supply, we have adopted a completely independent power supply room system.By storing power transformers, rectifier diodes, block capacitors, etc. in this power unit, we not only cut off leakage flux, but also isolate the entire power supply room from the main chassis with anti-vibration material against mechanical vibration, shutting out both electromagnetic and mechanical noise components from the power supply.The C-10 is designed to eliminate interference between circuit blocks, electromagnetic noise from the outside, and high-frequency noise. For example, each circuit block is laid out in a completely shielded structure, while shielding zones of high-frequency electromagnetic absorbers are provided at important points.The internal construction is based on a 5-point grounding mass FRP base bottom structure with excellent vibration absorption mode and extremely high stability, and each part is mounted by thick and hard chassis material.This blocks the influence of unwanted vibration and resonance and prevents mechanical noise.The C-10 uses custom parts developed through repeated trial manufacture for power transformer and CR parts.In addition to the use of small-capacity capacitors and copper-plated Styrofoam capacitors with copper shields, the enclosed gold-plated contact relay used for switching signal systems is also custom-made with Lux Special Specifications. This relay achieves more complete surface contact by polishing the contact points.The NF type tone control of the rack system is adopted for the tone control, and it can be adjusted to suppress the undulation and unnatural habit of the frequency at the flat point.This tone control circuit tone control circuit is bypassed by a line straight switch so that a flat frequency characteristic can be obtained directly.It has two coaxial Route 6 and balanced inputs and two coaxial and balanced outputs. You can select either coaxial or balanced for bi-amp drive.There are two tape input / output systems, and the balance / unbalance conversion amplifier for recording output uses a newly developed hybrid IC chip to achieve high-precision conversion.The balanced input / output terminals are made of highly reliable and durable materials such as metal type XLR terminals.Uses an aluminum machined front panel.Inside the sealing pocket, an inverted switch for switching between hot and cold at the balanced input, a reverse mode switch for exchanging L/R for output, and a line straight switch are installed.

sections.overview: This control amplifier was created by completely refining the control amplifier C-10 by changing resistors and circuit constants.An ultra-low-noise, high-density information resistor has been newly developed and fully introduced, and a 58-contact Super Ultimate Attenuator II, a 4-circuit 4-train type with a perfect balance, has been adopted.Although 456 resistors are used, each volume setting is always composed of only two resistors (0 dB and one -   position), and the signal purity is obtained by completely separating the other resistors.It is equipped with CSSC and single stagger circuit of pure complimentary service configuration directly connected to all stages.In the CSSC, the current transmission stage with the grounded base circuit in the second stage provides high cut-off frequencies and stable operation with minimum compensation. In addition, the two stage Darlington complimentary service emitter-follower circuit is used in the output-stage to keep the output impedance low and to provide sufficient signal energy to drive the power amplifier.Using a fully balanced configuration that combines two CSSCs, the earth potential difference is completely eliminated, and the CSSC with a clear reference point is made into a balanced configuration, eliminating potential difference and phase difference on the time axis.NFB is corrected separately into AC and DC regions. The DC region is relatively difficult to control and requires stronger correction than the AC region. Therefore, DC servo amplifiers have been used to improve the correction.The C-10II adopts an OD ? circuit that achieves sufficient DC stability without using a DC servo amplifier by refining the bare characteristics, which are the basic characteristics of the circuit.The power supply section employs a large-capacity capacitor with instantaneous power supply capability developed independently by LUX INC. to build a power supply section with high inertial force that retains constant energy without being affected by fluctuations in the power supply flowing to the load.In addition, the regulator circuit is the minimum NFB control necessary to keep the capacitor potential constant, eliminating the adverse effect on sound quality caused by excessive feedback.Each part is firmly mounted on a 5-point contact FRP chassis base to eliminate adverse effects such as unnecessary vibration.In addition, the internal structure adopts a box isolation structure in which sections with different roles are separated by shielding plates. In particular, the power supply unit blocks leakage flux by storing the power supply unit in an individual unit, and the entire power supply room is separated from the main chassis by anti-vibration materials to eliminate all noise components from both electromagnetic and mechanical aspects from the power supply unit.It is equipped with an enhanced noise filter to ensure high-purity sound quality against high-frequency noise emitted from PCs and microcomputer equipment and noise mixed through power supply.From custom resistors for exclusive use, to small-capacity capacitors, copper-foil Styrofoam capacitors with copper shields, to sealed gold-plated contact relays used for switching signal systems, parts with special specifications of Lux are used.It is equipped with coaxial Route 6 and two balanced input / output systems, two coaxial and two balanced output systems, and two tape-type input / output systems.Both coaxial and balanced can be selected for bi-amplifier drive.Like a high-end model, the front panel is machined out of aluminum and has a champagne gold finish.A wooden cabinet is also used.Equipped with a line phase sensor that senses the polarity of the AC power supply.This allows you to always set the correct polarity.

sections.overview: Stereo control center using duo-beta plusX circuit.A duo-beta circuit is used to control sound quality while eliminating excess NFB in favor of physical characteristics. This circuit produces an amplifier circuit that is practical even with bare characteristics, and adds an appropriate amount of NFB and b and DC servo as a finishing touch of sound quality.By doing so, we can suppress the generation of transient distortion such as TIM caused by excessive NFB and suppress the suppression of musical performance by NFB, thereby improving musical performance.Duo Beta plusX is also used for the feedback circuit of the power supply unit, introducing the concept of appropriate control.In general stabilized power supplies, the impedance characteristics of the power supply itself, which is not stabilized, rise in the low-frequency range, and sound quality is improved. However, there are problems such as less damping in the low-frequency range and no stability in the DC range.In plusX, we have created a low-impedance power supply that does not need to rely on excessive feedback, and we have set control that takes advantage of this bare characteristic in the middle and high range, and control that corresponds to the amplifier circuit in the low range.In the equalizer circuit, cascode bootstrap input by high-Gm low-noise dual FET is adopted at the first stage with current mirror load to obtain low distortion factor and high SN ratio.High f with a dynamic resistance circuit in the second stageTA cascode constant current load amplifier circuit using a PNP transistor is constructed, and a high f is supplied to the output stage.TAs a class A push-pull configuration with transistors, current flows, and the output impedance is made low, and the load of the NFB element is also given a margin.The flat amplifier uses basically the same circuit as the equalizer. Especially, the DC servo circuit is equipped with an operational amplifier with FET input to ensure excellent DC stability.This eliminates the output capacitor and eliminates sound coloring.The MC head amplifier consists of a direct-coupled type FET parallel input at the first stage, an A-class pure complimentary service push-pull type at the outputs, and a dedicated constant-voltage circuit placed close to each other to reduce noise and source impedance.The power supply section is completely independent on the left and right sides from the transformer winding, and includes the rectifier circuit and constant voltage circuit to constitute a twin monaural power supply.As a result, interference between the left and right channels is suppressed, and at the same time, the winding direction is aligned for both the primary and secondary sides of the transformer, for thorough sound quality control.The transformer and capacitor of this power supply are large in size and large in capacity to reduce impedance.High-quality film capacitors are used for the coupling capacitors of each stage and the capacitor of the power supply, and small-capacity Styrofoam capacitors are connected in parallel.All of these film capacitors and most of Styrofoam capacitors have the same polarity for sound quality control.In addition, it uses continuously variable precision class detent volume with aluminum die cast case, oxygen-free copper 500 core shielded cable, etc.It is equipped with necessary and sufficient functions, and the wiring route is arranged according to the signal flow to simplify it.Equipped with a turnover shift tone control that achieves the desired balance with simple operation.The two conventional operations are simplified because the turnover frequency moves continuously according to the amount of change.It is equipped with a line-phase sensor that can detect the polarity of home AC outlets and unify the polarity of devices.Equipped with a twin T-type subsonic circuit composed only of passive elements.Various measures have been taken to improve the sound quality.We have completely eliminated magnetic distortion by designing the chassis so that magnetic materials do not come close to the substrate facing surface.The input / output terminal is gold-plated, and the secondary fuse of the transformer is soldered to the fuse holder to reduce contact resistance.In addition, the Tape system employs a remote switch to simplify the wiring.A natural wood cabinet is adopted, and aluminum foil is attached on the back side to obtain shielding effect.

sections.title: LUXMAN C-5000A
sections.overview: The control center was developed for the top-of-the-line audio system by LUX's unique technology such as duo-beta circuit.In order to improve sound quality, we have adopted LUX's own duo-beta circuit.In this circuit, the minimum necessary amount of NFB is applied to all bands, and a DC servo circuit is combined.This eliminates TIM distortion by reducing the amount of NFB by keeping the gain of the amplifier low. In addition, the DC servo circuit not only cuts ultra-low frequency noise, which causes intermodulation distortion, but also uses a low-noise FET amplifier and a high-quality film capacitor in the low-pass filter circuit low-pass reproduction.In order to realize an amplifier with low gain and good characteristics suitable for a duo-beta circuit, we have adopted a combination of a cascode differential input bootstrap circuit and a transistor dynamic resistance circuit at the input stage.In the output stage, a four transistor SEPP circuit is used to keep the output impedance low.In order to minimize wiring, all switches are remotely connected to the board so that the circuit on the board can be directly switched by the knob on the panel. In addition, multi-circuit switches are used in parallel to prevent noise degradation caused by contacts.In the circuit configuration, the left and right channels are divided into blocks, and each board is separated independently to eliminate mutual interference.Highly reliable connectors used in communications equipment and other devices are carefully selected employment to the connecting parts of the circuit boards, and gold plating is applied to the terminals on the circuit boards to increase the reliability of the contacts.The power supply section is equipped with a high-capacity toroidal transformer and a twin monaural high-speed constant-voltage power supply.For the transformer, a toroidal transformer with low leakage flux and high magnetic efficiency is adopted, and the core size is large enough to be used for a power amplifier of about 25Wx2, which is a common size, so that extra space is provided.In order to prevent electromagnetic distortion, metal shielding is removed from the opposing surface of the substrate.In addition, to prevent noise, we use double-sided boards to block the boards and use remote switches to avoid adverse effects caused by wiring. We also use specially ordered switches made of non-magnetic materials for switches.It uses carefully selected parts with an emphasis on sound quality.Considering that non-polar film capacitors also have polarity, we have determined the polarity and consciously applied a bias to solve this non-linearity problem. This DC bias generates a Coulomb force between the polarities of the foils inside the film capacitor, and simultaneously prevents mechanical vibration.The volume is made of conductive plastic in consideration of durability, sound quality and usability.In addition, the equalizer stage and flat stage, which are essential parts of the pre-amplifier, are made of tantalum nitride, which is the most excellent in performance, after confirmation by trial listening.For the tone control, it uses the NF type Lux System with a curved point switching.Equipped with high filter and subsonic filter.Also, the filter circuit can be bypassed when not in use.Equipped with socket corresponding to 8000 series booster transformer for MC type cartridge sold separately.This transformer uses the best materials for the core material and is a toroidal transformer using silver wire and Litz wire for the winding. It has excellent high-frequency characteristics.

sections.overview: This tube type control amplifier was developed by applying the technology cultivated in transistor circuits such as duo-beta circuit and DC amplifier.A 3-stage direct-coupled amplifier circuit is used for the equalizer circuit to obtain sufficient gain, and the output stage (third stage) is S. P. has various advantages such as high output voltage, large input resistance, low output impedance, and so on, as well as canceling distortion by operating to correct non-linear operation by itself.The flat amplifier employs a two stage differential amplifier circuit that theoretically does not generate even order distortion in a direct-coupled configuration.In addition, a tone control is incorporated into the NFB loop of this flat amplifier to enable defeat.Appropriate amount Duo-beta circuit with NFB and DC servo is adopted.Two types of NFB have different roles : an appropriate NFB that further enhances the reproducibility of the mid-to-high frequency range and a DC servo that enhances the braking force in the low frequency range. sections.title: LUXMAN CL36
sections.overview: As a revised version of CL36, a bulb-tube type control amplifier was created with extensive modifications including sound quality, mechanism, and function.The equalizer circuit uses a 3-stage K-K ? NF method (negative feedback is applied from the third stage cathode to the first stage cathode). The output stage is not a cathode follower but an SRPP (Shunt Regulated Push-Pull) circuit to reduce distortion.This SRPP output circuit is characterized by high input impedance and low output impedance due to its large output voltage and excellent distortion factor characteristics compared with the cathode follower output circuit.The first and second stages use a specially selected low-noise type 12AX7 to improve the signal-to-noise ratio. In addition, careful consideration is given to setting the operating point of the equalizer circuit to improve the distortion factor characteristics, such as canceling waveform distortion mutually.The flat amplifier circuit employs the 3-stage K-K ? NF method as well as the equalizer circuit to reduce the distortion factor over the entire band. The output stage is a cathode follower circuit, so the input impedance is high. The load condition of the second stage is adjusted, so the distortion factor characteristics and input resistance characteristics are improved. The output impedance is also sufficiently low, ensuring stability that is not affected by the severe load condition to be connected later.When you defeat the tone control circuit, the output is taken directly from this circuit, and a low-boost circuit using an NF element is inserted into this flat amplifier circuit.The tone control circuit adopts LUX's unique 2-stage K-G ? NF method (negative feedback is applied from the cathode of the second stage cathode follower stage to the grid of the first stage). The LUX method NF type tone control is followed by the cathode follower stage to adjust the load condition of the preceding stage. Thus, the tone control circuit achieves both excellent change characteristics and low distortion rate characteristics over all bands. The frequency curve point switching is provided at 3 points for low band and high band respectively.Since the output stage of this control circuit is a cathode follower, the output impedance is sufficiently low, making it an excellent output stage of a control amplifier.As for the power supply circuit, the B+ power supply circuit is set to a constant voltage to supply a stable power supply to each amplifier circuit, and a DC ignition system using a constant voltage circuit is also adopted for the power supply for the heater to prevent mixing of pulse noise.The headphone amplifier circuit uses a pure complimentary service OCL system.The ultra-low frequency filter circuit uses a twin T-type filter combined with a CR1-stage filter to minimize the effect on the audible frequency band without using active elements and to obtain sharp attenuation characteristics.The cut-off frequency can be selected in 2 levels of 10 Hz and 30 Hz to effectively remove ultra-low frequency noise.As with the ultra-low frequency filter, the high-frequency filter circuit uses an LC-type filter composed only of coils and capacitors without active elements. It has two cut-off frequencies of 12 kHz and 18 kHz, and can eliminate noise such as tape hissing and FM tuner carrier-leak.Acoustic control is installed to effectively remove standing waves generated in the listening room.This circuit consists of two stages, a twin T-type circuit combined with a cathode follower circuit as a buffer. By controlling the dip frequency adjustment (knob that continuously changes the dip frequency between 75 Hz and 150 Hz) and the dip amount adjustment (knob that continuously changes the dip amount between 0 dB and -12dB), standing waves unnecessary for music playback are effectively removed.When using this circuit, output is taken out from the Pre out2 terminal.The low-boost switch has a two point turnover frequency and can boost the lower range.In addition, it is equipped with functions such as a two channel tape monitor circuit, a tape dubbing function, a rec out off function to disconnect the recording output terminal, a -20dB attenuator, a time muting circuit to disconnect the output circuit until full operation is achieved, and a blinker to let you know that preparation is in progress.In addition to simplifying the signal path by adopting a chassis structure that is thought to be reasonable, we are positively introducing the use of printed circuit boards to improve and stabilize the characteristics.In order to minimize the input circuit distance, a special relay for small signals is used to switch the input between the Phono terminal and the equalizer circuit. The shield wire of the input circuit is almost eliminated and various characteristics are improved. The power supply for driving the relay is constant voltage to suppress unnecessary noise.A new multi-slider type continuously variable volume is adopted for volume such as volume, balance control and tone control.We also use film capacitors and condensers with improved sound quality for coupling capacitors, and select highly accurate switches for switches.Equipped with a dedicated socket for use of step-up transformer (8000 series) for MC cartridge sold separately.There was a wood case sold separately.
