sections.title: LUXMAN MQ70
sections.overview: Tube type stereo power amplifier using 5-pole output tube 6CA7.The output tube uses 6CA7, a 5-pole tube that is well established in the audio world.Although the 6CA7 is relatively small and has a smart shape, it can be used for a large output power of 100W in push-pull operation. In the MQ70, the 6CA7 is an ultra-linear push-pull output circuit, allowing sufficient margin to obtain output power of 45W/45W for high durability.The output transformer uses the OY15 to 6.5 KHF developed in Shinkai for the MQ70.In order to improve the performance of the MQ70 without losing the efficiency of the output tube, the output transformer is equipped with an SG tap for ultra linear connection and a third winding for cathode NF. By using these methods together, the internal resistance of the output tube is sufficiently low, the speaker is driven at constant voltage, and the bare characteristics of the output stage is improved.Power loss is reduced by half compared with the conventional OY15 type by increasing the diameter of the output transformer wire. In addition, the secondary side winding is unified in order to greatly improve frequency characteristics, phase characteristics and AC balance.The power supply circuit uses a large power transformer 9F380 with excellent regulation, and the power supply supplied to the output circuit is bridge rectification system to minimize voltage fluctuation.In addition, the smoothing circuit is connected in parallel with a choke coil #4705 with low DC resistance and a high-voltage block capacitor 47 ? Fx3. By combining two of these, the power supply impedance is sufficiently low and the power supply circuit with low voltage fluctuation is completed.In addition, the making the negative power supply supplied to the differential circuit constant voltage, the operation of the first stage is stabilized and the directly coupled drive stage is stabilized.The drive circuit consists of a 2-stage differential amplifier circuit.The first stage of the MQ70 is equipped with a differential circuit using both 12AX7 units. This circuit is highly stable and resistant to changes in temperature and power supply voltage, and can produce output with 180   phase difference. Therefore, it can also function as phase inversion.The drive stage directly connected to the first stage uses an ultra-linear connection and a cathode NF for the output stage, which requires a large drive voltage. Therefore, a high voltage driver tube 6240G of the Lux brand is used for the drive stage, and a differential amplifier circuit configuration is adopted.In such a configuration in which the phase inversion stage of differential amplification is placed in the first stage and the input signal is added to one grid and the negative feedback input is added to the other grid, the balance of the push-pull operation is automatically corrected, and the distortion factor characteristics are further improved.The phase correction circuit has also been studied to improve the distortion factor characteristics in the high frequency range.The integrating phase correction circuit inserted in the secondary side of the output transformer has little influence on the high-frequency characteristics when a speaker is connected to the speaker terminal. It works effectively when there is no load. It ensures high stability from no load to full load.The differential-phase compensation circuit consists of an NF resistor and a capacitor connected in parallel to the resistor. In the MQ70, a high-frequency choke of several ? H is inserted into this circuit to limit the amount of NF in the ultra-high frequency range and to select a capacitor of appropriate capacity to ensure balanced and high stability.Equipped with independent input level setting mechanism for left and right channels.

sections.title: LUXMAN MQ80
sections.overview: A stereo power amplifier using 6336A vacuum tube.Dual triode 6336A used for OTL amplifier MQ36 is used for the output tube.In the MQ80, one push-pull circuit per one channel is constructed using this 6336A, and 40W output is obtained at 8   load.An output transformer similar in appearance to the conventional OY15 type is used. However, in order to achieve the effect of cross-shunt push-pull operation, the primary side winding is divided into the plate side and the cathode side, and this is wound around the bifilar.In addition, the high-frequency characteristics of the output transformer are extended to 200 kHz, and the phase characteristics are also excellent. Therefore, the naked characteristics of the amplifier are improved and the stability when negative feedback is applied is also excellent.For the output stage of cross-shunt push-pull operation, 50% of the output voltage returns as negative feedback. In addition, 6336A requires a large drive voltage because of low rp and high Gm.For this reason, we have adopted a powerful twin triode 12BH7A with large plate loss for the drive stage and constructed a cathode follower direct-coupled circuit for a powerful drive circuit. We have also adopted a twin triode 6AQ8 for the phase inversion stage and constructed a cathode coupled circuit. For the first stage, we have adopted a pentad 6267 for gain.

A pre-main amplifier developed by applying the know-how obtained with HMA 9500 to pre-main.Power MOS FET, a newly developed new power amplifier, is adopted.The power MOS FET achieves a switching speed of 0.05 ? sec and an amplification factor of 1 MHz (-2dB) in frequency characteristics, which is more than one order of magnitude higher than that of conventional bipolar transistors. The power MOS FET achieves a power gain of 85 dB at 100 kHz in bare characteristics, provides stable negative feedback even at 100 kHz, and achieves excellent push-pull operation even with class B circuit configuration because of its high switching speed.In order to realize the performance of this power stage, a 3-stage power circuit with small phase change is adopted. In order to further improve low-frequency characteristics, a power supply section using a DC amplifier configuration, left and right independent power supply with excellent dynamic characteristics, and high-quality large-capacity capacitor is mounted.The gain of the main amplifier is increased from 29 dB to 45 dB, and a main direct switch is used to connect the main amplifier directly to the output of the equalizer amplifier.It is also possible to be used to reduce the gain of the main amplifier to the gain when the main direct is off.All stages of the DC amplifier configuration is adopted in which capacitors are removed from the inlet of each stage of the head amplifier, equalizer amplifier, preamplifier and main amplifier and from the negative feedback (NFB) loop.As a result, phase and response characteristics have been greatly improved, and low-frequency characteristics and transparency in mid-range and high-range areas have been improved.The equalizer amplifier section consists of three stages : a cascade differential current mirror ICL circuit, a current mirror differential circuit at the second stage, and a SEPP circuit at the last stage. The allowable input of 300 mv is secured.The head head amplifier section, a low-noise junction FET is adopted in the first stage, a constant-current drive circuit is used in the second stage, and a SEPP circuit is used in the last stage. This is a 3-stage direct connection structure.The power supply section is equipped with a left / right independent power transformer and a large-capacity capacitor. In addition, a stabilizing power supply is used for the tone amplifier and head amplifier of the small signal system to prevent mutual interference between amplifiers.Both speaker output jacks A and B use direct output jacks that connect directly to the speaker jacks without passing any signal through the speaker selector switch.The power supply section and main amplifier section use a 70 ? s board that is twice as thick as the conventional one, reducing impedance from the power supply line to the output line.

This is a stereo power amplifier that adopts Dynaharmony (E-class drive) system.The dynamic harmony method is a circuit method that efficiently realizes a large output of the amplifier through analysis of the level distribution of music. It works as a large output at the peak of the music signal, usually as a small output, and effectively operates as a large output amplifier.This reduces the weight of the amplifier, expands the safe operation range, reduces the cost, and reduces the distortion factor.The power section adopts the Dynaharmony system and consists of   2 power sources for each of low voltage power source and high voltage power source (total 4 power sources), thereby realizing large output.Class A driver circuit uses a current mirror circuit for power stage drive.It is equipped with an external magnetic meter that can directly read the peak output level by the value of power.It is equipped with a subsonic filter that eliminates harmful vibrations outside the audible band caused by sleds of records.This filter can be turned on and off as needed.The transformer used in the power supply section is of a weight class of approximately 9 kg. The power supply Chemicon uses four capacitors with low earth impedance : two 18,000 ? F (63 V)   2 power supply dual chemical capacitors and two 10,000 ? F (125 V) capacitors.As the power increases, the speaker relay adopts a new design for large power supply with rated current (AC15A) and surge current (AC60A), and DC cutoff is also possible.In addition, the contact structure is a silver contact with a large contact area, and the deterioration of sound quality is reduced by limiting the contact area to 25m   or less. First stereo power amplifier using power MOS FET.Power MOS FET is adopted as the amplifying element of the power stage.Compared with conventional small-signal MOS FETs, this power MOS FET has high amplification factor (mutual inductance) and good linearity. Moreover, it has superior high-frequency characteristics by more than one order of magnitude compared with bipolar transistors. In addition, the switching speed is fast based on the operating principle. It is more resistant to electrical breakdown than power transistors and can simplify the protection circuit of the amplifier. Since the input characteristics are enhancement characteristics, the bias circuit is simpler than that of a FET with depletion characteristics. When used as an audio amplifier in a complimentary service circuit, it can be used as a push-pull amplifier with less distortion compared to an amplifier using a power transistor.The circuit configuration consists of a differential amplifier in the first stage and a differential amplifier in the second stage with a current mirror circuit as a load.The power MOS FET has large transconductance, good linearity and frequency characteristics, large power gain, and good uniformity of complimentary service characteristics of N channel and P channel, resulting in a simple three stage circuit configuration including the power amplifier stage.A DC amplifier configuration with no condenser inside the NFB loop and no input condenser is used to eliminate components that degrade sound quality and enable more accurate waveform transmission.Crosstalk is eliminated by installing power transformers independently on the left and right sides of the power supply section, and configuring the rectifying and smoothing circuit of the power amplifier stage and stabilizing power supply for small signals independently on the left and right sides.In addition, in order to reduce interference between the left and right channels, it is designed with symmetrical separated input / output.Uses gold-plated input pin jack.

A 2-way speaker system that uses a metal diaphragm and ????????.Based on the concept of rigid piston-like vibration, metal vibration plates made of thin plates are used for both woofer and tweeter.Metal vibration provides rigidity, sound velocity, and other characteristics that cannot be obtained with paper, and expands the rigid piston-like vibration range. A floor-type speaker system that uses an acoustic super woofer (ASW) system.The ASW method is used to enhance the bass reproduction capability.In this system, an ultra-low frequency unit is mounted in the enclosure and an acoustic bandpass filter is applied to reproduce only low frequencies below 100 Hz. In this case, even if the cone vibration causes nonlinear vibration and produces harmonic distortion, the acoustic bandpass filter cuts the harmonic distortion as a distortion component.The HS-1400WA is equipped with 20 cm cone type woofer for ASW system.A selector mounted on the front baffle plate allows switching between full range, ASW and ASW off.When the selector ASW is set, the woofer and tweeter do not operate and only the ASW operates.A 20 cm cone type woofer is mounted for low range.In order to reduce distortion, non-woven fabric is used for the high compliance edge and special polymer compound is used for the damper, and cavity resonance due to plate thickness is prevented by installing a prominent frame to eliminate characteristic variations.H-54HD horn type tweeter is mounted for high frequency band.This unit is designed for mass production without losing the characteristics of the H-70HD. This is the second CD player whose sound quality has been improved by the comprehensive technology of Hitachi Lo-D.Uses 3-spot type laser pickup servo.In this servo, in addition to the main laser spot for reading the signal, two sub-laser spots for tracking error detection are arranged which are slightly shifted to the right and left. When tracking is accurately performed, the reflected light output of the two sub-laser spots is the same, but even a slight shift causes a difference in the amount of reflected light from the pit picked up by sub-laser spots 1 and 2, resulting in an unbalanced output. This enables quick detection of tracking error.A focus signal detector is used to prevent focus errors caused by vertical misalignment caused by warping of the disc. The focus signal detector uses the characteristic that the laser light passing through a cylindrical lens changes from a vertically long ellipse to a true circle to a horizontally long ellipse.Depending on the shape of the laser light entering the detector, if it is a perfect circle, it is judged as accurate focus, and if it is an ellipse, it is judged as focus error, and an error signal is.Equipped with Lodio's original two dimensional objective lens drive actuators that quickly move the objective lens in response to the ???????? correction signal and focus error correction signal.The drive part is similar to the voice coil of the speaker. By moving the lens at high speed in two directions, up and down and left and right, with respect to the correction part, accurate tracking and focus with sub-micron precision is realized.LSIs and ICs specially designed by Lordi are used in all circuits, such as data-strobe circuits that discriminate digital signals and signal-processing circuits that detect and correct errors and rearrange signals according to their format.The disk motors are equipped with brushless, coreless, and slotless uni-torque motors.The analog circuits include carefully selected audio-only parts, high-quality pure focus capacitors, and 11th-order low-pass filters.You can perform operations such as random memory music selection, direct music selection, one touch music selection, index search, manual search, and music selection cue pause.It is also equipped with a repeat function that allows you to select all tracks, selected tracks, one track, or a section.Output volume can be adjusted.There was a wired remote control unit sold separately.
